english: The language Nexus writes in. Frequencies, signal reports, callsigns, grid squares, band and mode names are never translated or reformatted — a dial reads the same in every language.
chinese: Nexus 所用的语言。频率、信号报告、呼号、网格、波段与模式名称一律不翻译、不改格式——在任何语言下，表盘读数都相同。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Workspace. The same English text "Theme" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.theme.legend, theme.aria) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Light reads best outdoors in daylight; the top bar’s Field chip boosts contrast and size in whichever theme you use.
chinese: 浅色在白天户外最易读；无论用哪种主题，顶栏的“野外”按钮都会增强对比度与字号。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Theme. The same English text "On" is used by 6 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.night.on, settings.workspace.field.on, settings.workspace.localClock.on) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Stronger text-against-background in whichever theme you are using, at the size you already have. Turn this on if the screen is hard to read — it does not change the UI scale.
chinese: 在你所用的主题下增强文字与背景的对比，并保持现有字号。若屏幕难读可开启——它不改变 UI 缩放。

english: Field mode is on, so high contrast is applied already. This setting is your own standing choice, and it is what the screen keeps when you turn Field mode off.
chinese: 野外模式已开启，因此高对比度已应用。此设置是你自己的常驻选择，关闭野外模式后屏幕会保持这一选择。

english: A darker, warmer screen for operating after dark, in whichever theme you use. The transmit red, alerts and signal colours stay exactly as they are.
chinese: 在你所用的主题下，提供更暗、更暖的屏幕以便天黑后操作。发射红、报警与信号颜色保持原样不变。

english: Comes on at dusk and goes off at dawn at your grid square: when the sun is 6° below the horizon there.
chinese: 在你网格所在地，黄昏开启、黎明关闭：即当地太阳落到地平线以下 6° 时。

english: Auto needs your grid square (Settings ▸ Station ▸ Grid) to know when the sun sets. Until it has one, Night stays off.
chinese: 自动模式需要你的网格（设置 ▸ 本台 ▸ 网格）才能判断日落时间。在获得网格之前，夜间模式保持关闭。
notes: "Settings ▸ Station ▸ Grid" is a place in the program: use the same words as the Station tab (settings.tabs.station) and its Grid field (settings.station.grid.label).

english: Maximum contrast and larger type in one switch — for daylight outdoors, and for any screen that is hard to read. The same control as the Field chip in the top bar.
chinese: 一个开关即可达到最大对比度与更大字号——适用于白天户外，以及任何难读的屏幕。它与顶栏的“野外”按钮是同一控件。

english: This window only fits up to {{fits}}% — a larger window or monitor unlocks {{wanted}}%.
chinese: 此窗口最多只能适配到 {{fits}}%——放大窗口或使用更大显示器可解锁 {{wanted}}%。

english: Fits the whole interface to the window so nothing is cut off (currently {{scale}}%). This window maxes out at {{fits}}% — raising the cap can't help until you enlarge the window, or switch to Manual to force a bigger scale.
chinese: 将整个界面适配到窗口，确保不被裁切（当前 {{scale}}%）。此窗口最大为 {{fits}}%——在放大窗口前提高上限无济于事，或切换到手动以强制更大缩放。

english: Fits the whole interface to the window so nothing is cut off (currently {{scale}}%). This window fits up to {{fits}}%; bigger caps need a larger window or monitor. The waterfall stays sharp.
chinese: 将整个界面适配到窗口，确保不被裁切（当前 {{scale}}%）。此窗口最多适配到 {{fits}}%；更大的上限需要更大的窗口或显示器。瀑布图仍保持清晰。

english: Fits the whole interface to the window so nothing is cut off (currently {{scale}}%). The waterfall stays sharp. Raise the max for big monitors.
chinese: 将整个界面适配到窗口，确保不被裁切（当前 {{scale}}%）。瀑布图仍保持清晰。大显示器可提高上限。

english: Fixed scale. Switch to Auto to fit the interface to the window automatically.
chinese: 固定缩放。切换到自动可将界面自动适配窗口。

notes: The same English text "Text size" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. sstv.tx.overlay.size.aria) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

One-word control on: Settings ▸ Workspace. The three text-size choices, in order: Normal, Large, Larger — how big the words are.
One-word control on: Settings ▸ Workspace. The three text-size choices, in order: Normal, Large, Larger — how big the words are.

english: Makes all the text bigger, including the decode and log lists. UI scale above zooms the whole screen instead.
chinese: 放大所有文本，包括译码列表与日志列表。上方的 UI 缩放则是缩放整个屏幕。

english: How tightly rows and controls pack. Compact fits more on screen. Touch makes buttons big enough for a finger.
chinese: 行与控件排布的紧密程度。紧凑可在屏幕放下更多。触控让按钮大到适合手指点按。

notes: The same English text "Card" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. qso.detail.qsl.card, callStats.src.card) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Open the station card when the pointer rests on a call
chinese: 指针停在呼号上时打开电台卡片

english: A click on a call, or Enter on it, always opens its card. On: resting the pointer on a call for half a second opens it too.
chinese: 点击呼号或在其上按回车，总会打开其卡片。开启后：指针停在呼号上停留半秒也会打开。

english: Show the 3-D globe above the Logbook
chinese: 在日志簿上方显示 3D 地球

english: The 3-D globe above the Logbook table. Turn it off and the table starts at the top.
chinese: 日志簿表格上方的 3D 地球。关闭后表格从顶部开始。

english: The columns and widths chosen in the Logbook (its Columns button), kept with your settings. Reset puts back the default table.
chinese: 在日志簿中所选的列与列宽（其“列”按钮），随你的设置一起保存。重置恢复默认表格。

notes: The same English text "Reset" is used by 9 different keys (e.g. settings.backup.reset.confirm.action, settings.colours.reset, map.reset.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 本地时间（与 UTC 并列）

english: Show this computer's local time next to the UTC clock in the top bar. Logs, spots and FT slots always use UTC.
chinese: 在顶栏的 UTC 时钟旁显示本机本地时间。日志、频点播报与 FT 时隙一律使用 UTC。

notes: Section heading on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Theme. Use the same word as the Theme row (settings.workspace.theme.label). The same English text "Theme" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.theme.label, theme.aria) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Restore the default left/right pane widths.
chinese: 恢复默认的左右面板宽度。

The name of the divider between Tempo's stations list and the conversation, which is dragged, or moved with the arrow keys, to make the list wider or narrower. Screen readers read it aloud, and it appears inside the divider's tooltip (paneSeam.title), so it is a short lower-case phrase.

The same English text "waterfall height" is used by 6 different keys (e.g. operate.waterfall.splitter.label, rtty.waterfall.splitter.label, psk.waterfall.splitter.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Band Activity — heard on the band
chinese: 波段活动——本波段上听到的信号

notes: Short label on: application shell. The same English text "Roam settings" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. roam.chip.settings.aria) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
A short warning in capitals: the radio refused a change to the width (span) of its scope.

english: The radio reports 0% power and transmit is armed — it will key and put nothing on the air. Check the Pwr slider, and the rig’s own power for THIS mode: Yaesu rigs keep a separate level for SSB, DATA, CW and AM.
chinese: 电台报告功率为 0% 且发射已待发——它会键控却不在空中发出任何信号。请检查功率滑块，以及本模式下电台自身的功率设定：Yaesu 电台对 SSB、DATA、CW 和 AM 各自保留独立的电平。

notes: One-word control on: application shell. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.
A short status chip, capitals like its neighbours (NO RF POWER, RECORDING).

english: Your Parsec session dropped (or Parsec’s log stopped answering) at {{time}} UTC, so Nexus stopped: {{what}}. Nothing was restarted; key up again when you are back.
chinese: 你的 Parsec 会话在 {{time}} UTC 断开（或 Parsec 的日志停止响应），因此 Nexus 停止了：{{what}}。未重启任何内容；回来后再重新键控。
notes: {{what}} is a list of the four shell.lane.parsecStop.what.* entries, joined with commas.

The same English text "Tune" is used by 5 different keys (e.g. shell.net.tune, memories.grid.tune.label, memories.row.tune.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The radio did not accept PTT at {{time}} UTC ({{why}}), so that over was not sent and TX was turned off. Check your PTT method and CAT/port, then turn TX on again.
chinese: 电台在 {{time}} UTC 未接受 PTT（{{why}}），因此该次通联未发出且发射已关闭。请检查你的 PTT 方式与 CAT/端口，然后重新开启发射。

english: Nexus did not key the {{mode}} over at {{time}} UTC: Flex native DAX audio is on, but the radio was not yet taking its transmit audio from Nexus over DAX. Nothing was sent and TX was turned off. Nexus finishes setting the radio up within a moment; then turn TX on again.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 键控 {{mode}} 通联：Flex 原生 DAX 音频已开启，但电台尚未从其经 DAX 接收来自 Nexus 的发射音频。未发出任何内容，发射已关闭。Nexus 会在片刻内完成电台设置；随后请重新开启发射。

english: Nexus did not key the {{mode}} over at {{time}} UTC: Flex native DAX audio is off, but the radio was still taking its transmit audio from DAX, as Nexus had set it, and nothing feeds DAX now. Nothing was sent and TX was turned off. Nexus puts the radio back on its mic input within a moment; then turn TX on again.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 键控 {{mode}} 通联：Flex 原生 DAX 音频已关闭，但电台仍按 Nexus 所设从其经 DAX 接收发射音频，而此刻 DAX 无输入。未发出任何内容，发射已关闭。Nexus 会在片刻内将电台切回麦克风输入；随后请重新开启发射。

english: Nexus did not key the radio at {{time}} UTC because the transmit audio output would not open ({{why}}). Nothing was sent and TX was turned off. Check Output Device (TX) in Settings (another program may be holding it, or it is unplugged), then turn TX on again.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 键控电台，因为发射音频输出无法打开（{{why}}）。未发出任何内容，发射已关闭。请检查设置中的输出设备（TX）（可能有其他程序占用，或设备已拔出），然后重新开启发射。
PTT 关闭失败——发射停止

english: The radio did not accept PTT off at {{time}} UTC ({{why}}), so TX was turned off. It may still be transmitting: check the radio now. Nexus keeps sending PTT off until the radio accepts it. Turn TX on again once the radio is receiving.
chinese: 电台在 {{time}} UTC 未接受 PTT 关闭（{{why}}），因此发射已关闭。它可能仍在发射：请立即检查电台。Nexus 会持续发送 PTT 关闭指令，直到电台接受。待电台恢复接收后再重新开启发射。

english: The route carrying an over's audio to the radio (Flex DAX or TCI) stopped at {{time}} UTC in the middle of the over, so the rest of it would have gone out silent. Nexus ended the over there and turned TX off. Turn TX on again to carry on.
chinese: 承载某次通联音频至电台的路由（Flex DAX 或 TCI）在该次通联中途于 {{time}} UTC 中断，因此其余部分会静默发出。Nexus 就此结束该次通联并关闭发射。请重新开启发射以继续。
通联丢弃——电台键控过晚
notes: Status-bar headline, a warning: one FT8/FT4 over was dropped because the radio keyed too late; TX stays on.

english: This over was dropped: the radio keyed only at {{time}} UTC, {{late}} after your period had ended (slow CAT), so Nexus unkeyed it at once and sent nothing, and left TX on for your next over. Split operation sends the radio its commands before each key, which on a slow CAT link can take seconds: if this keeps happening, check the CAT link and Split operation in Settings.
chinese: 此次通联被丢弃：电台仅在 {{time}} UTC 键控，即你的时隙结束后 {{late}}（CAT 较慢），因此 Nexus 立即解除键控且未发送任何内容，并保持发射开启以等待你的下一次通联。分频操作会在每次键控前向电台发送指令，在慢速 CAT 链路上可能耗时数秒：若此情况持续，请检查设置中的 CAT 链路与分频操作。
notes: {{late}} is how long after the end of the station's own period the radio keyed, as Nexus writes it, e.g. "1.2 s": keep it as it is.

english: Nexus did not key the {{mode}} over at {{time}} UTC: the radio was still taking its transmit audio from DAX, as Nexus had set it, not from its mic, so your voice would not have gone out. Nothing was sent. Let go of PTT and Nexus puts the radio back on its mic input within a moment; then press PTT again.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 键控 {{mode}} 通联：电台仍按 Nexus 所设从其经 DAX 接收发射音频，而非来自麦克风，因此你的语音不会发出。未发送任何内容。松开 PTT，Nexus 会在片刻内将电台切回麦克风输入；随后再次按下 PTT。

english: Nexus did not play the voice message at {{time}} UTC: the radio did not switch its transmit audio to DAX within 2 seconds, so nothing was keyed. The message was dropped, not held; press its key again.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 播放语音消息：电台未在 2 秒内将其发射音频切换至 DAX，因此未键控任何内容。该消息被丢弃而非暂存；请再次按下其按键。

english: Nexus did not play the voice message at {{time}} UTC: something else was transmitting or keyed the radio first (your mic or PTT, a tune carrier, another program), so nothing was keyed. The message was dropped, not held.
chinese: Nexus 未在 {{time}} UTC 播放语音消息：另有程序正在发射或已先行键控电台（你的麦克风或 PTT、一个调谐载波、另一程序），因此未键控任何内容。该消息被丢弃而非暂存。

english: Nexus is repairing this computer’s clock. Nothing starts transmitting until the repair finishes, two minutes at most, so the clock cannot move in the middle of an over.
chinese: Nexus 正在修复本机时钟。在修复完成前（最多两分钟）不会开始发射，以免时钟在通联中途移动。

english: A newly signed-in Remote device is waiting for your approval. Press Allow to transmit under Settings ▸ Remote to let it transmit.
chinese: 一台新登录的远程设备正在等待你的批准。请前往设置 ▸ 远程，按下“允许”以让其发射。

english: No live propagation data yet — set your callsign in Settings and check your internet connection.
chinese: 尚无实时传播数据——请在设置中填写呼号并检查网络连接。

english: Live propagation refetch failed — showing the last-good snapshot.
chinese: 实时传播重新获取失败——显示最后一次有效的快照。

english: Any messages still waiting to send will be cancelled. This can't be undone.
chinese: 任何仍在等待发送的消息将被取消。此操作无法撤销。
▶ 通联中 {{call}} — 正在发射你的呼号
无法通联 {{call}} — 请检查 CAT

notes: Short label on: application shell. The same English text "Could not log QSO" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. logbook.form.logFailed) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: That contact had already been logged or discarded — nothing was logged, and the one waiting is shown now.
chinese: 该联系人已被记录或丢弃——未记录任何内容，现在显示等待中的那一条。

notes: {{call}} is a callsign: the station the Log button logged or held, which can be a contact set aside behind the station now shown.

english: {{call}} is already waiting in the log popup
notes: {{call}} is a callsign: Log was pressed on a contact whose offer for that station already waits in the log popup, so nothing new was added.

english: Nothing to log — the QSO already closed or no report was exchanged
chinese: 无可记录——QSO 已关闭或未交换报告

english: Nexus did not open the logbook database because your data folder is on a network drive, where a database can be damaged by the way file locking works across a network. Nothing is lost: this session keeps your log in log.adi, as before. To use the database, move the data folder to a drive inside this computer in Settings ▸ Config ▸ Data & log folder.
chinese: Nexus 未能打开日志簿数据库，因为你的数据文件夹位于网络驱动器上，而网络上的文件锁定机制可能损坏数据库。未丢失任何内容：本次会话仍像以前一样将日志保存在 log.adi 中。要使用数据库，请在设置 ▸ 配置 ▸ 数据与日志文件夹中将数据文件夹移动到本机内的驱动器。

english: Nexus could not open the logbook database. Reason: {{reason}}. Nothing is lost: this session keeps your log in log.adi, as before. The diagnostic log has the details, in Settings ▸ Logging & Connectors ▸ Integrations & Feeds ▸ Diagnostic log.
chinese: Nexus 无法打开日志簿数据库。原因：{{reason}}。未丢失任何内容：本次会话仍像以前一样将日志保存在 log.adi 中。诊断日志中有详细信息，位于设置 ▸ 日志与连接 ▸ 集成与订阅 ▸ 诊断日志。

english: Nexus could not read the file of QSOs that were waiting in the “Log this QSO?” popup, so it kept that file, untouched, at {{path}}. Nothing was deleted.
chinese: Nexus 无法读取等待在“是否记录此 QSO？”弹窗中的 QSO 文件，因此将该文件原样保留在 {{path}}。未删除任何内容。
notes: Shown once when Nexus starts, if the file of QSOs waiting for confirmation could not be read. {{path}} is the full path of the file on the operator's computer. “Log this QSO?” is the title of the confirmation popup (logPrompt.title): use the same Russian words as that row.

Label of the clock that shows this computer's local time, beside the UTC clock in the top bar.

english: Your PC clock is {{offset}} off UTC and Nexus is already correcting for it — transmit and decode windows land on the true UTC grid. Measured {{age}} ago, {{servers}} time servers agreeing.
chinese: 你的 PC 时钟相对 UTC 偏差 {{offset}}，Nexus 已在纠正——发射与译码窗口落在真实的 UTC 网格上。于 {{age}} 前测得，{{servers}} 台时间服务器一致。

english: Logged QSO times still come from the PC clock, so this one is worth fixing at the machine.
chinese: 记录的 QSO 时间仍来自 PC 时钟，因此值得在机器层面修复这一点。

english: The last UTC measurement was {{age}} ago and has aged out, so Nexus has stopped correcting — slot timing now follows the PC clock directly. It resumes on its own as soon as a time server answers.
chinese: 上次 UTC 测量在 {{age}} 前进行，已过期，因此 Nexus 停止了纠正——时隙时序现在直接跟随 PC 时钟。一旦有时间服务器应答，会自动恢复。

english: Your PC clock is {{offset}} off UTC — too far for Nexus to correct, and your logged QSO times would be wrong by the same amount. Set the clock on the machine itself (off-grid: GPS).
chinese: 你的 PC 时钟相对 UTC 偏差 {{offset}}——偏差过大，Nexus 无法纠正，且你记录的 QSO 时间会错同样多。请在机器本身校正时钟（离网：GPS）。

A small line under the Repair clock button, in the clock chip's column. Keep it about as short as the English: a longer line widens the whole top bar.

english: Fix what the clock check found. Windows asks for administrator rights first, and Nexus runs the fix only when you press this.
chinese: 修复时钟检查所发现的问题。Windows 会先请求管理员权限，Nexus 仅在按下此项时才运行修复。

english: Not while transmitting: a clock repair can move the clock in the middle of an over. Try again when the transmitter is idle.
chinese: 发射时不可修复：时钟修复可能在一次通联中途移动时钟。待发射机空闲后重试。

english: Not in the middle of a message: a JS8 or Tempo message is still going out, and a clock repair would pause it between two of its overs. Try again when it has finished.
chinese: 不可在消息中途进行：一条 JS8 或 Tempo 消息仍在发出，时钟修复会在其两次发射之间暂停它。待其完成后重试。

english: A clock repair is already running. Answer the Windows prompt, or wait for it to finish.
chinese: 时钟修复已在运行。请应答 Windows 提示，或等待其完成。

english: There is nothing to repair now: the latest clock check found nothing to fix.
chinese: 当前无需修复：最新的时钟检查未发现要修复的问题。

english: Clock repaired. Hover the clock readout to see what changed.
chinese: 时钟已修复。悬停时钟读数可查看更改内容。

english: The clock was not repaired: the administrator prompt was declined, or Windows refused a step.
chinese: 时钟未被修复：管理员提示被拒绝，或 Windows 拒绝了某一步骤。

english: Lock transmit to the even (1st) T/R slots — the station you work must be Tx 2nd

english: Your callsign and your grid square. Everything location-shaped in Nexus — the propagation map, satellite passes, distances, bearings, DXpedition windows, VHF opening locality — is computed from these two fields.
chinese: 你的呼号与网格。Nexus 中一切与位置相关的东西——传播地图、卫星过境、距离、方位、DX 远征窗口、VHF 开通的本地性——都由这两个字段算出。

english: Open the first-run wizard (it appears on first launch) or Settings ▸ Station at any time.
chinese: 打开首次运行向导（首次启动时出现），或随时打开设置 ▸ 本台。

english: Callsign — stored uppercase. Nexus will not start PSK Reporter or the RBN/cluster feed until a valid one is set: 3–10 characters, at least one letter and one digit.
chinese: 呼号——以大写存储。在设置有效的呼号之前，Nexus 不会启动 PSK Reporter 或 RBN/cluster 馈送：3–10 个字符，至少包含一个字母和一个数字。

english: Grid square — your Maidenhead locator. QRZ shows yours.
chinese: 网格——你的梅登海德定位格。QRZ 可显示你的。

english: Name — optional, in Settings ▸ Station. Feeds the CW {NAME} macro and logbook autofill.
chinese: 姓名——可选，在设置 ▸ 本台中。供 CW 宏 {NAME} 与日志簿自动填充使用。
notes: Contains CW macro tokens in SINGLE braces ({NAME}, {RST}...). These are matched literally by the macro expander — copy them exactly, do not translate or reorder them against the words that explain them.

english: Four characters pins you to the middle of a ~100-mile square, and every distance and bearing you will ever read is measured from that point. {{full}} beats {{short}}. A malformed locator is refused outright — the wizard will not let you past it.
chinese: 四位字符会把你钉在约 100 英里方格的中心，而你将来读到的每个距离与方位都从这一点起算。{{full}} 优于 {{short}}。格式错误的定位格会被直接拒绝——向导不会让你越过它。

english: Setup wizard ▸ step 1 · re-run any time from Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Features
chinese: 设置向导 ▸ 第 1 步 · 可随时从设置 ▸ 外观 ▸ 功能重新运行

english: Your grid square is the anchor for everything location-based — satellite passes, propagation, the map, and DXpedition windows are all computed from it.
chinese: 你的网格是任何基于位置的锚点——卫星过境、传播、地图与 DX 远征窗口都由它算出。

chinese: 梅登海德定位格（qrz.com 可显示你的）。请填写全部 6 位——4 位字符会把你钉在约 100 英里方格的中心。

chinese: 第 2 / 4 步 · 你的设备

notes: The same English text "How does the radio connect?" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. gettingStarted.radio.shot.title, setup.rig.title) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: One button does the archaeology. Nexus reads the USB descriptors, matches the rig model, pairs the audio CODEC, and looks for FlexRadios on your network — in a single scan.
chinese: 一个按钮完成排查。Nexus 读取 USB 描述符、匹配电台型号、配对音频编解码器，并在一次扫描中查找你网络上的 FlexRadio。

english: In the wizard, or in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Rig & CAT, click Detect my radio.
chinese: 在向导中，或在设置 ▸ 电台 ▸ 设备与 CAT，点击检测我的电台。
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Detect my radio" is the on-screen text of settings.rigControl.detect.action. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint points at a menu entry that no longer exists.

english: Pick the row that is your radio. It fills the port, the Hamlib model and both audio devices at once. On a dual-UART Icom two rows describe the same rig — take the one tagged CI-V port — use this one.
chinese: 选择属于你的电台那一行。它会一次性填好端口、Hamlib 型号与两个音频设备。在双 UART 的 Icom 上，两行描述同一台设备——请选标注为CI-V 端口——用这个的那行。

english: Generic cable? A CH340 reporting only “USB Serial” fills the port and audio but leaves the model blank — choose it from the dropdown.
chinese: 通用线缆？一个只报告“USB Serial”的 CH340 会填好端口与音频，但型号留空——请从下拉菜单中选择。

english: FlexRadio is found on the network and configured the WSJT-X-proven way: CAT through the SmartSDR CAT app at 127.0.0.1:5002, audio through DAX.
chinese: FlexRadio 在网络上被发现，并以经 WSJT-X 验证的方式配置：通过 SmartSDR CAT 应用在 127.0.0.1:5002 进行 CAT，音频经由 DAX。

english: Then press Test CAT. Nexus saves what you entered, starts rigctld for the radio, and reports the dial frequency it read back — or the specific error. Other programs share the radio through the address in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Transmit limits & sharing.
chinese: 然后按下 Test CAT。Nexus 保存你的输入，为该电台启动 rigctld，并报告它读回的本振频率——或具体的错误。其他程序通过“设置 ▸ 电台 ▸ 发射限制与共享”中的地址共享该电台。
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Transmit limits & sharing" is the on-screen text of settings.transmit.legend. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint points at a menu entry that no longer exists.

english: USB: plug it in and power it on. Flex: it has to be on this network. Either way you can skip and set it up later — the wizard never blocks on hardware. Set Tx Level (default 0.9) down until your rig’s ALC reads zero before you transmit.
chinese: USB：插上并开机。Flex：必须在同一网络上。无论哪种你都可以跳过，稍后设置——向导从不在硬件上阻塞。在发射前，将发射电平（默认 0.9）调低，直到你的电台 ALC 读数为零。

chinese: 设置向导 ▸ 第 2 步 · Hamlib 随安装包内置

chinese: 设置向导 ▸ 第 2 步 · CAT 需要 Homebrew Hamlib——在终端中：brew install hamlib

chinese: 一次检测找到一切——USB 电台与网络上的 FlexRadio。可跳过；稍后“设置 ▸ 电台 ▸ 设备与 CAT”中都有。

english: Declare your class, get a real lockout
chinese: 申报你的等级，获得真正的锁定

english: This one field becomes a software guard in every transmit path in the app. Nexus parks the dial in your licensed segments and refuses to key up outside them, with a toast that says why.
chinese: 这一个字段会成为应用中每一条发射路径的软件守卫。Nexus 把本振停在你的授权频段内，并拒绝在其外键控，同时弹出说明原因的提示。

english: On the wizard’s last step, under What’s your license?. It is persisted the moment you click it.
chinese: 在向导的最后一步，位于你的执照是什么？下。点击的瞬间即被保存。

english: A Technician on 40 m is held to the CW segment — phone and FT8 TX outside it are blocked.
chinese: 40 米上的技术员级被限定在 CW 段——其外的话音与 FT8 发射被阻止。

english: A General on 20 m cannot transmit in the Extra-only portion at the low end.
chinese: 普通级在 20 米低端 Extra 专属部分不能发射。

english: The channelized 60 m segments are included.

chinese: 美国境外？选美国境外。锁定仅建模美国 FCC Part 97 / ITU 第 2 区，因此是关闭而非错误。

english: You are responsible for knowing your privileges. The lockout catches the slip; it does not replace the knowledge. A fresh install defaults to Open, so nothing is silently restricted before you say so.
chinese: 你有责任了解自己的权限。锁定拦下的是疏忽，而非替代知识。全新安装默认为开放，因此在你明确之前不会悄悄限制任何东西。

chinese: 设置向导 ▸ 第 4 步 · 一切从开启状态开始——这是唯一的问题

english: Sets your transmit privileges — the app parks the dial in your licensed band segments and won’t let you transmit outside them. Pick “Outside the US” for no limits.
chinese: 设定你的发射权限——应用把本振停在授权频段内，不会让你在其外发射。选“美国境外”则无限制。

english: CQ WW rule VIII.2 counts “a CW decoder, DX cluster, DX spotting Web sites … local or remote call sign and frequency decoding technology (e.g., CW Skimmer or Reverse Beacon Network)” as QSO-finding assistance. Using any of them places the entry in Single Operator Assisted (V.A.2) instead of Single Operator (V.A.1).
chinese: CQ WW 规则 VIII.2 将“CW 译码器、DX cluster、DX spotting 网站……本地或远程的呼号与频率译码技术（如 CW Skimmer 或 Reverse Beacon Network）”计为 QSO 寻找辅助。使用其中任何一项都会将参赛归入单人辅助（Single Operator Assisted，V.A.2）而非单人（V.A.1）。
do_not_translate: <b> | Single Operator | QSO | CQ | CW | DX | VIII.2

english: ARRL contests call it spotting assistance and name “PSKReporter, Telnet, DX spotting websites or bulletin board systems, automated multi-channel decoders”. Single Operator may not use it (HCAT.1.1: “Use of spotting assistance is not permitted.”). Single Operator Unlimited may (HCAT.2.1). ARRL’s glossary defines a multi-channel decoder as software that “displays multiple decoded signals at the same time”. Nexus decodes one signal at a time, so that definition does not describe its CW decoder. It does describe the cluster, RBN and PSK Reporter feeds.
chinese: ARRL 比赛称之为 spotting 辅助，并点名“PSKReporter、Telnet、DX spotting 网站或公告板系统、自动化多通道译码器”。单人不可使用它（HCAT.1.1：“不允许使用 spotting 辅助。”）。单人无限（Single Operator Unlimited）可以使用（HCAT.2.1）。ARRL 术语表将多通道译码器定义为“同时显示多个已译码信号”的软件。Nexus 一次只译码一个信号，因此该定义并不描述其 CW 译码器。但它确实描述了 cluster、RBN 与 PSK Reporter 馈送。
do_not_translate: <b> | Single Operator Unlimited | Single Operator | PSK Reporter | PSKReporter | Telnet | Nexus | ARRL | PSK | RBN | CW | DX | HCAT.1.1 | HCAT.2.1

english: Your radio’s own digital decodes, FT8 and FT4 among them, keep feeding the Needed board in unassisted mode. Neither ruleset sets them apart: both count any technology that identifies a callsign or multiplier as assistance, so do not use the Needed board to find stations if your contest counts them. Your outbound PSK Reporter uploads also keep running, because ARRL says “Generating spotting information for use by other stations is not considered to be spotting assistance.”
chinese: 你电台自身的数字译码（含 FT8 与 FT4）在非辅助模式下仍持续供给缺项面板。两套规则都未将它们单独列出：两者都将任何能识别呼号或倍乘数的技术计为辅助，因此若你的比赛将它们计入，请勿用缺项面板来寻找电台。你向外的 PSK Reporter 上传也持续运行，因为 ARRL 说“为他人站生成 spotting 信息不被视为 spotting 辅助”。
do_not_translate: <b> | PSK Reporter | ARRL | FT4 | FT8 | PSK

english: What this switch does not cover: POTA and SOTA activator spots still arrive. Neither ruleset names those feeds, but both define assistance broadly enough to include them, so switch off the POTA/SOTA features by hand if you are entering a contest that counts them.

english: Earlier versions of Nexus could put the confirmation of one contact, from LoTW, eQSL or QRZ, or the mark that LoTW holds its upload, on another contact with the same station, band and mode on the same UTC day. Check downloads your whole history once from each of these services you have set up, which can take several minutes for LoTW, and lists each contact holding a confirmation or upload mark that the service’s own records give another contact, or none. english: The preview could not be made

A bulk edit never changes the worked call. Nothing is sent from here. A STATION_CALLSIGN replaced with another call is the call a contact is uploaded under, so its upload marks are cleared and the next upload sends it again under the new call, and its LoTW, eQSL and QRZ confirmations, matched under the old call, are cleared; paper QSL cards stay. Filling in a blank STATION_CALLSIGN, clearing one, or adding or removing /P clears no upload mark or confirmation. But a contact with no STATION_CALLSIGN is uploaded under the call in Settings, so a fill or a clear can change the call a contact is sent under to a service it has not been sent to yet: the confirm names those. Every other field keeps its upload marks and confirmations.
chinese: 批量编辑绝不会修改已通联的呼号。从此处不会发送任何内容。若 STATION_CALLSIGN 被替换为另一个呼号，则该呼号是通联上传所用的呼号，因此其上传标记会被清除，下次上传会以新呼号重新发送，并且其 LoTW、eQSL 和 QRZ 确认（在旧呼号下匹配）也会被清除；纸质 QSL 卡片保留。填写空白的 STATION_CALLSIGN、清除它，或添加/移除 /P，都不会清除任何上传标记或确认。但若某通联没有 STATION_CALLSIGN，则会以“设置”中的呼号上传，因此填写或清除可能将通联发送到的呼号变更为某个尚未发送过的服务：确认信息会列出这些。所有其他字段均保留其上传标记与确认。

english: Contacts logged with no grid, where Nexus knows the station’s grid: the one it sent on the air, heard by Nexus within 24 hours of the contact (ALL.TXT, or this session), else its home QTH from a callbook lookup already made (a call with no stroke and no park, from the last 12 months). A callbook grid is kept for the distance and the map only: it counts toward no grid award, fills no GRID need and is sent to no logging service. A contact already uploaded keeps its upload marks, as with every change here: nothing is sent again, and each service keeps what it was sent.

notes: Short label on: waterfall display. The same English text "now" is used by 5 different keys (e.g. roster.card.heard.now, operate.roster.age.now, sat.passesPane.now) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
One-word control on: panadapter / scope. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: S-meter {{reading}} ({{db}} dB rel S9, via CAT)
chinese: S 表 {{reading}}（相对 S9 的 {{db}} dB，经 CAT）
发射期间 S 表暂停

english: No CAT S-meter reported by this rig
chinese: 本电台未报告 CAT S 表

english: Native FlexRadio panadapter (SmartSDR) — real RF spectrum, not the soundcard FFT
chinese: 原生 FlexRadio 全景适配器（SmartSDR）— 真实 RF 频谱，而非声卡 FFT

english: Native Icom CI-V scope — real RF spectrum, not the soundcard FFT
chinese: 原生 Icom CI-V 频谱 — 真实 RF 频谱，而非声卡 FFT

english: How far the strongest signal in this view stands above the noise floor. The scope's vertical scale is FIXED at 50 dB above the noise, so a louder signal really does draw a taller spike — use G to widen or tighten that window.
chinese: 本视图中最强信号高出噪底多少。频谱的垂直刻度固定为噪底以上 50 dB，因此更强的信号确实画出更高的尖峰 — 用 G 加宽或收紧该窗口。

english: Visual gain — stretch (right) or flatten (left) the color contrast
chinese: 视觉增益 — 拉伸（右）或压平（左）颜色对比度

english: Visual zero — raise (right) to darken the noise floor, lower (left) to reveal weak texture
chinese: 视觉零点 — 提高（右）以压暗噪底，降低（左）以显现微弱纹理

english: Back to the flat trace + waterfall
chinese: 返回平面轨迹 + 瀑布图

english: Switch to the 3D stacked-spectrum view (fills the panel; hides the trace)
chinese: 切换到 3D 堆叠频谱视图（填满面板；隐藏轨迹）

english: Pause the waterfall — then scroll back through it with the mouse wheel
chinese: 暂停瀑布图 — 然后用鼠标滚轮回滚浏览

english: Resume the live scope (history kept filling while paused)
chinese: 恢复实时频谱（暂停期间历史持续填充）

notes: Short label on: panadapter / scope. The same English text "Scrolls down" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. waterfall.flow.down.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: panadapter / scope. The same English text "Scrolls up" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. waterfall.flow.up.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Scrolls down — the newest row appears at the TOP and history travels downward. Click for newest at the bottom.
chinese: 向下滚动 — 最新行出现在顶部，历史向下移动。点击切换为最新在底部。

english: Scrolls up — the newest row appears at the BOTTOM and history travels upward. Click for newest at the top.
chinese: 向上滚动 — 最新行出现在底部，历史向上移动。点击切换为最新在顶部。

english: Click a signal to tune it · press and drag to slide the passband
chinese: 点击信号以调谐 · 按住拖动以滑动通带

english: Click a signal to tune it · press and drag to slide the passband · drag a filter edge to change the width
chinese: 点击信号以调谐 · 按住拖动以滑动通带 · 拖动滤波器边缘以更改宽度

english: Scope: ← and → tune, with Shift in bigger steps; Enter tunes onto the signal in the passband; [ and ] narrow and widen the filter; ↑ and ↓ scroll back while paused
chinese: 频谱：← 和 → 调谐，Shift 为更大步进；回车调谐到通带中的信号；[ 和 ] 收窄与加宽滤波器；↑ 和 ↓ 在暂停时回滚

english: No scope data from the radio

notes: One-word control on: panadapter / scope — the strip of controls along its scale. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Fast — 1024-point window, 85 ms. Keying and speech onsets resolve; carriers read twice as wide.
chinese: 快速 — 1024 点窗，85 毫秒。键控与语音起始可分辨；载波显示为两倍宽。

english: Balanced — 2048-point window, 171 ms. The default. A 25 WPM dit is shorter than this window.
chinese: 均衡 — 2048 点窗，171 毫秒。默认值。25 WPM 的点比此窗更短。

english: Sharp — 4096-point window, 341 ms. Half the carrier width, at double the time smear.
chinese: 锐利 — 4096 点窗，341 毫秒。载波宽度减半，时间拖尾加倍。

notes: Label of the averaging setting on the scope: how long each frequency is smoothed. Its tooltip is the next row.

english: Averaging — how long each frequency is smoothed. Longer steadies the noise floor; shorter keeps keying and syllables. Off draws every sweep as it arrives.
chinese: 平均 — 每个频率被平滑的时长。更长使噪底更稳；更短保留键控与音节。关闭则每条扫描实时绘制。

notes: Short label on: panadapter / scope — the strip of controls along its scale. The same English text "Off" is used by 17 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.contrast.off, settings.workspace.night.off, settings.workspace.field.off) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

One-word control on: panadapter / scope — the strip of controls along its scale. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.
One of the scope's two detectors (Peak, Average): how the level of each frequency is measured. A noun, not the verb.

english: Peak — where one pixel covers several frequency bins, draw the strongest. A narrow carrier keeps its level.
chinese: 峰值 — 当一个像素覆盖多个频率分箱时，绘制最强者。窄载波保持其电平。

notes: Short for Average: one of the scope's two detectors (Peak, Average) — how the level of each frequency is measured.

english: Average — where one pixel covers several frequency bins, draw their mean power. A smoother noise floor; a narrow carrier in a wide view reads lower.
chinese: 平均 — 当一个像素覆盖多个频率分箱时，绘制其平均功率。噪底更平滑；宽视图中的窄载波读数更低。

english: Display settings — resolution, smoothing, the detector, and how a slow scope scrolls
chinese: 显示设置 — 分辨率、平滑、检波器，以及慢速频谱的滚动方式

english: Smooth scroll — the waterfall moves at a steady rate. When the radio's scope sweeps slower than that, the newest sweep is repeated until the next one arrives, and each repeat is recorded as one. Click for one row per sweep.
chinese: 平滑滚动 — 瀑布图以稳定速率移动。当电台频谱扫描慢于该速率时，最新扫描会被重复，直到下一条到达，且每次重复记录为一行。点击切换为每行一次扫描。

english: One row per sweep — the waterfall moves only when the radio sends a new sweep, so a slow scope scrolls slowly, in steps, and every row is new. Click for smooth scroll.
chinese: 每行一次扫描 — 瀑布图仅在电台发送新扫描时移动，因此慢速频谱缓慢、分步滚动，且每行都是新的。点击切换为平滑滚动。

notes: The same English text "Fast" is used by 6 different keys (e.g. operate.header.decodeDepth.fast, rtty.wf.speed.fast, cw.rxDsp.agc.fast) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: HiDef — the CW passband is analysed on its own: a steady carrier draws about 4–5 Hz wide, two signals 10 Hz apart stay apart, and keying keeps its gaps. The picture runs about a quarter of a second behind the audio. Click for Fast.
chinese: 高清 — CW 通带单独分析：稳定载波绘制约 4–5 Hz 宽，相距 10 Hz 的两个信号保持分离，键控保留其间隔。图像比音频滞后约四分之一秒。点击切换为快速。

english: Fast — the scope is analysed like every other display: the picture follows the audio closely and carriers draw wider (the resolution is under ⚙). Click for HiDef.
chinese: 快速 — 频谱像其他显示一样分析：图像紧随音频，载波绘制更宽（分辨率在 ⚙ 之下）。点击切换为高清。

english: Fast Graph — signal power across the T/R period; pings draw as spikes
chinese: 快速图 — 跨 T/R 周期的信号功率；ping 绘制为尖峰
天线匹配 — 保持在 2:1 以下

english: Antenna match — this is the radio's own raw figure, and Nexus has no verified scale for this model, so it cannot tell you what counts as high here. Watch which way it moves as you tune; the absolute number may be well out, and nothing stops your transmission on it.
chinese: 天线匹配 — 这是电台自身的原始数值，而 Nexus 没有为该型号验证过的刻度，因此无法告知你何为过高。调谐时注意其变化方向；绝对值可能偏差很大，且不会据此阻止你发射。

english: ALC — set mic gain so SSB peaks just tickle the zone, never peg it
chinese: ALC — 设置麦克风增益，使 SSB 峰值仅轻触该区，切勿顶满

english: Speech compression — the bar is the meter, the line is the processor level ({{level}}%). Drag the bar or use the arrow keys to set the level.
chinese: 语音压缩 — 柱条是表，线是处理器电平（{{level}}%）。拖动柱条或用方向键设置电平。

english: SSB transmit bandwidth: {{step}}. Click for the radio's next setting.
chinese: SSB 发射带宽：{{step}}。点击切换电台的下一个设置。
SSB 发射带宽 {{step}}，下一个设置

english: Not while transmitting — change the transmit bandwidth between overs
chinese: 发射中不可更改 — 在间歇之间更改发射带宽

english: The radio's power-amplifier (finals) temperature, as the radio reports it
chinese: 电台功放（末级）温度，按电台报告值

english: The amplifier's temperature, as the amplifier reports it
chinese: 放大器的温度，按放大器报告值

english: The radio's power-amplifier (finals) temperature meter, as a share of its scale — this radio reports its meter, not degrees
chinese: 电台功放（末级）温度表，以其刻度占比表示 — 该电台报告的是表值，而非度数

english: No street map is downloaded yet.
chinese: 尚未下载任何街道地图。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Map & globe ▸ Street maps. The same English text "Remove" is used by 9 different keys (e.g. logbook.tools.bulk.remove, settings.radios.remove.action, awards.custom.remove) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: This frees {{size}}. The map choice stays, and Street offers a download again.
chinese: 这将释放 {{size}}。地图选择保留，街道地图会再次提供下载。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Map & globe ▸ Street maps. The same English text "Check for updates" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.panel.update.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Map & globe ▸ Street maps. The same English text "Checking…" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. contestSetup.sends.checking, settings.contestAids.update.busy, settings.fdRules.update.busy) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Every street map is up to date.
chinese: 所有街道地图均为最新。
已将 {{name}} 更新至 {{date}} 的地图数据。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Map & globe ▸ Street maps. The same English text "Download a street map" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. map.street.sheet.title) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Kept in <path>{{folder}}</path>, outside your data folder. Uninstalling Nexus leaves it: delete it by hand to free the space.
chinese: 保存在 <path>{{folder}}</path>，位于你的数据文件夹之外。卸载 Nexus 会保留它：需手动删除以释放空间。

english: Bench only (NEXUS_STREET_MAP=1): a .pmtiles map file, or the fonts and icons archive (.tar.gz).
chinese: 仅限 Bench（NEXUS_STREET_MAP=1）：.pmtiles 地图文件，或字体与图标归档（.tar.gz）。

english: Interrupts you the INSTANT a needed station appears on the cluster or RBN, rather than waiting for the spot board to refresh. A loud tone plays whether or not Nexus is the window you are looking at, and a banner offers one-click Work. Off until you switch it on. How rare "rare" is depends on your own totals: if you are chasing your first hundred entities then almost every DX spot is a new one and this would never stop talking. Start with New DXCC entity only once your log is far enough along that a new one is genuinely an event. Each station alerts once per band and mode.
chinese: 当所需电台出现在集群或 RBN 上的瞬间即打断你，而非等待点报板刷新。无论 Nexus 是否是你正在看的窗口，都会播放响亮提示音，横幅提供一键通联。默认关闭，需手动开启。“罕见”有多罕见取决于你自身的统计：若你正在追逐前一百个实体，则几乎每个 DX 点报都是新目标，此功能会喋喋不休。当你的日志足够丰富、新目标确实成为事件时，再从 仅新 DXCC 实体 开始。每个电台在每个频段和模式仅提醒一次。
notes: Quotes another control by name: "New DXCC entity only" is the on-screen text of settings.pounce.threshold.atno. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint points at a menu entry that no longer exists.

chinese: 新实体或 CQ 分区

english: New entity, zone, US state, or IOTA group
chinese: 新实体、分区、美国州或 IOTA 群

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Alerts. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.
Label of a switch on: Settings ▸ Spots & Alerts ▸ Alerts. It turns off the messages that pop up in the bottom-right corner of the window.

english: The messages in the bottom-right corner. Turned off, confirmations such as Logged QSO and alerts such as a new DXCC, a station calling you, a band opening or space weather stop popping up. Sounds are not affected. Errors, notices about transmitting, the radio or the log, and any message with a button, such as Stop alarm, still pop up.
chinese: 右下角的消息。关闭后，诸如“已记录 QSO”的确认，以及新 DXCC、有人呼叫你、频段开通或空间天气等提醒将不再弹出。声音不受影响。错误、关于发射/电台/日志的通知，以及任何带按钮的消息（如停止警报）仍会弹出。
notes: The explanation under the Pop-up notifications switch. Logged QSO and Stop alarm are the words of a message and of a button elsewhere in the program (shell.toast.logged, dxped.alarm.stop): use the Russian you give those, so the operator recognises them.

english: Keep pop-ups up for at least
Most pop-ups go after 4 seconds, errors after 12. Pick a longer time if you look away and miss them. A pop-up that stays until you close it still does.
chinese: 大多数弹窗 4 秒后消失，错误 12 秒。若你转头错过，可选更长时间。一直保持到你关闭的弹窗仍如此。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Alerts. The same English text "My call" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. rtty.macro.myCall.label, psk.macro.myCall.label, settings.cw.macros.role.myCall) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Beep + flash when someone directs a call at you.
chinese: 当有人定向呼叫你时，蜂鸣 + 闪烁。

english: Show worked-but-unconfirmed award slots — LoTW confirmation chances — on the Needed board and as chips on decodes. Turn off to chase only new contacts.
chinese: 在需求板和解码上的芯片中显示已通联但未确认的奖项槽位 — LoTW 确认机会。关闭则仅追逐新联络。
显示 WPX 前缀需求

english: Add a WPX chip to Needed-board stations that would be a new prefix on that band and mode. Off by default, because most stations are. No sound or pop-up.
chinese: 为需求板上在该频段和模式将成为新前缀的电台添加 WPX 芯片。默认关闭，因为大多数电台已是。无声音或弹窗。
显示 WAE 国家需求

english: Add a WAE chip to Needed-board stations that would be a new Worked All Europe country on that band and mode. Off by default. No sound or pop-up.
chinese: 为需求板上在该频段和模式将成为新的 Worked All Europe 国家的电台添加 WAE 芯片。默认关闭。无声音或弹窗。

english: Alert on any decoded CQ. Off by default — CQs are constant.
chinese: 对任何解码出的 CQ 提醒。默认关闭 — CQ 连绵不断。

english: Beep when a park is freshly spotted on the air (the map's Parks on the air layer). Off by default.
chinese: 当公园刚在空中被点报时蜂鸣（地图的公园空中活动图层）。默认关闭。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Alerts. The same English text "Off" is used by 17 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.contrast.off, settings.workspace.night.off, settings.workspace.field.off) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Alerts. The same English text "All bands" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. logbook.globe.band.all, awards.grids.filter.all.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 新 DXCC 与网格提醒

english: The sound and the pop-up when you decode a new DXCC, a new grid or a rare grid 💎 on a band its menu allows. Off silences them and changes nothing else: the Needed boards and the NEW ONE and GRID icons keep following the three menus.
chinese: 当你在菜单允许的频段上解码出新 DXCC、新网格或罕见网格 💎 时的声音与弹窗。关闭会使它们静音，但不改变其他：需求板以及 NEW ONE 与 GRID 图标仍跟随这三个菜单。

english: The bands where a new DXCC entity — a “new one” — counts: the Needed boards, the NEW ONE icon and its loud alert all follow this choice. Off takes NEW ONE off every board.
chinese: 一个新 DXCC 实体 —“新目标”— 计数的频段：需求板、NEW ONE 图标及其响亮提醒都遵循此选择。关闭则从每个板移除 NEW ONE。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Alerts. The same English text "New grid" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. needed.filter.newGrid) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The bands where a grid you haven't worked counts: the Needed boards, the GRID icon on the roster and the decode rows, and its quiet toast all follow this choice. Default VHF+ only — grid awards (VUCC/FFMA) start at 6 m; on HF nearly every decode is an unworked grid.
chinese: 你未通联过的网格计数的频段：需求板、名册和解码行上的 GRID 图标，以及其安静的提示都遵循此选择。默认仅 VHF+ — 网格奖项（VUCC/FFMA）从 6 米起；在 HF 上几乎每个解码都是未通联的网格。

english: The bands where a rare or water-only grid (rovers, maritime, DXpeditions) counts: the Needed boards, its GRID icon and the loud 💎 alert all follow this choice. Separate from plain grids, so silencing HF chatter keeps the gems.
chinese: 罕见或仅水域网格（漫游车、海上、DXpeditions）计数的频段：需求板、其 GRID 图标和响亮的 💎 提醒都遵循此选择。与普通网格分开，因此屏蔽 HF 嘈杂声会保留这些珍宝。

english: Leave every box clear to be alerted about the whole world — that is the default and what this panel has always done. Tick one or more and the new-one, new-grid and CQ alerts are kept to those continents. Someone calling YOU, and anything on your watch list, always alerts wherever they are.
chinese: 将所有框留空以接收全球提醒 — 这是默认且本面板一直的做法。勾选一个或多个，则新目标、新网格和 CQ 提醒仅限于这些洲。呼叫你的某人，以及你关注列表上的任何内容，无论在哪里都会提醒。

english: Countries added here alert as well as the continents ticked above, so you can follow all of Europe plus Japan. Untick one to drop it. Names are the DXCC list’s own, so Germany appears as Fed. Rep. of Germany.
chinese: 此处添加的国家与上面勾选的洲一同提醒，因此你可关注整个欧洲加日本。取消勾选以移除。名称采用 DXCC 列表自身的叫法，因此德国显示为 Fed. Rep. of Germany。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Alerts. The same English text "Watch list" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. needed.filter.wanted) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 接收测试版（预发布）更新

english: When on, the updater offers pre-release builds — newer features, but less tested. Off keeps you on stable releases only.
chinese: 开启时，更新器提供预发布版本 — 功能更新，但测试较少。关闭则仅停留在稳定版。

english: Start Nexus when I sign in to this computer
chinese: 登录此电脑时启动 Nexus

english: Off by default. Nexus opens as usual, listening only: transmit stays off until you turn it on. Useful with Remote, which comes back on by itself after a restart if it was on when Nexus closed.
chinese: 默认关闭。Nexus 照常打开，仅监听：发射保持关闭，直到你开启。配合远程功能很有用——若 Nexus 关闭时远程处于开启，重启后会自动恢复。

english: This computer did not let Nexus change whether it starts at sign-in, so the setting is unchanged.
chinese: 此电脑未允许 Nexus 更改登录时是否启动，因此该设置未变。

english: Serves the full Conditions view — the map with every layer, the panes, live openings — read-only, to any browser on your network: a shack TV, a tablet, a phone. Nothing can be changed from it.
chinese: 向网络上任何浏览器（机房电视、平板、手机）只读提供完整的 Conditions 视图 — 包含所有图层的地图、各面板、实时开通。无法从中进行任何更改。

english: While this is on, anyone on your network can see your callsign, grid square and the propagation picture — including the callsigns of stations heard and spotted. Your log, your needs board and the frequency you are on are never sent.
chinese: 开启期间，网络上任何人都能看到你的呼号、网格方格与传播图景 — 包括听到和点到电台的呼号。你的日志、需求板以及所在频率绝不会被发送。

english: Serve Conditions on the local network
Stop serving Conditions on the local network
chinese: 停止在本地网络提供 Conditions

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Conditions on a TV. The same English text "Port" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.amplifier.netPort.label, settings.aprs.is.port.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 同时运行两台电台 — 例如一台 HF 电台加一台不同天线的 VHF/UHF 电台？添加第二台电台；之后你可编辑其中任意一台而不打断正在操作的电台。新手可忽略此项。

english: Run both radios at the same time

Run both radios at the same time — launch Nexus and it asks which radio this window drives; open a second window for the other. Both share one logbook. Leave off if you only ever use one radio at a time (you can still switch between them from the top bar).
chinese: 同时运行两台电台 — 启动 Nexus 时会询问本窗口驱动哪台电台；为另一台打开第二个窗口。两者共享一个日志簿。若你一次只使用一台电台，请保持关闭（仍可从顶栏在它们之间切换）。

The same English text "rule {{n}}, {{bands}} · {{mode}}" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. radioSetup.route.rule) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: any band no other radio lists
chinese: 其他电台未列出的任何频段

english: The Icom network connection works with the IC-7610, IC-9700, IC-705, IC-905, IC-7760 and IC-7300MK2. Pick one of those, or Serial (USB).
chinese: Icom 网络连接适用于 IC-7610、IC-9700、IC-705、IC-905、IC-7760 与 IC-7300MK2。请选其中之一，或串行（USB）。

english: Enter the radio's IPv4 address, for example {{example}}.
chinese: 输入电台的 IPv4 地址，例如 {{example}}。

english: No network user is set, so the radio will refuse the login.
chinese: 未设置网络用户，因此电台将拒绝登录。

chinese: 尚未保存此电台的网络密码：输入后按设置。

english: Enter the SDR program's address on its own, such as {{example}} when it runs on this computer.
chinese: 单独输入 SDR 程序的地址，例如它在本机运行时为 {{example}}。

english: Enter the TCI port, a number from 1 to 65535: {{example}} as ExpertSDR3 and Thetis come.
chinese: 输入 TCI 端口，1 到 65535 之间的数字：{{example}} 为 ExpertSDR3 与 Thetis 的默认值。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Audio. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word. The same English text "Audio" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.thisComputer.audio.title) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: 🎚 Audio devices below are for {{radio}}. Each radio has its OWN input/output — click “Edit” on another radio (in Radios above) to set its audio. The live RX audio + waterfall follow whichever radio is active.
chinese: 🎚 下方音频设备用于 {{radio}}。每台电台都有自己的输入/输出 — 点击另一电台（上方电台中）的“编辑”以设置其音频。实时 RX 音频 + 瀑布图跟随当前活动电台。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Audio. The same English text "the selected radio" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.radios.selectedRadio) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "System default" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.thisComputer.audio.default) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 向电台馈送（发射）的声卡。

english: Flat — no audio on the selected input. Check the device above (radio on? right codec?).
chinese: 平坦 — 所选输入无音频。检查上方设备（电台开了吗？编解码器对吗？）。

english: What the selected input hears, live — band noise should show as a moving floor. Confirms the RIGHT device before you leave Settings.
chinese: 所选输入实时听到的内容 — 频段噪声应显示为移动的底噪。在离开设置前确认是正确设备。

english: The audio drive into the rig — the SAME control as the cockpit Pwr slider (they always match now). Trim down until your rig's ALC is just zero. This is not the rig's RF watts — set those on the radio.
chinese: 送入电台的音频 驱动 — 与驾驶舱 功率 滑块是同一控制（现在始终一致）。下调直到电台的 ALC 刚好为零。这 不是 电台的 RF 瓦数 — 那些在电台上设置。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Audio. The same English text "RX audio level" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. topbar.rxLevel.label, phone.rxMeter.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: A dB scale like WSJT-X — aim for around 30 dB. Anything from ~15–60 dB decodes fine; red means too hot (back off RX Gain or the rig's audio).
chinese: 类似 WSJT-X 的 dB 刻度 — 目标约 30 dB。约 15–60 dB 范围内都能正常解码；红色表示过热（调低 RX 增益或电台音频）。

english: Boost a quiet interface until RX Level reads around 30 dB — the meter responds as you release the slider. Leave at ×1.0 unless the meter reads low (under ~15 dB) — FT8 decodes on a small signal, so you rarely need much.
chinese: 提升安静的接口直到 RX 电平读至约 30 dB — 仪表会在你松开滑块时响应。除非仪表读数偏低（低于约 15 dB），否则保持 ×1.0 — FT8 在小信号上也能解码，因此你很少需要很多。

english: Save stores this for {{radio}}, and it takes effect when that radio is in use; the radio in use now does not change.
chinese: 保存 为 {{radio}} 存储此项，并在该电台使用时生效；当前正在使用的电台不改变。

english: A short audio cue when the dial crosses your license privileges — a rising "ding" back in band, a falling "dong" past an edge. Applies on every mode.
chinese: 当刻度盘越过你的执照权限时发出简短音频提示 — 回到频段内为上升的“叮”，越过边缘为下降的“咚”。适用于所有模式。
按模式限制最大功率（安全）

english: A ceiling on RF output per mode — leave blank for full power. FT8/FT4/RTTY run ~100% duty cycle, so capping the Digital modes (e.g. 30%) protects your finals and any amplifier. The rig is brought down to the cap the moment you enter a capped mode, not only when you touch the power slider.
chinese: 每种模式的 RF 输出上限 — 留空为满功率。FT8/FT4/RTTY 占空比约 100%，因此限制数字模式（如 30%）可保护你的末级和任何放大器。一旦进入受限模式，电台即降至上限，而非仅在你动功率滑块时。

english: Stop transmitting when SWR is high

notes: The SWR above which Nexus stops transmitting (the setting "Stop transmitting when SWR is high").

english: Two readings in a row above this and Nexus stops transmitting, exactly as Stop TX does, and tells you why. It never starts a transmission and never turns TX back on — you do that once the antenna is sorted out. Off by default; a high reading on one poll is ignored, so a tuner stepping or a keyup transient will not cut you off.
chinese: 连续两次读数高于此值，Nexus 即停止发射，与停止 TX 完全相同，并告知原因。它从不发起发射，也从不重新开启 TX — 待天线整理好后由你操作。默认关闭；单次轮询的高读数会被忽略，因此调谐器步进或按键瞬态不会切断你。
notes: "Stop TX" is the button's own name, English on purpose (the README).

english: This radio's SWR reading isn't verified yet, so Nexus won't stop your transmission on it. Nexus only trusts the number where it knows the radio's own scale — Icom over native CI-V, and FlexRadio. On other radios the figure can be far out: some show a near-perfect match on their own meter while reporting a fault here.
chinese: 此电台的 SWR 读数尚未验证，因此 Nexus 不会据此停止你的发射。Nexus 仅在知道电台自身刻度时才信任该数值 — 原生 CI-V 的 Icom，以及 FlexRadio。在其他电台上该数值可能偏差很大：有些在自己表上显示近乎完美匹配，却在此报告故障。

english: Nexus is not receiving this Flex's own SWR meter, so this cutoff will not stop anything, however high the SWR goes. That meter comes from the radio's native stream, and it is off. Turn on "Flex native panadapter (Beta)" in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Rig & CAT to start it. Until then this setting has no effect.
chinese: Nexus 未收到此 Flex 自身的 SWR 表，因此无论 SWR 多高，此切断都不会停止任何发射。该表来自电台的原生数据流，且当前关闭。在 设置 ▸ 电台 ▸ 电台与 CAT 中开启“Flex 原生全景适配器（测试版）”以启动它。在此之前此设置无效。
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Flex native panadapter (Beta)" is the on-screen text of settings.rigControl.flexPan.label. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint points at a menu entry that no longer exists.

english: Stop latched transmissions if my Parsec session drops
chinese: 若我的 Parsec 会话断开则停止锁存发射

english: For running the shack over Parsec. Nexus watches Parsec's own log on this computer. If the Parsec session that was connected drops, or its log can no longer be read, Nexus stops a latched PTT, continuous RTTY or PSK, and Tune, exactly as their own Stop does, and says why. It never starts a transmission or turns TX back on. FT8/FT4 overs are not touched: they end by themselves, and the TX watchdog still applies. Parsec can take up to a minute to notice a pulled network cable, so this backs up the watchdog rather than replacing it.
chinese: 用于在 Parsec 上运行机房。Nexus 监视本机上 Parsec 自身的日志。若已连接的 Parsec 会话断开，或其日志无法再读取，Nexus 会停止锁存的 PTT、连续 RTTY 或 PSK，以及调谐，与其自身的停止完全相同，并说明原因。它从不发起发射或重新开启 TX。FT8/FT4 周期不受影响：它们自行结束，且 TX 看门狗仍然适用。Parsec 可能需要近一分钟才注意到拔掉的网络线，因此这是看门狗的备份而非替代。
do_not_translate: Parsec | Nexus | PTT | RTTY | PSK | Tune | TX | FT8/FT4

english: Available on Windows only, where Nexus can read the Parsec host’s log.
chinese: 仅在 Windows 上可用，Nexus 可在其上读取 Parsec 主机的日志。
正在检查 Parsec 日志…

english: A Parsec session is connected. If it drops, a latched transmission stops.
chinese: 已连接一个 Parsec 会话。若断开，锁存发射将停止。

english: No Parsec session is connected, so nothing will be stopped.
chinese: 未连接任何 Parsec 会话，因此不会停止任何发射。

english: Nexus cannot find or read Parsec’s log (it looks for log.txt in %APPDATA%\Parsec and %ProgramData%\Parsec), so nothing will be stopped until it can.
chinese: Nexus 无法找到或读取 Parsec 的日志（它在 %APPDATA%\Parsec 和 %ProgramData%\Parsec 中查找 log.txt），因此在能够读取之前不会停止任何发射。

english: Stream this station from my browser
chinese: 从我的浏览器串流此电台
notes: Stream means sending the picture of this window over the internet, not a radio transmission. Avoid "transmitir" here: a ham reads it as keying the radio.

english: A browser you approved for station control, while it holds control, is shown this Nexus window and can operate it as you would here, transmit included. Its clicks and keys reach Nexus only, never anything else on this computer. Only this window is sent: a dialog that opens outside it, such as a file picker, is not, and a minimized window sends nothing. The stream is encrypted end to end. While a browser is connected, every transmission stops within five seconds if its connection drops, and within seven if its picture freezes.
chinese: 你批准用于电台控制、且正持有控制的浏览器，会显示此 Nexus 窗口，并可像你在此处一样操作它，包括发射。它的点击和按键仅送达 Nexus，绝不会触及本机其他任何内容。仅发送此窗口：在窗口外打开的对话框（如文件选择器）不会发送，最小化的窗口不发送任何内容。串流端到端加密。浏览器连接期间，若连接断开，所有发射在五秒内停止；若画面冻结，在七秒内停止。
notes: "transmit" in the first sentence and "transmission" in the last are the radio sense: the browser can key the rig, and every transmission at the station stops.

english: The stream is this window as Windows draws it on this computer, so keep Nexus open, and not minimized, while a browser streams it.
chinese: 串流就是 Windows 在本机上绘制的此窗口，因此在浏览器串流期间，保持 Nexus 打开且不要最小化。
notes: Stream means sending the picture of this window over the internet, not a radio transmission. Avoid "transmitir" here: a ham reads it as keying the radio. "Windows" is the operating system; "minimized" is the window sent to the taskbar.

english: Available on Windows only, for now.
Available on Windows only, for now. Elsewhere, open Remote in your browser.
chinese: 目前仅限 Windows。其他平台请在浏览器中打开远程。

english: Saving applies your rig settings live (no restart). Test CAT saves, launches the bundled rigctld (Hamlib ships with Nexus on Windows — no separate install), and reads your rig's frequency to confirm CAT. For CAT, pick your Rig Model and Serial Port; serial RTS/DTR and VOX need no model.
chinese: 保存会实时应用你的电台设置（无需重启）。测试 CAT 会保存、启动内置的 rigctld（Hamlib 随 Nexus 在 Windows 上提供 — 无需单独安装），并读取你的电台频率以确认 CAT。对于 CAT，选择你的 电台型号 和 串口；串行 RTS/DTR 与 VOX 无需型号。
do_not_translate: <b> | <code> | <em> | rigctld | Hamlib | Nexus | CAT | VOX | RTS/DTR
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Test CAT" is the on-screen text of settings.rigControl.testCat.action. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint points at a menu entry that no longer exists.

english: Save your radios, preferences, memory channels and watchlist to a file
chinese: 将你的电台、偏好、记忆频道和关注列表保存到文件

english: Your radios, operating preferences, memory channels, watchlist and chase sets in one file — for a new computer, or before a rebuild. It holds no passwords or API keys: those stay in your operating system's keychain, so a restore asks for them again, and the file is safe to keep on a USB stick. Your contact log is separate — export that from the Logbook. Restoring replaces your current setup.
chinese: 你的电台、操作偏好、记忆频道、关注列表和追逐集集中于一个文件 — 用于新电脑，或重建前。它不含任何密码或 API 密钥：那些保留在你的操作系统钥匙串中，因此恢复时会再次索要，文件可放心存于 U 盘。你的联络日志是独立的 — 从日志簿导出。恢复会替换你当前的设置。

english: It also carries how Nexus looks: the theme, colours, text size, density, Night and waterfall palettes, and a restore puts them back. Field mode and UI scale stay with each computer.
chinese: 它还携带 Nexus 的外观：主题、颜色、文字大小、密度、夜间与瀑布图调色板，恢复时会还原这些。现场模式与 UI 缩放随每台电脑保留。
notes: A second line under Settings ▸ Config ▸ Backup & reset ▸ Back up your setup (settings.transmit.backup.hint).

english: Back up to a folder you choose (Back up saves straight to Downloads)
chinese: 备份到你选择的文件夹（备份直接存入下载）

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Transmit. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Replace your current setup with a saved backup
chinese: 用已保存的备份替换当前设置

english: Share this radio with other programs
chinese: 与其他程序共享此电台

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Transmit. The same English text "Copy" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. settings.connectWeb.url.copy, contestOver.submit.copy, settings.fdBoard.url.copy) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: {{wanted}} is taken (another program is listening there, or it is your radio’s own rigctld address), so Nexus leaves it free and is sharing on {{port}} instead. Point other programs at this address.
chinese: {{wanted}} 已被占用（另一程序正在该处监听，或它是你电台自身的 rigctld 地址），因此 Nexus 将其留空，改为在 {{port}} 共享。将其他程序指向此地址。

english: Copy the address to paste into the other program
chinese: 复制地址以粘贴到其他程序

english: Nexus itself answers at this address, so VarAC, FreeDV, WSJT-X, JS8Call and fldigi can use the radio while Nexus runs — pick the rig Hamlib NET rigctl (VarAC and FreeDV call it a network or rigctld connection), give it the address above, and leave their serial port blank. They stay connected even while Nexus tests or reconfigures the radio link, and they follow whichever radio is active. Only for this computer — the address is not reachable from the network. Takes effect right away. Both programs can command the rig, so expect them to argue if you tune in both at once.
chinese: Nexus 自身在此地址应答，因此 VarAC、FreeDV、WSJT-X、JS8Call 和 fldigi 可在 Nexus 运行时使用电台 — 选择电台 Hamlib NET rigctl（VarAC 与 FreeDV 称之为网络或 rigctld 连接），填入上方地址，并将其串口留空。即使 Nexus 测试或重新配置电台链路，它们仍保持连接，并跟随当前活动电台。仅限本机 — 该地址无法从网络访问。立即生效。两个程序都能指令电台，因此若你同时调谐两者，它们会“争执”。
do_not_translate: <b> | <em> | JS8Call | rigctld | Hamlib | WSJT-X | fldigi | Nexus

english: Off — other programs cannot use the radio while Nexus runs. Turn it on and point them at the address that appears here (Hamlib NET rigctl).
chinese: 关闭 — Nexus 运行时其他程序无法使用电台。开启后将它们指向此处出现的地址（Hamlib NET rigctl）。

english: Driving a specific radio that is not the active one: use its direct address {{address}} (per-radio; this link drops briefly whenever Nexus reconfigures that radio).
chinese: 驱动某个非活动电台：使用其直连地址 {{address}}（每台电台独立；每当 Nexus 重新配置该电台时，此链路会短暂断开）。

english: On: a shared program (WSJT-X, VarAC) can key the rig, exactly as it could when it owned the CAT cable — every Nexus transmit safeguard still applies. Off: shared programs tune and read but never transmit.
chinese: 开启：共享程序（WSJT-X、VarAC）可触发电台，正如它独占 CAT 线缆时那样 — Nexus 的所有发射安全措施仍然适用。关闭：共享程序可调谐与读取，但绝不会发射。

notes: The switch that runs Nexus as a TCI server for other programs on this computer.

english: Off. Turn it on and programs on this computer that speak TCI, such as WSJT-X, JTDX, MSHV and Log4OM, can use the radio through Nexus at the address that appears here.
chinese: 关闭。开启后，本机上支持 TCI 的程序（如 WSJT-X、JTDX、MSHV 和 Log4OM）可通过此处出现的地址经 Nexus 使用电台。
do_not_translate: <b> | WSJT-X | JTDX | MSHV | Log4OM | TCI | Nexus

english: Programs on this computer connect to this address as they would to an SDR program's TCI server. In WSJT-X and JTDX, pick the rig TCI Client RX1 and give it this address as its TCI server. They follow whichever radio is active: they can tune it, switch its sideband and lower its power (never raise it), and they get its receive audio. Only programs on this computer can connect, never another computer and never a web page. Takes effect when you save.
chinese: 本机程序连接到此地址，如同连接到某 SDR 程序的 TCI 服务器。在 WSJT-X 与 JTDX 中，选择电台 TCI Client RX1 并将此地址作为其 TCI 服务器。它们跟随当前活动电台：可对其调谐、切换边带并降低功率（绝不升高），并获取其接收音频。仅本机程序可连接，绝不来自另一台电脑，也绝不来自网页。保存时生效。
do_not_translate: <em> | WSJT-X | JTDX | TCI Client RX1 | TCI | SDR
notes: "TCI Client RX1" is the rig name WSJT-X and JTDX show, copied exactly.

english: Not listening yet. The address appears here once programs can connect. If you just turned this on, save first.
chinese: 尚未监听。程序可连接后地址将出现于此。若你刚开启，请先保存。

english: WSJT-X, JTDX and MSHV look for 40001. A second Nexus window uses the next port, and the address above always shows the one in use. Change it only if another program on this computer already has it.
chinese: WSJT-X、JTDX 和 MSHV 寻找 40001。第二个 Nexus 窗口使用下一端口，上方地址始终显示正在使用的那个。仅当本机另一程序已占用时才更改。

english: Off: programs tune and read but never transmit. On: a program may key the radio with its own audio or the radio's microphone while Nexus is on its Phone screen, send CW macros on the CW screen, and Tune. Its own audio goes out only once it has asked for a voice mode (USB, LSB, AM or FM). WSJT-X and JTDX ask for a mode only when it differs from Nexus's, so set to USB while Nexus is already in USB they ask for nothing and are refused. Every Nexus transmit safeguard still applies: TX must be on in Nexus, Stop TX wins and holds, and nothing goes past your licence or your power limits. A program never turns TX on. Set at the station only.
chinese: 关闭：程序可调谐与读取，但绝不发射。开启：当 Nexus 处于语音屏幕时，程序可用其自身音频或电台麦克风触发电台，在 CW 屏幕发送 CW 宏，并调谐。其自身音频仅在它请求了语音模式（USB、LSB、AM 或 FM）后才发出。WSJT-X 与 JTDX 仅在模式与 Nexus 不同时才请求模式，因此当 Nexus 已在 USB 时设为 USB，它们请求无内容并被拒绝。Nexus 的所有发射安全措施仍然适用：Nexus 中 TX 必须开启，停止 TX 优先且保持，且任何内容都不会越过你的执照或功率限制。程序绝不会开启 TX。仅可在电台处设置。
do_not_translate: Stop TX | Nexus | TX | Tune | CW | WSJT-X | JTDX | USB | LSB | AM | FM
notes: "Stop TX" and "Tune" are the buttons' own names, English on purpose (the README).

english: FT8, FT4 and other slot-timed modes may not transmit through TCI yet. Nexus refuses a program's digital transmissions until the delay it adds to their timing has been measured.
chinese: FT8、FT4 及其他时隙定时模式尚可能无法通过 TCI 发射。在 Nexus 测量其给这些时序增加的延迟之前，会拒绝程序的数字化发射。
来自程序的 CW 宏

english: A logger's TCI keyer (Log4OM, 5MContest) sends its CW macros through Nexus, on the CW screen only, and only while programs may transmit. Any program can stop the CW.
chinese: 日志记录器的 TCI 键控器（Log4OM、5MContest）通过 Nexus 发送其 CW 宏，仅在 CW 屏幕，且仅在程序可发射期间。任何程序都能停止 CW。

english: Spots a program sends show on Nexus's band map and in the Phone and CW screens' band activity. A click on one only tunes Nexus, and a click on a spot in Nexus is passed back to the programs. A spot or a click never transmits.
chinese: 程序发送的点报显示在 Nexus 的频段地图以及语音和 CW 屏幕的频段活动中。点击其一仅调谐 Nexus，而点击 Nexus 中的点报会回传给程序。点报或点击绝不发射。

Beside a connected program: it is transmitting now. The same English text "Transmitting" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. status.tx.label, shell.tx.announce.on, settings.sstv.transmitting.title) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 公开广播 — 呼叫 CQ 启动台 + 频段推送。

english: Round-trips the QRZ Logbook API (ACTION=STATUS) — proves the key works without logging anything
chinese: 往返测试 QRZ Logbook API（ACTION=STATUS）— 在不记录任何内容的情况下证明密钥有效

chinese: ✗ QRZ 测试失败：{{detail}}（上传需要每个日志簿的 API 密钥，来自 logbook.qrz.com ▸ 设置 ▸ API — 而非你的 QRZ 密码。）

english: every save, sync, push, and failure lands here
chinese: 每次保存、同步、推送与失败都记录于此

english: No events yet this session — save a credential or run a sync and it shows here.
chinese: 本次会话尚无事件 — 保存凭据或运行同步后它会显示于此。

english: This log is kept at the station: read it in Settings there.
chinese: 此日志保存在电台处：在其中的设置中读取。

english: Off (the default, and WSJT-X’s): working a station on 40m marks them B4-on-band for 40m in every mode, and the log strip’s Dupe badge counts any mode on the band. On: 40m FT8 and 40m phone are separate contacts — the solid B4 chip and the Dupe badge require the mode to match as well. The hollow B4 chip (worked anywhere) is unaffected either way.
chinese: 关闭（默认，也是 WSJT-X 的）：在 40m 上通联某台电台，会在每种模式下将其标记为 40m 频段已通联，且日志条上的重复徽章计入该频段任意模式。开启：40m FT8 与 40m 语音是不同的联络 — 实心 B4 芯片与重复徽章也要求模式匹配。空心 B4 芯片（任何地方已通联）无论如何都不受影响。
本地 API 与日志记录器

english: for JTAlert / GridTracker / loggers — and FT8 contest scorers. Several at once: separate addresses with a comma.
chinese: 用于 JTAlert / GridTracker / 日志记录器 — 以及 FT8 竞赛计分器。可多个同时使用：用逗号分隔地址。

english: push each QSO to HRD Logbook over its QSO-Forwarding UDP port (HRD must be running; don't also run JTAlert/QSO Relay into HRD or you'll double-log)
chinese: 通过 HRD 的 QSO 转发 UDP 端口将每个 QSO 推送到 HRD Logbook（HRD 必须运行；不要同时让 JTAlert/QSO Relay 也写入 HRD，否则会重复记录）
HRD QSO 转发 host:port（默认 127.0.0.1:2333）
● 可访问 HRD — 联络正在转发

english: ○ HRD not reachable — {{count}} contact(s) queued, will send when HRD is back
chinese: ○ 无法访问 HRD — {{count}} 个联络已排队，HRD 恢复后将发送

english: Where Nexus listens for WSJT-X/JTDX in Companion source mode.
chinese: Nexus 在伴侣源模式下监听 WSJT-X/JTDX 的位置。
写入 ALL.TXT 解码日志

english: WSJT-X-format decode log for GridTracker / loggers to tail. Written only while this is on, and it first appears after the next decode.
chinese: 供 GridTracker / 日志记录器跟踪的 WSJT-X 格式解码日志。仅在此开启时写入，且首次出现在下次解码之后。

english: In JS8 it also writes DIRECTED.TXT beside it, as JS8Call does: every directed message heard.
chinese: 在 JS8 中，它还会像 JS8Call 那样在旁边写入 DIRECTED.TXT：每个听到的定向消息。
notes: Follows the ALL.TXT switch's help text: in JS8 the same switch also writes DIRECTED.TXT.

english: Save a WAV per logged QSO
chinese: 为每个已记录 QSO 保存一个 WAV

english: Auto-records the last ~60 s of RX audio on log.
chinese: 在记录时自动录制最近约 60 秒的 RX 音频。

english: Saved in {{path}}, created the first time you record.
chinese: 保存在 {{path}}，首次录制时创建。
保存接收音频（每个周期一个 .wav）

english: WAVs land in recordings/periods (12 kHz mono, ~360 KB each). "All" writes ~2 GB/day of continuous monitoring — use for decoder debugging, not always-on.
chinese: WAV 存入 recordings/periods（12 kHz 单声道，每个约 360 KB）。“全部”在连续监控下每天写入约 2 GB — 用于解码器调试，而非常开。

english: upload spots to the global map
chinese: 将点报上传到全球地图

english: While {{event}} runs, its rules allow spots only over amateur RF, so no reports are sent; they resume when it ends.
chinese: 当 {{event}} 运行时，其规则仅允许通过业余 RF 发送点报，因此不会上报；结束后恢复。
DX 集群 / RBN 点报

english: Surface "new ones" from the Reverse Beacon Network on the Needed board + Conditions. Takes effect on restart.
chinese: 在需求板 + Conditions 上凸显来自 Reverse Beacon Network 的“新目标”。重启后生效。

english: No nodes — add one below to get SSB/phone needs (RBN only carries CW + digital).
chinese: 无节点 — 在下方添加一个以获取 SSB/语音需求（RBN 仅承载 CW + 数字）。

english: We connect to ALL listed nodes and union their human SSB/phone spots — more nodes = wider phone coverage (RBN CW + digital connect automatically; RBN endpoints are ignored here). Nexus never changes this list for you. An added node connects, and a removed one disconnects, on the next Save.
chinese: 我们连接所有列出的节点并合并其人工 SSB/语音点报 — 节点越多，语音覆盖越广（RBN 的 CW + 数字自动连接；此处的 RBN 端点被忽略）。Nexus 绝不会为你更改此列表。添加的节点会在下次保存时连接，移除的节点会断开。
自动选择可用节点（推荐）

english: Nexus keeps two of these nodes connected for SSB/phone spots and spreads operators across them. A node that stops answering for five minutes, while your other spot feeds are working, is skipped for a day and another takes its place. A quiet band never counts against a node. RBN CW + digital connect automatically either way. Takes effect on the next Save.
chinese: Nexus 保持其中两个节点连接以获取 SSB/语音点报，并在它们之间分散操作员。某节点若停止应答达五分钟（而其他点报源正常），将被跳过一天，由另一节点取代。安静的频段绝不计入节点。RBN 的 CW + 数字无论哪种方式都自动连接。下次保存时生效。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Integrations. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word. The same English text "Connecting…" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. lanWindow.connecting) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Integrations. The same English text "Standby" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. amp.standby) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Added to your callsign at login (2 = W9XYZ-2). A node allows one session per callsign and drops the older one, so a second Nexus — or another cluster program on the same call — knocks this one off unless each uses a different SSID. 1-99, or leave it empty to log in with your bare call. Your spots still reach the network under your plain callsign. On a node that requires registration, register the suffixed call there too or it will not let you post spots. Takes effect on the next Save.
chinese: 在登录时添加到你的呼号（2 = W9XYZ-2）。一个节点每个呼号允许一个会话并丢弃较旧的那个，因此第二个 Nexus — 或同一呼号上的另一个集群程序 — 会把此会话踢掉，除非各自使用不同的 SSID。1–99，或留空以用裸呼号登录。你的点报仍以纯呼号到达网络。在需要注册的节点上，也需在那里注册带后缀的呼号，否则它不会让你发布点报。下次保存时生效。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Integrations. The same English text "Propagation" is used by 5 different keys (e.g. features.category.propagation, qso.detail.propMode, map.insights.pill) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Watch VHF/10 m activity near your QTH (not just your own contacts) so openings flag "open around you" before you've worked anyone. Takes effect on restart.
chinese: 监视你 QTH 附近的 VHF/10 米活动（不仅是你自己的联络），以便在通联任何人之前就标记“你周围开通”。重启后生效。

english: Log space weather on each contact
chinese: 为每个联络记录空间天气

english: Adds the planetary K index, A index and solar flux to every contact you log (ADIF K_INDEX, A_INDEX, SFI), from the latest reading Nexus fetched. Nothing is added when that reading is more than 3 hours old.
chinese: 为记录的每个联络添加行星 K 指数、A 指数和太阳通量（ADIF K_INDEX、A_INDEX、SFI），取自 Nexus 获取的最新读数。当该读数超过 3 小时则不添加。

english: Drives the per-station path outlook + 24h band×hour grid. P.533 is the real circuit-reliability method (validated against the ITU reference; ~0.1 s per prediction, uses your station power). Live spots always win over any model.
chinese: 驱动每电台路径展望 + 24 小时 频段×小时 网格。P.533 是真实的电路可靠性方法（对照 ITU 参考验证；每次预测约 0.1 秒，使用你的电台功率）。实时点报始终优先于任何模型。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ LoTW users. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

chinese: LoTW 列表已加载 — {{count}} 个呼号

english: Not fetched yet — decode lists gain an L mark on calls that upload to LoTW.
chinese: 尚未获取 — 解码列表会在上传到 LoTW 的呼号上显示 L 标记。

english: Count as a LoTW user if uploaded within (days)
chinese: 若在该天数内上传则计为 LoTW 用户

english: ARRL's activity list updates weekly — refetching more often just returns "unchanged". Manual fetch by design (WSJT-X convention).
chinese: ARRL 的活动列表每周更新 — 更频繁地重新获取只会返回“未改变”。按设计手动获取（WSJT-X 约定）。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Callsign state. The same English text "Update now" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.contestAids.update.action, settings.orbitalElements.update.action) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Callsign state. The same English text "Updating…" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.countryFile.update.busy, settings.orbitalElements.update.busy) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

{{count}} 个美国呼号 · 获取于 {{date}}

chinese: 尚未加载 — 首次启动时下载，之后每周自动刷新。

english: A callsign→state index (from the FCC license file) so a New State lights up on cluster / CW / SSB spots that carry no grid. Refreshed weekly from hamradiotools.io; a live decode grid refines it for rovers.
chinese: 呼号→州索引（来自 FCC 执照文件），以便在没有网格的集群 / CW / SSB 点报上点亮“新州”。每周从 hamradiotools.io 刷新；实时解码网格为漫游车细化它。

english: Island group names: © Islands On The Air (IOTA) Ltd and RSGB — iota-world.org
chinese: 岛屿群名称：© Islands On The Air (IOTA) Ltd 与 RSGB — iota-world.org

chinese: 无法下载 IOTA 岛屿列表

chinese: {{ref}} 不在 IOTA 岛屿列表上。

english: Kept in your log, but sent to no service until you confirm it on the contact card.
chinese: 保留在你的日志中，但在你在联络卡片上确认之前不发送至任何服务。

english: Filled from a spot: kept in your log, sent to no service until you confirm it.
chinese: 由点报填入：保留在你的日志中，在你确认之前不发送。

english: Filled from the callbook: kept in your log, sent to no service until you confirm it.
chinese: 由呼号簿填入：保留在你的日志中，在你确认之前不发送。

chinese: 显示 IOTA 岛屿名称

chinese: IOTA Ltd 的岛屿群列表（© RSGB 与 IOTA Ltd）经 IOTA Ltd 许可随 Nexus 提供，并在 iota-world.org 最多每月检查一次更新副本。它为岛屿群命名并标记非法的参考。关闭则不显示名称、停止检查并删除任何已下载副本。

english: {{count}} island groups · the copy shipped with Nexus ({{date}})
chinese: {{count}} 个岛屿群 · Nexus 随附副本（{{date}}）
