chinese: 关闭：参考仅按其格式（EU-131）检查。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Country file. The same English text "Updating…" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.callsignState.update.busy, settings.orbitalElements.update.busy) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Country file downloaded — AD1C {{ver}} applies at next launch.
chinese: 国家文件已下载 — AD1C {{ver}} 于下次启动时应用。

english: Country file is already current — AD1C {{ver}}.
chinese: 国家文件已是最新 — AD1C {{ver}}。
{{count}} 个实体 · AD1C {{ver}} · 获取于 {{date}}

english: Update downloaded (AD1C {{ver}}) — applies at next launch.
chinese: 更新已下载（AD1C {{ver}}）— 下次启动时应用。

english: The AD1C cty.dat country file maps callsigns to DXCC entities — the country on decode rows, the Needed board and the log. Checked weekly; a downloaded update applies at the next launch.
chinese: AD1C cty.dat 国家文件将呼号映射到 DXCC 实体 — 即解码行、需求板与日志上的国家。每周检查；下载的更新于下次启动时应用。

notes: Section heading on: Settings ▸ Appearance. The scopes are the spectrum displays in the Phone and CW cockpits.

english: The colours of the waterfalls and scopes: the same two settings as the pickers in the cockpits. Turbo is the default. Cividis looks almost the same to red-green colour-blind eyes as to everyone else.
chinese: 瀑布图与频谱的颜色：与驾驶舱中选择器相同的两项设置。Turbo 为默认。Cividis 在红绿色盲眼中和在其他人眼中看起来几乎相同。
notes: The line under the Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Waterfall & scopes heading. Turbo and Cividis are palette names.
Short label on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Waterfall & scopes: the palette picker those four modes share.

english: Shared by the scopes and waterfalls of those four modes.
chinese: 由这四种模式的频谱与瀑布图共享。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Waterfall & scopes: the FT waterfall's own palette picker.

english: The FT waterfall keeps a palette of its own.
chinese: FT 瀑布图保留自己的调色板。

notes: Section heading on: Settings ▸ Appearance: the Logbook's globe and the Conditions map.

english: The Conditions map’s view (globe, flat or beam), its layers and its colours are chosen on the map itself, and Conditions keeps a separate set for each activity you pick there.
chinese: Conditions 地图的视图（地球仪、平面或波束）、其图层与颜色在地图上自行选择，且 Conditions 为你在此处选择的每个活动保留一套独立设置。
notes: Globe, flat and beam are the map's view choices (map.projection.globe.label, map.projection.world.label, map.projection.beam.label): use the same words.
Section heading on: Settings ▸ Appearance.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Performance: whether the screen animates (fades, pulses). The same English text "Motion" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. aprs.card.motion.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Short control on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Performance ▸ Motion: use the computer's own reduce-motion setting.
One-word control on: Settings ▸ Appearance ▸ Performance ▸ Motion. A verb: reduce the motion (turn the animations off).

english: Reduce turns off the animations and fades, which also helps a slow computer keep up. Alerts still show; they just stop pulsing. Follow the computer uses your system’s own reduce-motion setting.
chinese: 减少会关闭动画与淡入淡出，这也有助于慢速电脑跟上。提醒仍会显示；只是停止脉动。跟随电脑使用你系统自身的减少动态设置。

english: Your logbook, the data tables Nexus downloads and the Winlink mailbox live in one folder. Keep it on a drive inside this computer. Nexus keeps your logbook in a database, and a database on a network drive can be damaged by the way file locking works across a network, so a network drive is refused. A synced folder (Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud, Google Drive) is allowed, but only ONE Nexus may use it at a time: two computers writing one logbook through a sync client make a conflicted copy, not a merged log.
chinese: 你的日志簿、Nexus 下载的数据表以及 Winlink 邮箱都位于一个文件夹中。请将其保留在本机的一个驱动器上。Nexus 将你的日志簿保存在数据库中，而网络驱动器上的数据库可能因跨网络的文件锁定方式而损坏，因此网络驱动器被拒绝。同步文件夹（Dropbox、OneDrive、iCloud、Google Drive）是允许的，但一次仅允许一个 Nexus 使用它：两台电脑通过同步客户端写入同一日志簿会产生冲突副本，而非合并日志。
do_not_translate: Google Drive | OneDrive | Dropbox | Winlink | iCloud | Nexus

english: This folder is on a network drive. Nexus keeps your logbook in a database, and a database on network storage can be damaged by the way file locking works across a network — the worst case is a logbook that will not open. Copy the folder to a drive inside this computer and point Nexus at the copy.
chinese: 此文件夹位于网络驱动器上。Nexus 将你的日志簿保存在数据库中，而网络存储上的数据库可能因跨网络的文件锁定方式而损坏 — 最坏情况是日志簿无法打开。将文件夹复制到本机的驱动器上，并将 Nexus 指向该副本。

english: This folder looks like it is synced by Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud or Google Drive. Only ONE Nexus may use it at a time — two computers writing one logbook through a sync client make a conflicted copy, not a merged log.
chinese: 此文件夹看起来由 Dropbox、OneDrive、iCloud 或 Google Drive 同步。一次仅允许一个 Nexus 使用它 — 两台电脑通过同步客户端写入同一日志簿会产生冲突副本，而非合并日志。

english: Set by NEXUS_DATA_DIR for this launch, which wins over this setting.
chinese: 由本次启动的 NEXUS_DATA_DIR 设置，优先于本设置。

english: Chosen: {{path}} — Nexus uses it the next time it starts.
chinese: 已选择：{{path}} — Nexus 下次启动时启用。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Config ▸ Data & log folder. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Pick the folder from your computer instead of typing the path. This only fills the box in — nothing changes until you choose one of the buttons below.
chinese: 从你的电脑选择文件夹，而非键入路径。这仅填入方框 — 在你选择下方按钮之一前不会改变任何内容。

english: Could not open the folder picker
chinese: 无法打开文件夹选择器

english: Use this folder from the next start. Nothing is copied, so the folder should already hold your log.
chinese: 从下次启动起使用此文件夹。不复制任何内容，因此该文件夹应已包含你的日志。

english: Not private — announced in the clear. Coordinated QSY steps you and one other station to a new channel together, with the move sent as plain text (FCC Part 97 forbids encryption / obscured meaning, and your callsign IDs every 10 min). It shakes a casual scanner parked on the old frequency — it does not hide you from anyone with a wideband receiver, who can follow. Use it for anti-QRM and modest obscurity, never for secrecy.
chinese: 并不保密 — 以明文公布。协同 QSY 会把你和另一个电台一起切换到新频道，切换信息以纯文本发送（FCC 第 97 部分禁止加密或隐晦含义，且你的呼号每 10 分钟发送一次）。它能甩掉停守在旧频率上的随意扫描者 — 但不能让持宽带接收机的人跟不到你。用于抗干扰和轻度隐蔽，绝不可用于保密。

english: {{source}} lists no {{band}} repeaters here, which is unusual for an area that has any — its rural coverage is patchy, so this list is probably missing machines. Adding a RepeaterBook API token in Settings ▸ Logging & Connectors ▸ Confirmations fills the gap.

english: RepeaterBook did not answer for {{states}}, so repeaters there are missing from this list. That is a fetch that failed, not an empty area — fetch again in a few minutes.
chinese: RepeaterBook 对 {{states}} 没有返回结果，因此这些地区的中继在本列表中缺失。这是获取失败，不是该区域为空 — 请过几分钟再获取一次。

english: The {{rsgb}} repeater list could not be read just now, so these are {{hearham}}'s machines alone. Fetch again later to add the coordinator's.
chinese: 刚刚无法读取 {{rsgb}} 中继列表，因此这里只有 {{hearham}} 自己的机器。稍后再次获取即可加入协调会的数据。
notes: RSGB is the UK national radio society, whose repeater list Repeaters reads for UK locations; hearham is another repeater directory. Both arrive as {{…}} slots.

english: The {{hearham}} repeater list could not be read just now, so its machines are missing from this list. Fetch again in a few minutes.
chinese: 刚刚无法读取 {{hearham}} 中继列表，因此它的机器在本列表中缺失。请过几分钟再获取一次。
notes: hearham is a repeater directory, the one Repeaters reads on every search, under RepeaterBook and RSGB; its name arrives as the {{hearham}} slot. Shown when its list could not be read, and in place of "No repeaters within …" when nothing is listed, because the area is then not known to be empty.

english: {{rsgb}} is asked about the locator squares nearest you, not every one this radius reaches, so the machines in {{squares}} are {{hearham}}'s alone.
chinese: {{rsgb}} 只按离你最近的定位网格查询，而非本半径覆盖的全部网格，因此 {{squares}} 内的机器仅来自 {{hearham}}。
notes: A locator square is a 4-character Maidenhead grid square (IO83). {{squares}} is a list of them.

english: {{rsgb}} is asked about the locator squares at the start of this route, not every one it crosses, so the machines in {{squares}} are {{hearham}}'s alone.
chinese: {{rsgb}} 只按本路线起点的定位网格查询，而非沿途全部网格，因此 {{squares}} 内的机器仅来自 {{hearham}}。
notes: As program.rsgb.beyond, for a long route: RSGB (the UK national society, whose repeater list Repeaters reads) is asked about the first nine locator squares the route reaches. A locator square is a 4-character Maidenhead grid square (IO83); {{squares}} is a list of them; hearham is another repeater directory.

english: {{rb}} is asked about the states at the start of this route, not every one it crosses, so the machines in {{states}} are {{hearham}}'s alone. Search the rest of the trip as a route of its own.
chinese: {{rb}} 只按本路线起点的州/省查询，而非沿途全部，因此 {{states}} 内的机器仅来自 {{hearham}}。可把行程其余部分作为另一条路线单独搜索。
notes: Note on a long route in Repeaters: RepeaterBook ({{rb}}, a repeater directory) is asked about the first nine US states the route reaches, and {{states}} lists the others as 2-letter codes (CO, NM). hearham is another directory. The last sentence suggests searching the rest of the trip as a second route.

notes: Tooltip on the line under a repeater that lists how it links to others over the internet. AllStar and IRLP are linking networks, a DMR ID is the repeater's number on a DMR network, and CC is the DMR color code; those names stay as they are.
A node number whose network the directory does not name, on the line under a repeater in Repeaters: {{node}} is the number (7230). A node as in a linking network's node.
Short label on: Repeaters (radio programming) view. A badge on a repeater whose directories disagree about its tone, input frequency, mode or colour code.

chinese: 各目录对该机器的记录不一致。本行按显示的第一个值编程；依赖前请核对其他值。

notes: {{used}} and {{others}} are a directory name with a value, e.g. "RSGB 88.5" (a CTCSS tone in Hz) and "hearham 82.5".

chinese: 已写入输入频率 {{used}}（另有列出：{{others}}）
notes: {{used}} and {{others}} are a directory name with a frequency in MHz, e.g. "RSGB 438.525". The input is the frequency you transmit on to reach the repeater.
{{used}} and {{others}} are a directory name with mode names, e.g. "RSGB FM+DMR".
The DMR color code. {{used}} and {{others}} are a directory name with a code, e.g. "RSGB CC1".

english: Armed, but no audio samples are arriving at all — the capture device is not delivering anything. Check that Input Device (RX) in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Audio is the radio (not a microphone or a disconnected device); what you hear on the speaker does not tell you what the app is capturing.

english: {{count}} bursts heard since arming, last one {{age}} ago — none passed the checksum. Some of that is normal: when the squelch opens partway through a burst the start of the packet is lost, and a part-heard packet can never pass. It is only a fault if nothing ever decodes — in which case check the rig is on {{channel}} in FM.{{advice}} Last burst peaked {{burst}}; live {{level}}.
chinese: 启用以来听到 {{count}} 个突发，最近一次在 {{age}} — 均未通过校验。其中一部分属正常：若静噪在突发中途打开，分组开头会丢失，残缺的分组永远无法通过。只有当从未解出任何内容时才算故障 — 那时请检查电台是否在 {{channel}} 且为 FM。{{advice}} 最近一次突发峰值为 {{burst}}；实时 {{level}}。

english: The burst is CLIPPING (peaked {{peak}}, {{samples}} sample(s) at the rails) — lower the rig's USB AF output level, or the Windows input level for that device. Packet survives a lot of clipping, so this costs headroom rather than decodes, but there is no reason to run into the rails.
chinese: 该突发正在削波（峰值 {{peak}}，有 {{samples}} 个样本顶到上限）— 请降低电台的 USB AF 输出电平，或降低该设备在 Windows 中的输入电平。分组能承受相当程度的削波，因此这损失的是余量而非解码率，但也没必要顶到上限。

english: The burst peaked {{peak}}, well below the healthy {{min}} to {{max}} band — raise the rig's USB AF output level (IC-9700: SET > Connectors > USB AF Output Level) or the Windows input level for that device. That buys margin against noise; it is not by itself why a checksum fails.
chinese: 该突发峰值为 {{peak}}，远低于健康区间 {{min}} 至 {{max}} — 请提高电台的 USB AF 输出电平（IC-9700：SET > Connectors > USB AF Output Level）或该设备在 Windows 中的输入电平。这能留出抗噪余量；但它本身并不是校验失败的原因。

english: Keep the rig's ALC near zero — an overdriven PSK31 signal splatters (IMD). Lower TX audio until the ALC meter barely moves.
chinese: 让电台 ALC 保持在接近零的位置 — 过驱的 PSK31 信号会产生杂散（IMD）。降低发射音频，直到 ALC 表几乎不动。

english: PSK31 is an amplitude-shaped mode: if the rig's ALC is compressing, the signal splatters into the neighbors (IMD). Nexus keys at a modest drive by default — set TX audio / power so the rig's ALC meter barely moves.
chinese: PSK31 是幅度成形模式：若电台 ALC 在压缩，信号就会溅到邻频（IMD）。Nexus 默认以适中的驱动力发射 — 请调整发射音频/功率，使电台 ALC 表几乎不动。

The divider between the first two columns of the JS8 cockpit when it shows three: RX and Stations. It is dragged, or moved with the arrow keys, to share the width between them. Screen readers read it aloud; the two names are the JS8 panes’ own (js8.panel.activity, js8.panel.stations).

The divider between the JS8 cockpit’s two decode panes, RX above and Band activity below, dragged, or moved with the arrow keys, to share the height between them. Screen readers read it aloud; the two names are the panes’ own (js8.panel.activity, js8.panel.offsets).

The name of the divider under the JS8 cockpit's waterfall, which is dragged, or moved with the arrow keys, to make the waterfall taller or shorter. english: Repeating CQ is off. Click to call CQ every {{min}} min until someone answers — the button counts down to the next one. It keys only while TX is on, and it is never remembered across launches.
chinese: 循环 CQ 已关闭。点击可每 {{min}} 分钟呼叫一次 CQ，直到有人应答 — 按钮会倒计时到下一次。仅在发射开启时才会发射，且不会跨启动记住。

english: Repeating CQ is on, but TX is off — nothing keys. Enable TX (the header pill) to let the CQs go out.
chinese: 循环 CQ 已开启，但发射已关闭 — 不会发射。启用发射（顶栏胶囊）后 CQ 才会发出。

english: Calling CQ every {{min}} min, on your TX offset. Stops on its own when a station answers you, or at the idle watchdog. Click to stop the schedule — a CQ already on the air finishes; Stop TX cuts it.
chinese: 正按你的发射偏移每 {{min}} 分钟呼叫 CQ。有台站应答或触发空闲看门狗时会自动停止。点击可停止该计划 — 已在空中的 CQ 会发完；“停止发射”可立即切断。
notes: "Stop TX" is the button's own name, English on purpose (the README).

english: Repeating CQ is on, but no CQ is scheduled: the interval was 0 when the last one went. Turn it off and on to call again.
chinese: 循环 CQ 已开启，但没有排定的 CQ：上次发出时间隔为 0。请关闭再开启以重新呼叫。

notes: Short label on: JS8 cockpit — the message dock. The same English text "now" is used by 5 different keys (e.g. roster.card.heard.now, operate.roster.age.now, waterfall.paused.now) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Heartbeat schedule is off. Click to send a heartbeat every period’s interval (Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8) — it keys only while TX is on, and it is never remembered across launches.
chinese: 心跳计划已关闭。点击可按周期间隔发送心跳（设置 ▸ 数字 ▸ JS8）— 仅在发射开启时才会发射，且不会跨启动记住。

english: Heartbeat schedule is on, but TX is off — nothing keys. Enable TX (the header pill) to let heartbeats go out.
chinese: 心跳计划已开启，但发射已关闭 — 不会发射。启用发射（顶栏胶囊）后心跳才会发出。

english: Heartbeats are going out on schedule, on a random free slot between 500 and 1000 Hz. Click to stop the schedule.
chinese: 心跳正按计划发出，占用 500 至 1000 Hz 之间的随机空闲时隙。点击可停止该计划。

english: HB is on, but no heartbeat of yours is scheduled: with the interval at 0 (Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8), HB sends one when it is turned on, and that one has gone. Turn HB off and on, or use Send heartbeat now on its menu, for another.
chinese: HB 已开启，但没有排定的心跳：间隔为 0 时（设置 ▸ 数字 ▸ JS8），HB 开启时会发送一次，而那次已经发出。请关闭再开启 HB，或使用其菜单中的“立即发送心跳”再发一次。

english: The heartbeat repeat is paused while a call is in the To box (the QSO pause, Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8). Clear the To box and it starts again, its first heartbeat one interval later.
chinese: 收件框中存在呼号时，心跳重复会暂停（QSO 暂停，设置 ▸ 数字 ▸ JS8）。清空收件框后它会重新开始，首个心跳在一个间隔之后。
notes: Tooltip on the JS8 dock’s HB button while the heartbeat repeat is paused because a call is in the To box, the dock’s addressee field. HB is the heartbeat button.
Accessible name of the small ▾ button beside HB in the JS8 dock that opens the heartbeat menu.

english: Heartbeat menu: send one now, or start or stop the repeat. Right-clicking HB opens it too.
chinese: 心跳菜单：立即发送一次，或启动/停止重复。右键点击 HB 也可打开。

notes: Menu item that starts the repeating heartbeat, in JS8Call’s own words.
Menu item that stops the repeating heartbeat.

english: Heartbeat networking is off, as JS8Call ships it: no HB button, no heartbeats and no heartbeat acknowledgements. Click to turn it on (remembered). It sends nothing by itself.
chinese: 心跳组网已关闭，与 JS8Call 出厂默认一致：没有 HB 按钮，不发心跳，也不做心跳确认。点击开启（会被记住）。它本身不会发送任何内容。
notes: Tooltip on the HB NET chip, JS8Call’s heartbeat networking switch. HB NET stays as it is.

english: Heartbeat networking is on: HB sends your heartbeats, and HB ACK may answer the heartbeats you hear. Click to turn it off (remembered); a running heartbeat repeat stops.
chinese: 心跳组网已开启：HB 会发送你的心跳，HB ACK 可能会应答你听到的心跳。点击关闭（会被记住）；正在运行的心跳重复会停止。

english: No heartbeats at {{speed}}: JS8Call sends heartbeats and their acknowledgements only at Slow, Normal and Fast. HB is hidden until you change speed, and this switch keeps its setting.
chinese: 在 {{speed}} 速率下不发送心跳：JS8Call 仅在 Slow、Normal 和 Fast 下发送心跳及其确认。在你更改速率之前 HB 会隐藏，而此开关会保留其设置。
notes: {{speed}} is a JS8 speed name (Turbo). Slow, Normal and Fast are JS8 speed names and stay as they are.

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but none goes out at {{speed}}: JS8Call answers heartbeats only at Slow, Normal and Fast.
chinese: 心跳确认已开启，但在 {{speed}} 速率下不会发出：JS8Call 仅在 Slow、Normal 和 Fast 下应答心跳。
notes: {{speed}} is a JS8 speed name (Turbo).

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but held back now: a message is still arriving, as in JS8Call.
chinese: 心跳确认已开启，但当前被暂缓：仍有消息正在接收，与 JS8Call 一致。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but held back now: a call is in the To box (the QSO pause, Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8). Clear the To box to answer heartbeats again.
chinese: 心跳确认已开启，但当前被暂缓：收件框中存在呼号（QSO 暂停，设置 ▸ 数字 ▸ JS8）。清空收件框即可重新应答心跳。
notes: The To box is the JS8 dock’s addressee field.

english: Not answering these stations, which heartbeat more often than every 55 minutes: {{calls}}.
chinese: 正在忽略以下台站的心跳，因为它们的心跳间隔短于 55 分钟：{{calls}}。
notes: {{calls}} is a list of callsigns.

chinese: 这需要占用多少周期的空口时间（每周期一帧）。仅为估算 — 引擎会实际打包，并拒绝任何超过十分钟空口时长的内容。

english: Auto-reply is off — an answer to SNR?, GRID?, INFO? or STATUS? to you, an ACK for a MSG or a relay is put in the message box for you to send, as JS8Call does, and nothing keys by itself; QUERY MSGS goes unanswered. Click to turn it on (remembered). It answers only while TX is on.
chinese: 自动回复已关闭 — 发给你的 SNR?、GRID?、INFO? 或 STATUS? 的答复，以及对 MSG 或中继的 ACK，会放入消息框由你自行发送，与 JS8Call 一致，绝不自行发射；QUERY MSGS 不会得到应答。点击开启（会被记住）。仅在发射开启时才会应答。
do_not_translate: SNR? | GRID? | INFO? | STATUS? | ACK | MSG | QUERY MSGS | JS8Call | TX
notes: Tooltip on the JS8 cockpit's AUTOREPLY chip while it is off. The capitalised words are JS8 command words and are not translated. The message box is the JS8 cockpit's text field where you type a message (js8.dock.compose.aria).

english: Auto-reply is on, but TX is off — nothing keys; a reply is shown as “would have replied”. Enable TX (the header pill) to let replies go out.
chinese: 自动回复已开启，但发射已关闭 — 不会发射；回复会显示为“本应回复”。启用发射（顶栏胶囊）后回复才会发出。

english: Auto-reply is ARMED: SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, QUERY and MSG addressed to you or a group you joined are answered, each after your Yes when Settings asks for one. Click to turn it off.
chinese: 自动回复已就绪：发给你的、或发给你加入的组的 SNR?、GRID?、INFO?、QUERY 和 MSG 都会得到应答，若设置在询问时要求确认，则在你说“是”之后回复。点击关闭。
notes: Tooltip on the JS8 cockpit's AUTOREPLY chip while it is on and TX is on: the automatic replies will really go out. SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, QUERY and MSG are JS8 command words and are not translated.

english: Relay is off — a > message routed through you is displayed and not passed on. Click to turn it on (remembered). Relaying is third-party traffic; you are responsible for it.
chinese: 中继已关闭 — 经你转发的 > 消息只显示，不再传递。点击开启（会被记住）。中继属于第三方信息，你需对其负责。

english: Relay is on, but TX is off — nothing keys. Enable TX (the header pill) to relay.
chinese: 中继已开启，但发射已关闭 — 不会发射。启用发射（顶栏胶囊）后方可中继。

english: Relay is ARMED: a > message routed through you is retransmitted with *DE* your call, and the final hop is acknowledged. With Auto-reply off, it is put in the message box for you to send instead. Click to turn it off.
chinese: 中继已就绪：经你转发的 > 消息会以 *DE* 你的呼号 重新发送，最后一跳会被确认。若自动回复关闭，则改为放入消息框由你发送。点击关闭。
notes: Tooltip on the JS8 cockpit's RELAY chip while it is on and TX is on. > is how a JS8 message is routed through another station; *DE* is a JS8 word and is not translated. Auto-reply is the AUTOREPLY chip.

english: Relay is on, but with AUTOREPLY off a relay is put in the message box for you to send, and nothing keys by itself. Turn AUTOREPLY on to relay on the air.
chinese: 中继已开启，但自动回复关闭时，转发的消息会放入消息框由你发送，绝不自行发射。开启自动回复才能在空口上中继。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are off (JS8Call’s default). Click to answer heartbeats with HEARTBEAT SNR (remembered). Answers only while TX is on.
chinese: 心跳确认已关闭（JS8Call 的默认设置）。点击可用 HEARTBEAT SNR 应答心跳（会被记住）。仅在发射开启时才会应答。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but TX is off — nothing keys. Enable TX (the header pill).
chinese: 心跳确认已开启，但发射已关闭 — 不会发射。请启用发射（顶栏胶囊）。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are ARMED: each heartbeat heard is answered with HEARTBEAT SNR on a random free slot. Click to turn it off.
chinese: 心跳确认已就绪：每听到一次心跳，就在随机空闲时隙用 HEARTBEAT SNR 应答。点击关闭。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but they answer only while heartbeat networking (HB NET) is on, as in JS8Call. HB NET sends nothing by itself.
chinese: 心跳确认已开启，但与 JS8Call 一致，只有在心跳组网（HB NET）开启时才会应答。HB NET 本身不发送任何内容。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but they answer only while AUTOREPLY is on, as in JS8Call. Turn AUTOREPLY on.
chinese: 心跳确认已开启，但与 JS8Call 一致，只有在自动回复开启时才会应答。请开启自动回复。

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but they answer only while heartbeat networking (HB NET) and AUTOREPLY are both on, as in JS8Call. HB NET sends nothing by itself.
chinese: 心跳确认已开启，但与 JS8Call 一致，只有心跳组网（HB NET）和自动回复同时开启时才会应答。HB NET 本身不发送任何内容。

english: Two acts, where JS8Call has one: this switch is the second, the header’s TX pill is the first, and the chip reads ARMED only while both are on.
chinese: JS8Call 一步完成的事，这里分两步：该开关是第二步，顶栏的发射胶囊是第一步，只有两者都开启时才会显示“已就绪”。

english: Not armed: nothing from you for {{min}} min, so the idle watchdog holds it. Your next send, switch, speed choice, or Read or Delete in the Inbox brings it back.
chinese: 未就绪：你已 {{min}} 分钟无操作，空闲看门狗将其挂起。下一次发送、切换开关、更改速率，或在收件箱中读取/删除，都会恢复它。

english: Would reply to {{to}} — TX is off, nothing keys: {{text}}
chinese: 本应回复 {{to}} — 但发射已关闭，不会发射：{{text}}

english: JS8 idle watchdog: no operator activity for {{min}} min — HB, AUTOREPLY, RELAY, HB ACK and the repeating CQ are off. TX stays as you left it. Your next send, switch, speed choice, or Read or Delete in the Inbox brings back AUTOREPLY, RELAY and HB ACK as Settings has them; HB and the repeating CQ stay off until you switch them on.
chinese: JS8 空闲看门狗：操作员已 {{min}} 分钟无操作 — HB、AUTOREPLY、RELAY、HB ACK 和循环 CQ 均已关闭。发射状态保持你离开时的样子。下一次发送、切换开关、更改速率，或在收件箱中读取/删除，会按设置恢复 AUTOREPLY、RELAY 和 HB ACK；HB 和循环 CQ 需你手动开启。
do_not_translate: JS8 | {{min}} | HB | AUTOREPLY | RELAY | HB ACK | CQ | TX
notes: The notice when the JS8 idle watchdog trips. HB, AUTOREPLY, RELAY, HB ACK and CQ are the labels on the dock's switches and are not translated. Read and Delete are the two buttons on a message in the JS8 Inbox; Settings is the Settings screen.

english: A transmission is queued for autoreply: {{text}} — would you like to send this transmission?
chinese: 有一条自动回复的发射已排队：{{text}} — 是否发送？
notes: In the JS8 cockpit's dock, when an automatic reply waits for your answer: JS8Call's own question (its Autoreply Confirmation box). {{text}} is the reply exactly as it will be sent, for example KD9TAW: W1AW SNR -07.

The button that answers js8.dock.confirm: send the automatic reply. The same English text "Yes" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. qso.detail.qsl.yes, js8.pill.cmd.yes) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Send it: it goes out in the next period, through every TX check.
chinese: 发送：它将在下一周期发出，并通过全部发射检查。
notes: Tooltip on the Yes button of the automatic-reply question in the JS8 cockpit. TX is not translated.
The button that answers js8.dock.confirm: do not send it. {{secs}} counts down the seconds until it answers No by itself, as JS8Call's box does.

english: Do not send it. With no answer it is No when the count reaches 0, as in JS8Call.
chinese: 不发送。与 JS8Call 一致，倒计时归零仍无应答即视为“否”。
notes: Tooltip on the No button of the automatic-reply question.

english: Queued frames — one leaves per period while TX is on. F/L mark the first and last frame of a message.
chinese: 已排队的帧 — 发射开启时每个周期发出一帧。F/L 标记一条消息的首帧和末帧。

english: Drop every queued frame. Not a stop: a frame already on the air finishes — Stop TX cuts it.
chinese: 丢弃所有已排队的帧。这不是停止：已在空中的帧仍会发完 —“停止发射”可直接切断。
notes: "Stop TX" is the button's own name, English on purpose (the README).

One-word control on: JS8 cockpit — the message dock. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word. The same English text "you" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. qso.history.source.operator) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Where a queued frame came from: a JS8 heartbeat, the automatic "I am here" frame (JS8Call's HEARTBEAT).
Where a queued frame came from: the answer to another station's heartbeat (sent as HEARTBEAT SNR).
One-word control on: JS8 cockpit — the message dock. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.
One-word control on: JS8 cockpit — the message dock. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.
Where a queued frame came from: an APRS message from the internet, relayed over JS8 to a station heard on the air.

english: Idle watchdog tripped — your next send or switch brings back AUTOREPLY, RELAY and HB ACK; HB and the repeating CQ stay off until you switch them on
chinese: 空闲看门狗已触发 — 下次发送或切换会恢复 AUTOREPLY、RELAY 和 HB ACK；HB 和循环 CQ 需你手动开启
do_not_translate: AUTOREPLY | RELAY | HB ACK | HB | CQ
notes: The line in the JS8 cockpit's dock while the idle watchdog has tripped. AUTOREPLY, RELAY, HB ACK, HB and CQ are the labels on the dock's switches and are not translated; the repeating CQ is the CQ button set to call again and again.

english: Set your callsign in Settings before transmitting
chinese: 发射前请在设置中填写你的呼号
notes: The same English text "Set your callsign in Settings before transmitting" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. rtty.send.noCallsign, psk.send.noCallsign) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
A short notice after “Save current message” in the JS8 dock’s Saved menu. {{text}} is the saved message.

english: The message could not be saved
notes: A short notice after “Save current message” in the JS8 dock’s Saved menu. {{text}} is the saved message.

english: TX locked — this frequency is outside your license privileges
chinese: 发射已锁定 — 该频率超出你的执照权限
notes: The same English text "TX locked — this frequency is outside your license privileges" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. rtty.send.txLocked, psk.send.txLocked, cw.send.txLocked) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: A command needs a station — put a callsign, @ALLCALL or a group in To
chinese: 命令需要指定台站 — 请在收件框中填入呼号、@ALLCALL 或组名

notes: A short error notice: your Yes or No to an automatic reply did not reach the station (or that reply was no longer waiting).

english: What JS8Call shows in its RX pane: the traffic on your RX offset and what is addressed to you or your groups, each message on one line as its frames arrive, the end mark after its last frame and the missing-frame mark where one did not come. Every frame of every offset is in Band activity.
chinese: JS8Call 在其 RX 面板显示的内容：你的接收偏移上的通信，以及发给你的或你所在组的内容，每条消息随帧到达而占一行，末帧后显示结束标记，缺失帧处显示缺失标记。每个偏移的所有帧都可在“波段活跃度”中查看。

english: Listening… what is sent on your RX offset, and what is addressed to you, prints here
chinese: 监听中… 在你接收偏移上发出的内容，以及发给你的内容，都会打印在这里

notes: Tooltip on a line of the JS8 RX pane that opens with a callsign. {{call}} is that callsign; a double-click puts it in the To box.

english: One row per frequency offset in the passband, holding the frames heard there with the end mark after each message: its age, SNR, time delta and speed come from the newest. Read it to find a clear offset and to see who is in sync. Columns and order are in ⋯.
chinese: 通带内每个频率偏移占一行，保存该处收到的帧及每条消息后的结束标记：其时龄、SNR、时间差和速率取自最新的一帧。可用它寻找空闲偏移，并查看谁已同步。列与排序在 ⋯ 中。

notes: Column heading in the JS8 Band activity table: the text heard at that offset (one or several messages).
Accessible name of the ⋯ button that opens one Band activity row’s menu. {{offset}} is the audio offset in Hz.

Column heading in the JS8 lists: the audio offset of a signal, in Hz. The same English text "Offset" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. memories.grid.column.offset, memories.editor.offset.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 lists: how long ago a station or offset was last heard. The same English text "Age" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. spots.column.age, operate.roster.col.age, aprs.table.age) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 lists: the signal report in dB. The same English text "SNR" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.col.snr) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 lists: how far a station is off the period clock, in milliseconds. The same English text "Time delta" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.col.tdrift) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 lists: the JS8 speed (Slow, Normal, Fast, Turbo) a station sends at. The same English text "Speed" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. js8.view.col.submode, cw.wpm.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Accessible name of the JS8 call list’s first column, which holds one symbol per station (✕ ⚑ ★ ☎ ⚟).

Column heading in the JS8 call list, with the number of stations listed. Plural form "one" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101.

Column heading in the JS8 call list, with the number of stations listed. Plural form "other" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101. Plural form "few" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101.

Column heading in the JS8 call list, with the number of stations listed. Plural form "other" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101. Plural form "many" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101.

Column heading in the JS8 call list, with the number of stations listed. Plural form "other" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101.

Column heading in the JS8 call list: the Maidenhead grid square. The same English text "Grid" is used by 10 different keys (e.g. settings.station.grid.label, logEntry.grid.placeholder, logEntry.fd.grid.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 call list. The same English text "Distance" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. js8.view.col.distance, contestStats.distance.head) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 call list: the operator’s name from your log. The same English text "Name" is used by 9 different keys (e.g. logEntry.name.placeholder, logbook.field.name.label, logbook.filters.name) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 call list: the comment from your log. The same English text "Comment" is used by 7 different keys (e.g. logPrompt.comment.label, logbook.field.comment.label, spots.column.comment) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Accessible name of the call list column with the one-click query buttons (SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, HEARING?, QUERY MSGS).
Accessible name of the column of ⋯ buttons, one per row, that open each row’s menu.
Accessible name of the ⋯ button that opens one station’s menu in the JS8 call list. {{call}} is its callsign.

english: Blocked: messages from this station are hidden in the RX pane (Settings ▸ JS8)
chinese: 已屏蔽：该台站的消息在接收面板中隐藏（设置 ▸ JS8）
正听到你的台站（{{since}} 前）
notes: Tooltip on ★ in the JS8 call list: the station sent something to your callsign, so it hears you. {{since}} is how long ago, e.g. 4m.
Tooltip on ☎ in the JS8 call list: the station called CQ. {{since}} is how long ago, e.g. 2m.
Tooltip on ⚟ in the JS8 call list: the station was named in a message relayed to you. {{through}} is the relaying station’s callsign.

english: Unread message for {{group}}, in the Inbox
chinese: 发给 {{group}} 的未读消息，位于收件箱
notes: Tooltip on ⚑ beside a @GROUP in the JS8 call list. {{group}} is the group, e.g. @FUN. Inbox is the JS8 pane that lists messages.
Field label in the JS8 dialog that adds a station (a callsign) or joins a group (a name starting with @).

The same English text "Add" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. watchlist.add.submit, settings.js8.freqs.add.action, settings.js8.saved.add) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Cancel" is used by 30 different keys (e.g. logEntry.sent.moved.cancel, logbook.import.preview.cancel, logbook.parkStates.cancel) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: {{name}} is not a valid callsign or group
chinese: {{name}} 不是有效的呼号或组名
notes: Error under the field when the text is neither a callsign nor a @GROUP. {{name}} is what was typed.
Error under the field when a name starting with @ is not a valid group. {{name}} is what was typed.
Accessible name of a JS8 pane’s ⋯ button, which opens its view options. {{pane}} is the pane’s name.
Submenu in a JS8 list’s ⋯ menu, listing the orders the list can take.
Submenu in a JS8 list’s ⋯ menu, listing the columns that can be shown.
A switch in the Band activity ⋯ menu that shows or hides heartbeat frames and their acknowledgements.
The same English text "Frequency offset" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.col.offset) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Callsign" is used by 7 different keys (e.g. settings.station.callsign.label, gettingStarted.station.shot.callsignLabel, setup.station.callsign.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
A sort order of the JS8 call list: the stations that sent something to you, most recent first.
The same English text "Azimuth" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.col.azimuth) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Frequency offset" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.sort.offset) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "SNR" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.col.snr) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Grid" is used by 10 different keys (e.g. settings.station.grid.label, logEntry.grid.placeholder, logEntry.fd.grid.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Distance" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. js8.calls.col.distance, contestStats.distance.head) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Azimuth" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.sort.azimuth) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

A column name in the call list’s Show columns menu: the ✓ for a station already in your log. The same English text "Worked before" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. operate.decodes.filter.title.b4) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Menu entry that empties one JS8 list (the RX pane, Band activity or the call list). The same English text "Clear" is used by 16 different keys (e.g. logEntry.clear.label, logbook.search.clear, logbook.tools.bulk.clear) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 清空所有 JS8 活动？

english: The RX pane, Band activity and the call list start empty and fill again as stations are heard, and the compose box is emptied, as in JS8Call. Your Inbox, your settings and the station’s own record of who it heard are kept.
chinese: 接收面板、波段活跃度和通联列表会清空，并在听到台站后重新填充，输入框也会清空，与 JS8Call 一致。你的收件箱、设置以及台站自身记录的通联历史都会保留。

notes: Menu entry: move your receive and transmit audio offsets to this one. {{offset}} is in Hz.
Menu entry: switch your JS8 transmit speed to this station’s. {{speed}} is a speed name (Slow, Normal, Fast, Turbo).
Menu entry on a Band activity row: take that offset’s row off the list until it is heard again.
Menu entry on a call list row: keep that station at the top of the list.
Menu entry on a pinned call list row: let it go back into the list’s order.

english: The JS8 list was not saved

notes: Button on the new-message notice that opens the Inbox at that station’s messages. The same English text "Show" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. program.filters.show.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Accessible name of the Inbox’s row of controls (station filter, Reply, Delete). The same English text "Inbox" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.panel.inbox) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Label before the Inbox’s station filter (All, or one callsign).

The station filter’s choice that shows every station’s messages. The same English text "All" is used by 10 different keys (e.g. roster.filter.all, needed.filter.all, operate.decodes.filter.all) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Button in the JS8 Inbox. The same English text "Reply" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. sstv.tx.overlay.reply.label, cw.macro.reply.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Put the path the message came by, MSG and [MESSAGE] in the compose box, as JS8Call does: type your message over [MESSAGE] and send it. Nothing is sent yet.
chinese: 把消息来路、MSG 和 [MESSAGE] 填入输入框，与 JS8Call 一致：在 [MESSAGE] 上写出你的回复并发送。此时尚未发送任何内容。

notes: Button in the JS8 Inbox that deletes the ticked messages; {{count}} is how many. english: Delete the ticked messages (or press Delete)
chinese: 删除已勾选的消息（或按 Delete 键）
按 {{column}} 排序（再次点击反向）
notes: Tooltip on an Inbox column heading. {{column}} is the heading’s name.
Accessible name of the Inbox column of tick boxes.
Accessible name of the Inbox column that shows ⚑ for an unread message.
The same English text "Time" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. operate.decodes.sort.time, fieldDay.log.column.time) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Inbox column heading: who sent the message (and the relays it came through). The same English text "From" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. program.route.from, aprs.table.from) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Inbox column heading: who the message is addressed to. The same English text "To" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. program.route.to, aprs.msg.to.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Message" is used by 5 different keys (e.g. aprs.msg.title, rtty.macroEditor.message.label, psk.macroEditor.message.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 选择 {{from}} 于 {{time}} 发来的消息
notes: Accessible name of a message’s tick box. {{from}} is the sender’s callsign, {{time}} when it arrived (HH:MM:SS).

The same English text "Off" is used by 17 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.contrast.off, settings.workspace.night.off, settings.workspace.field.off) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Dist" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. operate.roster.col.dist, aprs.table.dist) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: iPhone HEIC photos can't be read here — Nexus has no HEVC decoder. On the iPhone: Settings → Camera → Formats → Most Compatible (new photos are JPEG), or Settings → Photos → Transfer to Mac or PC → Automatic (converts on send). Then re-send this picture.
chinese: iPhone 的 HEIC 照片无法在此读取 — Nexus 没有 HEVC 解码器。请在 iPhone 上操作：设置 → 相机 → 格式 → 兼容性最佳（新照片即为 JPEG），或 设置 → 照片 → 传输到 Mac 或 PC → 自动（发送时转换）。然后重新发送这张图片。

english: That is an AVIF file. SSTV sends JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP or GIF — export or save-as one of those.
chinese: 这是 AVIF 文件。SSTV 可发送 JPEG、PNG、WebP、BMP 或 GIF — 请导出或另存为其中一种。

english: That is a TIFF file. SSTV sends JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP or GIF — export or save-as one of those.
chinese: 这是 TIFF 文件。SSTV 可发送 JPEG、PNG、WebP、BMP 或 GIF — 请导出或另存为其中一种。

english: That is a camera RAW file. SSTV sends JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP or GIF — export a JPEG from it first.
chinese: 这是相机 RAW 文件。SSTV 可发送 JPEG、PNG、WebP、BMP 或 GIF — 请先从中导出 JPEG。

chinese: 已收到音频，但还没有 SSTV 报头 — 图像开始时会自动解码。{{where}}

chinese: 无法读取接收机状态 — 应用没有响应。解码器可能仍在运行。

english: Start decoding now in the mode chosen beside this, without waiting for a header. Arms the receiver if it is off. Receive only — this never transmits.
chinese: 立即以旁边所选模式开始解码，无需等待报头。若接收机未启用会自动启用。仅接收 — 绝不发射。

english: RF output power — set it against a Tune carrier, below ALC
chinese: 射频输出功率 — 在调谐载波下设置，保持在 ALC 以下

english: Detected SSTV mode — fills in (Martin / Scottie / Robot / PD) when the receiver hears a VIS header

english: Showing the rig's current band — SSTV decodes wherever you're tuned
chinese: 显示电台当前波段 — 你在哪个频率上，SSTV 就在哪里解码

notes: One-word control on: SSTV view. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

chinese: 倾斜校正 — 精细的采样时钟修正。解码器会自动校正；手动微调将在后续版本提供。

chinese: SSTV 倾斜校正（已禁用 — 解码器尚未接入）

chinese: 发射预览，{{w}}×{{h}}。拖动或使用方向键选择要发送的图像区域（上下）；Home 键回到居中。{{overlays}}

chinese: 点击文字叠加层可选中它；方向键移动，Delete 删除。

chinese: 把图像拖到这里，或在下方选择 — 任意尺寸，会自动缩放以适配所选模式。

chinese: 未设置呼号 — SSTV 通过把呼号烧入图像来标识，因此没有呼号将无法发射。

chinese: 已是 {{w}}×{{h}} — 逐像素发送，无需裁切。

chinese: 正在发送第一帧 — SSTV 只发送一张静态图像。

chinese: 该文件不是 Nexus 可读取的图像（其开头为 {{magic}}）。

chinese: 该图像已损坏，只能部分解码 — Nexus 不会发送半幅图像。请尝试重新导出。

chinese: 这是 {{w}}×{{h}} 的图像（{{mp}} 百万像素）— 过大，无法处理。请导出一份较小的副本；宽度超过约 4000 像素已远超 SSTV 能发送的范围。

chinese: 输入要发送的 CW 内容…（Enter）

english: The station you are working. The ! in a macro sends this call. A decoded call fills it in; type over it to answer someone else, then press Enter or a macro key.
chinese: 你正在通联的台站。宏中的 ! 会发送此呼号。解出的呼号会自动填入；要回应别人时直接改写，然后按 Enter 或宏键。
notes: "Enter" is the key on the keyboard. "!" is the character typed in a macro to send this call.

english: TX locked — this frequency is outside your license privileges
chinese: 发射已锁定 — 该频率超出你的执照权限

english: CW speed match: an answer to a station (your call, your exchange) is sent at the speed Nexus measured for that station, within the slowest and fastest set in Settings ▸ CW. A CQ is sent at your own speed, and so is everything once the answer has gone. Without a recent measurement of the station you are working, your own speed.
chinese: CW 速度匹配：对某台站的应答（你的呼号、你的交换信息）按 Nexus 为对方测得的速度发送，并限制在 设置 ▸ CW 的最慢与最快之间。CQ 按你自己的速度发送，应答发出之后的内容也一样。若没有该台站的近期测速记录，则用你自己的速度。

english: CW speed match was not saved, so the switch is as it was.
chinese: CW 速度匹配未能保存，开关保持原状。

english: Whose turn it is, read from the decoder's copy. It never sends: you press the key.
chinese: 轮到谁，依据解码器的抄收判断。它绝不发送：按键由你按下。
notes: Tooltip of the turn lamp on the CW cockpit.
Read by a screen reader on the F-key the turn lamp lights.
The Enter key's name, as in Enter Sends Message (settings.contestKeys.legend): the lamp says "Your turn · Enter" while that runs.

Turn lamp, CW cockpit: nothing heard lately. The same English text "Listening" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. aprs.health.listening.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Turn lamp: the other station is sending.
Turn lamp: the other station is sending, its call not copied.
Turn lamp: the other station's over has just ended; the turn is about to be yours.
Turn lamp: your turn to send; {{key}} is the F-key that fits (F2, F3…) or Enter.
Turn lamp: your turn, and no F-key fits (a ragchew): type your over.

chinese: 大概轮到你 · 按一次 {{key}}
notes: Turn lamp: the other station sent part of a call that matches yours ("KD9?"); send your call once with {{key}}.
Turn lamp: do not send; the over was for {{call}}.
Turn lamp: the DX listens above his own frequency (UP) and your split is off. "split" is the radio's SPLIT function.
Turn lamp: a long silence, and nothing said whose turn it is; {{key}} asks for a repeat (AGN).
Turn lamp: your over has ended.

chinese: 对方可能还要说 · 继续听
notes: Turn lamp: the moment to call has passed; the other station may carry on.
Turn lamp: the other station is signing; send your 73 and log the contact.
Turn lamp, in a contest: the contact is complete.
Turn lamp: nobody answered your over; {{key}} sends it again.
Turn lamp: a DX station came back to you in a pileup ("KD9TAW 5NN"). No F-key fits, so the lamp says what to send. The lamp is short: keep it about this length.

english: Send 5NN TU. The Reply key would send a whole ragchew over.
chinese: 发送 5NN TU。“应答”键会发一整套闲聊内容。
notes: Tooltip: a DX station came back to you in a pileup. "Reply" is the F3 key's caption (cw.macro.reply.label).
Spoken by a screen reader.
Spoken by a screen reader.
Spoken by a screen reader.
Spoken by a screen reader.
Spoken by a screen reader.

chinese: 先等：对方在上变频收听，而异频未开启。
notes: Spoken by a screen reader. "split" is the radio's SPLIT function.

english: Not sure whose turn it is.
notes: Spoken by a screen reader.
Spoken by a screen reader.
Spoken by a screen reader: the other station is ending the contact (73, SK).
In the CW Decode pane's head: the other station's speed beside yours, in WPM.

english: Their speed beside yours. Click to send at {{them}} WPM for this contact; your saved speed stays as it is.
chinese: 对方速度与你的对照。点击可在本次通联中以 {{them}} WPM 发送；你保存的速度保持不变。

chinese: 波段活跃度栏 / 接收机栏

english: {{plate}} needs CAT control — this radio is set up for VOX or serial PTT only. Add rig control in Settings ▸ Radio to get it.
chinese: {{plate}} 需要 CAT 控制 — 该电台仅配置了 VOX 或串口 PTT。请在 设置 ▸ 电台 中添加电台控制。

english: {{plate}} is picked from the pads this radio publishes, and it has not published any — Nexus will not command one it might not have. Reconnect rig control in Settings ▸ Radio to ask again.
chinese: {{plate}} 从该电台公布的档位中选取，而它没有公布任何档位 — Nexus 不会去命令一个它可能没有的档位。请在 设置 ▸ 电台 中重新连接电台控制后再试。

english: No rig control on this radio — the receiver and transmitter controls need CAT. Settings ▸ Radio.
chinese: 该电台没有电台控制 — 接收机与发射机控件需要 CAT。见 设置 ▸ 电台。

english: Nexus does not read the sub receiver’s frequency back from the radio.
chinese: Nexus 不会从电台读回副接收机的频率。

english: RF gain of the sub receiver — its own front end. Set from Nexus; the radio does not report it back.
chinese: 副接收机的射频增益 — 其自身前端。由 Nexus 设定；电台不会回报该值。

english: AF gain of the sub receiver — how loud it plays. Set from Nexus; the radio does not report it back.
chinese: 副接收机的音频增益 — 即播放音量。由 Nexus 设定；电台不会回报该值。

english: Squelch of the sub receiver. Set from Nexus; the radio does not report it back.
chinese: 副接收机的静噪。由 Nexus 设定；电台不会回报该值。

english: Not confirmed for the sub receiver: {{plates}}
Set from Nexus — the radio does not report the sub receiver’s levels back.
chinese: 已由 Nexus 设定 — 电台不会回报副接收机的电平。

english: Nexus could not set the sub receiver’s {{plate}}.
chinese: Nexus 无法设置副接收机的 {{plate}}。

english: Nexus could not set the monitor level.
chinese: Nexus 无法设置监听音量。

english: Receiver chain — what you are hearing
chinese: 接收链路 — 你正在听的内容

english: Transmitter chain — how your voice goes out
chinese: 发射链路 — 你的声音如何送出

notes: Short label on: Phone (SSB) cockpit. The same English text "Off" is used by 17 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.contrast.off, settings.workspace.night.off, settings.workspace.field.off) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
One-word control on: Phone (SSB) cockpit. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: The input pad, in decibels — the front-end attenuator this radio publishes. Use it when a strong neighbour is pumping the AGC; it costs you weak signals too.
chinese: 输入衰减，单位分贝 — 该电台公布的前端衰减器。当强邻台压制 AGC 时使用；但它同样会牺牲弱信号。

notes: One-word control on: Phone (SSB) cockpit. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: The receive preamp, by the name this radio gives each position — on some rigs they are numbered rather than decibels. Worth it on a quiet band; on a noisy one it lifts the noise with the signal.
chinese: 接收前置放大器，按该电台为各档给出的名称显示 — 有些机型用编号而非分贝。安静波段值得开启；噪声大的波段会连噪声一起放大。

english: How loud the radio plays your own voice back while you are transmitting. It is heard only on transmit, so turning it down can never silence a decoder — that is AF.
chinese: 发射时电台回放你自己声音的音量。它只在发射时能听到，因此调低绝不会让解码器静音 — 那属于音频增益。

notes: Short label on: Phone (SSB) cockpit. The same English text "Log" is used by 9 different keys (e.g. logEntry.log, logbook.form.log, operate.strip.log.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Transmit contract — what goes out when you key
chinese: 发射实况 — 你按键时真正发出的内容

english: The frequency your next over will actually be emitted on — the engine’s own answer, with any confirmed split and any XIT offset already in it. Under split this is NOT your receive dial.
chinese: 你下一次发段实际发射的频率 — 由引擎自身给出，已计入确认的异频和 XIT 偏移。异频状态下，这并非你的接收频率。

english: Nexus worked this frequency out from what it commanded and cannot confirm all of it against the radio — either there is no CAT link, or XIT is in play and the clarifier is write-only, so an offset dialled at the radio would not show here.
chinese: Nexus 根据其下发的指令推算出该频率，无法全部与电台核对 — 或者没有 CAT 链路，或者启用了 XIT 且 clarifier 只写不读，因此在电台上拧出的偏移不会显示在这里。

english: This station is not reporting a transmit frequency. Nexus will not print your receive dial in its place — under split they are unrelated numbers.
chinese: 该台站未报告发射频率。Nexus 不会用你的接收频率顶替 — 异频状态下二者是无关的数字。

english: Nexus cannot state your transmit frequency on FM through a repeater — the shift is applied by the radio and is not in the frequency the engine reports, so printing one here would be your listening frequency wearing a transmit label. Check the shift in Settings ▸ Radio, or read it off the radio.
chinese: 在 FM 中继场景下，Nexus 无法给出你的发射频率 — 频移由电台施加，不在引擎报告的频率中，因此在此打印只会是贴着发射标签的接收频率。请在 设置 ▸ 电台 中核对频移，或直接在电台上查看。

english: The mode your next over goes out in, and where Nexus got it. This is the same read-back the logbook writes, so what you see here and what gets recorded cannot disagree.
chinese: 你下一次发段所用的模式，以及 Nexus 的来源。这与日志写入的是同一次回读，因此此处所见与记录内容不会矛盾。

english: How far your transmit frequency sits from your receive dial (kHz)
chinese: 你的发射频率相对接收频率的偏移（kHz）

english: Nexus asked the radio for this split. The snapshot does not carry the radio’s own confirmation, so it is shown as commanded rather than read back — check the radio if the pile-up is not hearing you where you expect.
chinese: Nexus 向电台请求了该异频。快照不包含电台自身的确认，因此这里显示的是下发值而非回读值 — 若堆积中对方听不到你，请在电台上核对。

english: Transmit incremental tuning — the offset added to your transmit frequency (Hz)
chinese: 发射微调 — 叠加到发射频率上的偏移（Hz）

english: Nexus cannot read XIT back from any radio, so this is what Nexus commanded — not necessarily where the transmitter is. An offset set on the radio’s own clarifier knob will not appear here.
chinese: Nexus 无法从任何电台读回 XIT，因此这里显示的是 Nexus 下发的值 — 未必是发射机的实际位置。在电台自身 clarifier 旋钮上设置的偏移不会出现在这里。

english: Your power setting, and the output the radio last actually measured. No mark: the setting is the radio’s read-back when CAT reports one and the last commanded value otherwise, and nothing says which.
chinese: 你的功率设置，以及电台最近一次实际测得的输出。无标记时：若 CAT 有回报则为电台回读值，否则为最后一次下发值，且无法区分是哪种。

english: VOX is on — the radio keys itself from the mic. Stop TX cannot unkey a VOX-held transmitter.
chinese: VOX 已开启 — 电台由话筒自行触发。对 VOX 保持的发射，“停止发射”无法解除。
notes: "Stop TX" is the button's own name, English on purpose (the README).
A small mark beside a reading in the Phone cockpit: the radio reported this value itself (the row phone.prov.rig says the same in full).
A small mark beside a reading in the Phone cockpit: short for "commanded" — the value Nexus last sent, because this radio does not report it back.

english: As commanded — this radio does not report {{plate}} back over CAT, so this is what Nexus last sent.
chinese: 以下发值为准 — 该电台不会通过 CAT 回报 {{plate}}，因此这里显示的是 Nexus 最后下发的值。

notes: Short label on: Phone (SSB) cockpit. The same English text "Phone mode" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. freq.mode.aria, settings.phone.mode.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: AUTO — sideband by band (now {{sideband}}); a band change re-asserts this
chinese: 自动 — 按波段选择边带（当前 {{sideband}}）；换波段会重新套用
60 m 波段仅允许 USB 语音
notes: The tooltip on the greyed LSB, AM and FM buttons on 60 m, where a US licence allows upper sideband only.

english: Flex native DAX audio is on, so the radio takes transmit audio from DAX and your microphone is disconnected — on every slice and in every program, SmartSDR included. Turn OFF Flex native DAX audio in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Rig & CAT to use the mic.
chinese: 已开启 Flex 原生 DAX 音频，因此电台从 DAX 取发射音频，你的话筒已断开 — 对所有 slice 和所有程序生效，SmartSDR 也不例外。要使用话筒，请在 设置 ▸ 电台 ▸ 电台与 CAT 中关闭 Flex 原生 DAX 音频。

notes: Short label on: Phone (SSB) cockpit. The same English text "rig: {{mode}}" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. topbar.rigMode.chip, operate.strip.rigDiverge.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Your rig is on {{rigMode}}, but Phone is set to {{mode}}. TX uses {{mode}} — turn the rig's mode knob (or re-pick the band) to match.
chinese: 你的电台处于 {{rigMode}}，但电话模式设为 {{mode}}。发射使用 {{mode}} — 请把电台的模式旋钮转过去（或重新选择波段）以保持一致。

english: Split ON — TX {{freq}} MHz. Click for simplex.
chinese: 异频已开 — 发射 {{freq}} MHz。点击切换到同频。

english: Work split — TX off your RX frequency (e.g. up 5)
chinese: 异频通联 — 发射偏离接收频率（例如上差 5）

english: TX offset from your RX dial (kHz)
chinese: 发射相对接收频率的偏移（kHz）

english: AF gain — the radio's own volume. If your soundcard is fed from the rig's speaker or headphone jack, this also sets the level the decoder hears, so turning it right down stops FT8, RTTY and PSK as well as the speaker. A rig with its own USB audio, or a fixed-level ACC/DATA jack, is not affected.
chinese: 音频增益 — 电台自身音量。若你的声卡取自电台扬声器或耳机口，它也会决定解码器听到的电平，因此把它调到很低会同时停掉 FT8、RTTY、PSK 和扬声器输出。自带 USB 音频、或使用固定电平 ACC/DATA 接口的电台不受影响。
do_not_translate: DATA | RTTY | ACC | FT8 | PSK | USB | AF
notes: "USB" here is the computer connection (the radio's own USB sound card), not the USB sideband.

The same English text "DECODE?" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. phone.analog.sql.mutesDecode.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: AF is almost fully down. If the decoder listens through the rig’s speaker or headphone jack it has gone quiet too. Raise AF, or feed the soundcard from the USB codec or the rear ACC/DATA jack, which are not affected by this control.
chinese: 音频增益几乎调到最低。若解码器通过电台扬声器或耳机口收听，它也已静音。请提高音频增益，或改用 USB 编解码器或后部 ACC/DATA 接口供声卡，这些不受此控件影响。
notes: "USB" here is the computer connection (the radio's own USB sound card), not the USB sideband.

english: RF gain — the receiver front end, not transmit power. Back it off on a loud band to lift a signal out of the noise the AGC is riding on.
chinese: 射频增益 — 控制接收前端，不是发射功率。在强信号波段上把它调低，可把信号从 AGC 正在压着的噪声中提出来。

notes: One-word control on: Phone (SSB) cockpit. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Squelch — the level a signal must reach before you hear it. Normal on FM; on SSB, CW and the data modes leave it fully open, because a closed squelch mutes the audio the decoder listens to on most radios, including the USB feed.
chinese: 静噪 — 信号需达到的电平门槛。FM 下正常使用；在 SSB、CW 和数据模式下请完全打开，因为多数电台（包括 USB 音频通路）静噪关闭时会同时静音解码器所听的音频。
notes: "USB" here is the computer connection (the radio's own USB sound card), not the USB sideband.

A warning chip in capitals beside the squelch control: it is closed so far that the decoder may hear nothing. Its tooltip is the next row. The same English text "DECODE?" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. phone.analog.af.mutesDecode.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The squelch is up outside FM. On most radios that mutes the audio the decoder hears as well as the speaker, so nothing will decode until a signal breaks it. Wind it fully down for SSB, CW and the data modes.
chinese: 在 FM 之外的模式下静噪仍开着。多数电台此时会连同解码器所听的音频一起静音，因此在有信号打破静噪之前什么都解不出来。SSB、CW 和数据模式下请把它完全关到底。

english: Your trial has less than 48 hours left, so subscribing now takes the first payment at once and the plan starts now.
chinese: 你的试用期不足 48 小时，因此现在订阅会立即扣除首次款项，方案即刻开始。

english: Change plan, change the card, read invoices or cancel, on the payment provider's page.
chinese: 在支付服务商的页面上更改方案、更换银行卡、查看发票或取消。

english: This account already has a subscription. Use Manage subscription to change it.
chinese: 该账户已有订阅。请用“管理订阅”进行更改。

english: This account has no subscription to manage yet.
chinese: 该账户尚无订阅可管理。

english: Download a copy of what Nexus Remote holds about your account: your trial and plan, your stations, their devices and your invitations, as a JSON file.
chinese: 以 JSON 文件下载 Nexus Remote 持有的账户相关数据副本：你的试用与方案、你的台站及其设备，以及你的邀请。

english: Deleting your account removes it, your stations with their devices and the invitations made there, and your devices at other people's stations. Every one of them is disconnected at once, and people you invited lose access. Nexus at your shack keeps working.
chinese: 删除账户会移除账户本身、你的台站及其设备和在那里发出的邀请，以及你在他人台站上的设备。它们会立即全部断开，你邀请的人也会失去访问权限。你台站上的 Nexus 仍可正常使用。

english: We keep only what stops a second free trial (fingerprints of your address, callsign and shack computer, and your trial dates) and the billing records the law requires.
chinese: 我们仅保留用于阻止二次免费试用的信息（你地址、呼号与台站电脑的指纹，以及试用日期）和法律要求的账单记录。

english: Deleting your account cancels your subscription at once: access ends now and the unused part of the period is not refunded. If you are within 14 days of your first payment, ask for your refund before you delete.
chinese: 删除账户会立即取消你的订阅：访问即刻终止，未使用部分不予退款。若你在首次付款后 14 天内，请在删除前申请退款。

english: Your subscription could not be cancelled, so nothing was deleted. Try again in a few minutes.
chinese: 订阅未能取消，因此未删除任何内容。请几分钟后重试。

english: This account already has two stations. Revoke one you are not using before pairing another.
chinese: 该账户已有两个台站。请先撤销一个不用的台站，再配对其他台站。

english: That pairing code has expired or has already been used. Get a fresh one from Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 该配对码已过期或已被使用。请从台站上的 Nexus 获取新的配对码。

english: A pairing code is sixteen characters, digits 0-9 and letters a-f only. Check for a letter O where a zero should be.
chinese: 配对码为十六个字符，仅含数字 0-9 和字母 a-f。请检查是否把数字零误写成了字母 O。

english: This station already has as many approved browsers as it allows. Forget one you no longer use, then try again.
chinese: 该台站已达批准的浏览器数量上限。请忘记一个不再使用的浏览器后重试。

english: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again to carry on.
chinese: 登录状态已过期。请重新登录以继续。

english: Sign-in was refused. If you have just created an account, confirm your email with the code or link we sent, then sign in again.
chinese: 登录被拒绝。若你刚创建账户，请用我们发送的验证码或链接确认邮箱后再登录。

english: Your sign-up worked, but the email address is not confirmed yet. Enter the six-digit code we emailed you on the sign-up screen, or if you received a link, click it. Then come back here and continue. If you land back on this page, the email is not confirmed yet.
chinese: 注册成功，但邮箱地址尚未确认。请在注册页面输入我们邮件发送的六位验证码，若收到的是链接则点击它。然后回到此处继续。若你又回到本页，说明邮箱尚未确认。

english: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam or junk folder for an email from Nexus Remote. A code works for fifteen minutes, and a link for five days.
chinese: 几分钟后仍无邮件？请检查垃圾邮件文件夹中来自 Nexus Remote 的邮件。验证码有效期十五分钟，链接有效期五天。
notes: "Nexus Remote" is the name the email arrives from, so it stays as it is.

chinese: 我已确认邮箱 — 继续

english: This email address already has a Remote trial running under a different sign-in, such as Google instead of a password. Sign out, then sign in the way you did the first time.
chinese: 该邮箱地址已在另一种登录方式（例如 Google 而非密码）下运行了远程试用。请退出登录，然后用首次登录时的方式重新登录。

english: Too many tries. Wait up to ten minutes, then try again.
chinese: 尝试次数过多。请等待最多十分钟后重试。

english: That station is not reachable. Check that Nexus is running at the shack, that Remote is on there (Settings → Remote), and that the computer is awake and online.
chinese: 无法连接该台站。请确认台站上的 Nexus 正在运行、远程已在那里开启（设置 → 远程），并且电脑处于唤醒且联网状态。

english: Remote access to this station ended, so this browser was disconnected. Check your trial and your stations below.
chinese: 对该台站的远程访问已结束，因此此浏览器被断开。请在下方查看你的试用状态与台站。

english: Remote access to this station ended, so this browser was disconnected. Check your stations below.
chinese: 对该台站的远程访问已结束，因此此浏览器被断开。请在下方查看你的台站。

english: Each station approves its browsers separately, so this browser needs approving for this station too.
chinese: 每个台站分别批准其浏览器，因此此浏览器也需要为该台站单独批准。

english: Signing out keeps this browser approved. On a shared computer, press “Remove this browser’s approval” for each station before you sign out.
chinese: 退出登录不会取消此浏览器的批准。在共用电脑上，请在退出前为每个台站按“移除此浏览器的批准”。
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Remove this browser’s approval" is the on-screen text of remote.forgetBrowser. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint points at a menu entry that no longer exists.

english: This browser is approved until {{until}} UTC.
chinese: 此浏览器已获批准，有效期至 UTC {{until}}。

english: This browser is approved until you remove it in Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 此浏览器已获批准，直到你在台站上的 Nexus 中移除它。

english: This browser is approved until {{until}} UTC. Using the station from here keeps it approved, up to {{limit}} UTC.
chinese: 此浏览器已获批准，有效期至 UTC {{until}}。从此处使用台站会持续延长批准，最长至 UTC {{limit}}。

english: This browser’s approval ends {{until}} UTC. To keep using it, approve it again in Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 此浏览器的批准将于 UTC {{until}} 结束。要继续使用，请在台站上的 Nexus 中重新批准。

notes: On the Remote page, under a station. {{key}} is this browser's device key as a short fingerprint, like 3F2A 9C1B 77E0 4D12; Nexus at the shack shows the same one beside the browser, and the operator compares the two.

english: This station’s key has changed: the Remote service now lists a different key for it than the one this browser kept. Nothing connects until you accept the new key. Compare it with “This station’s key” in Nexus at the shack, and accept it only if they match.
chinese: 此台站的密钥已变更：远程服务现在为其列出的密钥与此浏览器保存的不一致。在你接受新密钥之前不会建立连接。请与台站 Nexus 中的“此台站的密钥”比对，仅在一致时接受。
notes: “This station’s key” is the start of the line where Nexus at the shack shows its key (remote.thisStationKey): use the same words, so the operator can find it there.

english: Revoking access disconnects this station and removes the approval of every browser that used it. To use it again, pair it again at the shack and approve your browsers there again.
chinese: 撤销访问会断开该台站，并移除所有曾使用它的浏览器的批准。若要再次使用，需在台站重新配对并重新批准你的浏览器。

english: In Nexus at the shack, open Settings → Remote and press “Pair a station”. Enter the code shown there.
chinese: 在台站电脑的 Nexus 中打开 设置 → 远程 并按“配对其他台站”。输入那里显示的验证码。
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Pair a station" is the on-screen text of remote.pairStation. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.
The same English text "Pairing code" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. lanWindow.code) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: "{{station}}" is linked to your account and waiting for approval in Nexus at the shack. Match the account ID there and approve it. The code is good for about {{minutes}} more minutes.
chinese: “{{station}}”已关联到你的账户，正在等待台站上的 Nexus 批准。请在那里核对账户 ID 并批准。该验证码还可使用约 {{minutes}} 分钟。

english: Pair this station with your Remote account. Approving the pairing turns Remote on and approves the browser you paired from; approve any other browser here. While Remote is on, approved browsers receive your station, contact, radio and amplifier data.
chinese: 将此台站与你的远程账户配对。批准配对会开启远程，并批准你发起配对的浏览器；其他浏览器请在此单独批准。远程开启期间，已批准的浏览器会接收你的台站、联络、电台与功放数据。

english: Your current contact draft is unchanged. Start a new contact with {{call}} when ready.
chinese: 你当前的联络草稿未改动。准备好后可用 {{call}} 开始新的联络。

english: This is not available from the browser right now. Open it in Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 该功能目前无法在浏览器中使用。请在台站上的 Nexus 中打开。

english: Journey, confirmation diagnostics and uploads are not available remotely yet.
chinese: 历程、确认诊断与上传功能暂不支持远程使用。

notes: Short label on: Listen control of the remote browser (the station's receive audio, played in the browser). The same English text "Listen" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. remote.listen.open, remote.account.role.listen) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

One-word control on: Listen control of the remote browser (the station's receive audio, played in the browser). Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word. The same English text "Volume" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.thisComputer.audio.volume.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Audio gap - the link is losing packets
chinese: 音频中断 — 链路正在丢包

english: Audio stalled - the link, not the band
chinese: 音频停滞 — 是链路问题，不是波段

english: This browser cannot play station audio. Chrome, Edge, Firefox on a computer, or Safari 26 can.
chinese: 此浏览器无法播放台站音频。电脑上的 Chrome、Edge、Firefox，或 Safari 26 可以。

english: The station changed its audio device. Press Listen again.
chinese: 台站更换了音频设备。请再次按“收听”。

english: Another browser is listening to this station.
chinese: 另一个浏览器正在收听该台站。

english: Audio stopped because station control was lost.
chinese: 音频已停止，因为失去了台站控制权。

notes: Text on the Stop TX button while the stop command is on its way to the station.
Text on the Stop TX button once the station has accepted the stop command.

english: Copy the file from the station into this computer’s Downloads folder
chinese: 把台站上的文件复制到本机“下载”文件夹

notes: The same English text "Saved to {{path}}" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. awards.status.saved, awards.custom.exported, sstv.viewer.save.done) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Could not save the station’s file to this computer
chinese: 无法把台站上的文件保存到本机

english: {{name}} is not a recording, an SSTV picture or ALL.TXT
chinese: {{name}} 不是录音、SSTV 图像或 ALL.TXT
台站上的 SSTV 图像

english: Could not list the station’s files
chinese: 无法列出台站上的文件

notes: The same English text "Close" is used by 10 different keys (e.g. logbook.import.done.close, logbook.form.close, logbook.qrzCorrect.close) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The station has accepted the Stop. It is not off the air until the station reports the transmitter free.
chinese: 台站已接受停止请求。在台站报告发射机空闲之前，它仍未离开空中。
notes: "Stop" here is what the Stop TX button sends: the command that ends a transmission.

Short label on: the Stop TX button while it reports what it did (TX strip, and the remote browser). The same English text "Stopped" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. rtty.txline.stopped) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The station reports the transmitter free.
chinese: 台站报告发射机已空闲。

english: The station has no audio to send right now.
chinese: 台站当前没有可发送的音频。

notes: Button on a station card on the Remote page that opens the live stream of Nexus at the shack. On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air. The same English text "Stream" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. lanWindow.stream) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Name read aloud by screen readers for the area that shows the live picture of Nexus at the shack.

english: Nexus at the shack. Click it, then use your mouse and keyboard to operate it. Tab leaves the picture.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus。点击它，然后用鼠标和键盘操作。Tab 键可离开画面。
notes: Screen-reader label on the live picture itself. "Tab" is the keyboard key that moves focus out of the picture.

On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

On the Remote stream page (Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it): a button that makes the page fill the whole screen. The same English text "Full screen" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. map.full.enter.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same button, while the page fills the screen. The same English text "Exit full screen" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. map.full.exit.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Fill the screen with the stream, Stop TX included. Esc still stops transmitting.
chinese: 让串流铺满屏幕，含“停止发射”。Esc 仍可停止发射。
notes: Tooltip on the Full screen button. "Stop TX" is the button's own name, English on purpose (the README); "Esc" is the key.
A button over the live picture while it is zoomed in with two fingers: it shows the whole picture again.
Tooltip on the Fit button.

On the Remote stream page (Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it): a button on a phone that opens a short menu with what its bars have no room for: End the stream, Disconnect, Sign out.
A button on a phone that opens a one-line box for typing into the field selected in Nexus at the shack, with the phone's own on-screen keyboard.

english: Type here for the field selected at the shack
chinese: 在此输入，内容会送到台站当前选中的控件
notes: Placeholder text inside that one-line box, also read aloud by screen readers as its name. "The shack" is the operator's own station, where Nexus runs.

english: Turn the phone on its side for a bigger picture.
chinese: 把手机横过来可获得更大画面。
notes: Shown on a phone held upright while the stream runs: turned on its side, the picture gets the whole height of the screen.
A button the operator holds down to key the station's transmitter; letting go unkeys it.

english: Hold to talk: the rig keys when your microphone's audio arrives, and unkeys when you let go or the picture stops.
chinese: 按住说话：你的话筒音频到达时电台开始发射，松开或画面停止时解除发射。
notes: Tooltip on the "Hold PTT" button.

english: Station control is off for this browser. Allow it in Nexus at the shack (Settings → Remote → Advanced), then try again.
chinese: 此浏览器的台站控制已关闭。请在台站上的 Nexus 中开启（设置 → 远程 → 高级），然后重试。

english: Another browser is using this station. You can start once it lets go.
chinese: 另一个浏览器正在使用该台站。对方释放后你即可开始。

english: Ready. Start the stream to see and operate Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 已就绪。开始串流即可查看并操作台站上的 Nexus。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The stream is the Nexus window as Windows draws it at the shack, so Nexus there must stay open, and not minimized.
chinese: 串流显示的是台站上 Windows 绘制的 Nexus 窗口，因此那里的 Nexus 必须保持打开且未最小化。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air. "Windows" is the operating system; "minimized" is the window sent to the taskbar.

On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The station couldn't start the stream just now. Start the stream again.
chinese: 台站刚才无法启动串流。请重新开始串流。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

chinese: 正在串流台站上的 Nexus
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The picture has stopped updating. The station will not transmit for this browser until it moves again.
chinese: 画面已停止更新。在画面恢复之前，台站不会为此浏览器发射。
notes: Shown over the live picture when it stops updating. The station refuses to transmit for a browser whose picture is out of date.

english: The station is holding off transmitting for this browser until its picture here catches up.
chinese: 台站正在暂缓为此浏览器发射，直到这里的画面跟上。
notes: Shown over the live picture when the station says the picture this browser shows is too old for it to accept transmitting.
Button on the Remote stream page that turns this browser's microphone on, for talking on the rig. Shows the state it is in now.
The same button, while the microphone is on.

english: Your microphone, for talking on the rig. It stays off until you turn it on, and your browser asks first. Then hold PTT and talk: the rig keys when your audio arrives.
chinese: 你的话筒，用于通过电台上话。它默认关闭，开启前浏览器会先询问。然后按住 PTT 说话：音频到达时电台开始发射。
notes: Tooltip on the microphone button.

Name read aloud by screen readers for the list of notes about the microphone shown over the live picture. The same English text "Microphone" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.phone.mic.title) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
A slider beside the microphone button: how loud the operator's voice goes to the rig.

english: How loud your voice goes to the rig, over your microphone's own level. Talk as you would on the air and raise it until your loudest words reach the end of the bar. Peaks are held 3 dB under full scale, so it never clips. This browser remembers it.
chinese: 你的声音送到电台的音量，叠加在话筒自身电平之上。按平时上机的音量说话，并提高它直到最响的字达到整条末端。峰值会压在满刻度以下 3 dB，因此永不削波。此浏览器会记住该设置。
notes: Tooltip on the Mic level slider. "Full scale" is the loudest a digital audio signal can be.
Read aloud by screen readers for the bar beside the Mic level slider, which shows how loud the voice being sent is.

english: The rig must take its SSB audio from USB (its menu for the transmit audio source). Most radios come set to the front microphone, and then an over sends the shack's microphone instead of you.
chinese: 电台必须从 USB 取 SSB 音频（其发射音频源菜单）。多数电台出厂设为前面板话筒，那样一个发段送出的会是台站的话筒而不是你。
notes: "USB" here is the computer connection: the rig takes its transmit audio from the USB cable. It is not the USB sideband.

english: The microphone is blocked for this site. Allow it in the browser's settings for this site (the icon at the left of the address bar), then turn the microphone on again.
chinese: 本站点的话筒权限被阻止。请在浏览器针对本站点的设置中允许（地址栏左侧的图标），然后重新开启话筒。
notes: Shown when this site is blocked from the microphone in the browser. "The icon at the left of the address bar" is the browser's site-information icon (a padlock or two sliders) at the start of the web address.

english: Your computer's privacy settings are blocking the microphone for the browser. On Windows, open Settings ▸ Privacy & security ▸ Microphone and turn on microphone access, including for desktop apps. On a Mac, open System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security ▸ Microphone, turn the browser on, and reopen it. Then turn the microphone on again.
chinese: 你电脑的隐私设置阻止了浏览器使用话筒。在 Windows 上，打开 设置 ▸ 隐私和安全性 ▸ 麦克风 并开启麦克风访问（含桌面应用）。在 Mac 上，打开 系统设置 ▸ 隐私与安全性 ▸ 麦克风，开启该浏览器并重新打开它。然后重新开启话筒。
notes: Shown when the computer itself (Windows or macOS privacy settings) blocks the browser from the microphone. The menu names are Windows' and macOS's own: use the names those systems show in Russian.

english: The browser's question about the microphone was closed without an answer. Turn the microphone on again and choose Allow.
chinese: 浏览器关于话筒的询问被关闭且未作答。请重新开启话筒并选择“允许”。
notes: "Allow" is the button in the browser's own question: use the word the browser shows in Russian.

english: No microphone was found on this computer. Plug one in, then turn the microphone on again.
chinese: 本机未找到话筒。请接入一个，然后重新开启话筒。

english: The microphone was found but could not start. Another program may be using it: close that program, then turn the microphone on again.
chinese: 找到了话筒但无法启动。可能有其他程序正在使用：请关闭该程序，然后重新开启话筒。

english: The browser could not get the microphone ({{name}}). Check the browser's settings for this site and the computer's microphone settings, then turn the microphone on again.
chinese: 浏览器无法获取话筒（{{name}}）。请检查浏览器针对本站点的设置与电脑的麦克风设置，然后重新开启话筒。
notes: {{name}} is the browser's own name for the error, such as NotAllowedError, and stays in English.

english: This browser cannot send the microphone on this stream.
