chinese: 此浏览器无法在此串流中发送话筒音频。

english: The browser is still processing the microphone (echo cancellation, noise suppression or automatic gain), which can make your voice sound worse on the air.
chinese: 浏览器仍在处理话筒音频（回声消除、噪声抑制或自动增益），这可能让你在空中的声音变差。

english: PTT is held but your microphone is off, so nothing is transmitted. Turn the microphone on to talk.
chinese: PTT 已按住但话筒未开，因此没有发射。请开启话筒后再讲话。

english: The rig shows no power out while your voice is arriving. Set its SSB audio source to USB (its menu for the transmit audio source).
chinese: 你的声音已到达，但电台显示无输出功率。请把其 SSB 音频源设为 USB（其发射音频源菜单）。
notes: "USB" here is the computer connection: the rig takes its transmit audio from the USB cable. It is not the USB sideband.

english: Your connection stalled, so the transmission stopped.
chinese: 你的连接中断，发射已停止。
notes: "Transmission" here is the radio transmission (the rig on the air).

english: Your audio stopped arriving, so the transmission stopped.
chinese: 你的音频中断，发射已停止。
notes: "Transmission" here is the radio transmission (the rig on the air).

english: Control was lost, so the transmission stopped.
chinese: 控制权已丢失，发射已停止。
notes: "Transmission" here is the radio transmission (the rig on the air).

english: The transmission ended at its 10-minute limit. Press PTT again to carry on.
chinese: 发射已达到 10 分钟上限并结束。请再次按 PTT 继续。

english: The TX watchdog stopped the transmission.
chinese: 发射看门狗停止了发射。

english: The station's audio changed, so the transmission stopped. Press PTT again.
chinese: 台站的音频发生变化，发射已停止。请再次按 PTT。

english: Time to give your call sign.
notes: A reminder shown while the operator is transmitting: the rules require giving your call sign at least every ten minutes and at the end of a contact.

english: Remember to give your call sign at the end of the contact.
chinese: 记得在联络结束时报出你的呼号。

english: Still there? The stream ends in a minute unless you click.
chinese: 还在吗？若你不点击，串流将在一分钟后结束。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air. Shown after fifteen minutes with no click, key press or PTT from this browser.

On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air. The one button on the "Still there?" prompt.

english: Nobody answered “Still there?”, so the stream ended.
chinese: 无人回应“还在吗？”，串流已结束。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air. Use the same words for "Still there?" as in remote.stream.idle.prompt.

english: The stream ended because station control was lost.
chinese: 串流已结束，因为失去了台站控制权。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: This station can't stream yet. Update Nexus at the shack and turn streaming on there.
chinese: 该台站暂时无法串流。请更新台站上的 Nexus 并在那里开启串流。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Your Remote access has ended, so the stream can't start.
chinese: 你的远程访问已结束，因此无法开始串流。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Remote access was switched off for this account, so the stream ended.
chinese: 该账户的远程访问已被关闭，串流随之结束。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then start the stream again.
chinese: 尝试次数过多。请等待一分钟后重新开始串流。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Your Remote access over the internet has ended, so the stream works only on the shack's own network. Connect this device to the same network as the station, then start the stream again.
chinese: 你通过互联网的远程访问已结束，因此串流仅在台站局域网内可用。请把本设备接入与台站相同的网络，然后重新开始串流。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Streaming on the shack's own network needs a newer Nexus at the shack. Update Nexus there, then start the stream again.
chinese: 在台站局域网内串流需要台站上更新版本的 Nexus。请在那里更新 Nexus，然后重新开始串流。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The station's reply was not encrypted end to end, so the stream was refused.
chinese: 台站的回复未经端到端加密，因此串流被拒绝。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: This browser can't show the stream. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
chinese: 此浏览器无法显示串流。请使用较新的 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 或 Safari。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The stream stops while this tab is in the background. Start it again when you're back.
chinese: 此标签页处于后台时串流会停止。回来后再重新开始。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The connection to the station was lost. Start the stream again.
chinese: 与台站的连接已断开。请重新开始串流。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Streaming is off at the shack. In Nexus there, turn on “Stream this station from my browser” (Settings → Remote), then start the stream again.
chinese: 台站上的串流已关闭。请在台站的 Nexus 中打开“从我的浏览器串流该台站”（设置 → 远程），然后重新开始串流。
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Stream this station from my browser" is the on-screen text of settings.remoteStream.label. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: Another browser is streaming this station. You can stream once it ends.
chinese: 另一个浏览器正在串流该台站。对方结束后你即可串流。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The station could not use this browser's stream request. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
chinese: 台站无法使用此浏览器的串流请求。请使用较新的 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 或 Safari。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Nexus at the shack is asking you to approve this browser. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then start the stream again.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus 正在请求你批准此浏览器。若那里显示的密钥与下方一致，请在那里批准，然后重新开始串流。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission. Shown when this browser was approved before streams checked its key.

english: This browser’s key has changed, so Nexus at the shack asks you to approve it again. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then start the stream again.
chinese: 此浏览器的密钥已变更，因此台站上的 Nexus 要求你重新批准。若那里显示的密钥与下方一致，请在那里批准，然后重新开始串流。
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission. Shown when the key this browser signs with is not the one Nexus at the shack approved.

english: This reply was not signed with your station's key, so it may not have come from your station. Nothing was connected.
chinese: 该回复未用你台站的密钥签名，因此可能并非来自你的台站。未建立任何连接。

english: Nexus at the shack did not sign its reply, so this browser can't tell it came from your station. Update Nexus at the shack, then start the stream again.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus 未对回复签名，因此此浏览器无法确认它来自你的台站。请更新台站上的 Nexus，然后重新开始串流。

english: This station’s key has changed, so nothing was connected. Return to your stations to compare the new key with “This station’s key” in Nexus at the shack.
chinese: 此台站的密钥已变更，因此未建立任何连接。请返回台站列表，将新密钥与台站 Nexus 中的“此台站的密钥”比对。
notes: “This station’s key” is the start of the line where Nexus at the shack shows its key (remote.thisStationKey): use the same words, so the operator can find it there.

english: The station isn't online. Check that Nexus is running at the shack with Remote turned on, and that the computer is awake.
chinese: 台站不在线。请确认台站上的 Nexus 正在运行且已开启远程，并且电脑处于唤醒状态。
notes: On the Remote stream page, when the station has not answered for several seconds: Nexus at the shack is closed, Remote is off there, or the computer is asleep.

Button on a station card on the Remote page, and on its audio-only page: hear the station's receive audio in the browser, with no picture. The same word as remote.audio.start. The same English text "Listen" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. remote.audio.start, remote.account.role.listen) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Ready. Press Listen to hear the station's receive audio.
chinese: 已就绪。按“收听”即可听到台站的接收音频。
notes: On the Remote page's audio-only view, before the audio starts. "Listen" is the button's own label (remote.listen.open).

english: The station couldn't start just now. Press Listen again.
chinese: 台站刚才无法启动。请再次按“收听”。
notes: On the audio-only view, when the station could not start just now. "Listen" is the button's own label (remote.listen.open).

english: Nexus at the shack is asking you to approve this browser. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then press Listen again.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus 正在请求你批准此浏览器。若那里显示的密钥与下方一致，请在那里批准，然后再次按“收听”。

english: This browser’s key has changed, so Nexus at the shack asks you to approve it again. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then press Listen again.
chinese: 此浏览器的密钥已变更，因此台站上的 Nexus 要求你重新批准。若那里显示的密钥与下方一致，请在那里批准，然后再次按“收听”。

english: This station isn't sending its receive audio. Check that Nexus at the shack is up to date and has the radio's audio input set.
chinese: 该台站未发送其接收音频。请确认台站上的 Nexus 已更新，且已设置电台的音频输入。
notes: On the audio-only view, when the station does not offer its receive audio (an older build, or no radio audio input set).

english: Ready. Stream to see and operate Nexus at the shack, or Listen for its audio only.
chinese: 已就绪。串流可查看并操作台站上的 Nexus，收听则仅接收其音频。
notes: One sentence on a station card on the Remote page, for a browser approved for that station. "Stream" and "Listen" are the card's two buttons (remote.stream.open, remote.listen.open): use the same words. "Stream" means Nexus shown live as a picture in a web browser, never a radio transmission.

english: This browser isn't approved for this station yet. Press Stream, and Nexus at the shack asks you to approve it.
chinese: 此浏览器尚未获准访问该台站。请按“串流”，台站上的 Nexus 会请求你批准。
notes: On a station card for a browser not approved for that station yet. Pressing Stream asks Nexus at the shack, which shows a question there. Use the same word as the Stream button (remote.stream.open). "Stream" means Nexus shown live as a picture in a web browser, never a radio transmission.

english: Waiting for approval at the shack: Nexus there asks whether to let “{{browser}}” stream. Approve it if it shows this key: {{key}}.
chinese: 正在等待台站批准：那里的 Nexus 会询问是否允许“{{browser}}”串流。若显示的密钥为此值，请批准：{{key}}。
notes: On a station card while Nexus at the shack asks whether to approve this browser. {{browser}} is the browser's own name, such as "Chrome on Windows"; {{key}} is a code like A1B2 C3D4 E5F6 0718 that the operator compares on both screens. "Stream" means Nexus shown live as a picture in a web browser, never a radio transmission.

english: Waiting for approval at the shack: Nexus there asks whether to let “{{browser}}” stream. Approve it there.
chinese: 正在等待台站批准：那里的 Nexus 会询问是否允许“{{browser}}”串流。请在那里批准。
notes: On a station card while Nexus at the shack asks whether to approve this browser. {{browser}} is the browser's own name, such as "Chrome on Windows". "Stream" means Nexus shown live as a picture in a web browser, never a radio transmission.
A short code on the station card for this browser's request; Nexus at the shack shows the same code beside it.

The name a browser gives itself when it asks a station to approve it, shown at the shack: for example "Chrome on Windows". {{browser}} is a browser's product name and {{system}} an operating system's; neither is translated.
The name a browser gives itself when its type cannot be read, shown at the shack in "Let {{browser}} stream this station?".
A small label beside the beta warning (remote.beta.notice) on the Remote site and in Nexus. Keep it one short word.

english: Remote streaming is a beta feature. Access could be revoked at any time.
chinese: 远程串流为测试功能。访问权限可能随时被撤销。
notes: On every station card on the Remote site, on the stream page, and beside the streaming switch in Nexus. "Streaming" means Nexus shown live as a picture in a web browser, never a radio transmission; "revoked" means the service can stop this account using it.

english: Station data unavailable. Refresh or reconnect.
chinese: 台站数据不可用。请刷新或重新连接。

english: Click a signal to tune it
chinese: 点击某个信号即可调谐到它

english: Waiting for the account to claim this station
chinese: 正在等待该账户认领此台站
账户已关联 — 需要本地批准
正在重新连接远程服务

english: Confirm this station in your browser first — the Remote page is asking whether to attach it. Then approve here again.
chinese: 请先在浏览器中确认此台站 — 远程页面正在询问是否关联它。然后在此再次批准。

english: The Remote service holds a different key for this station than the one it signs its stream with, so browsers refuse its stream. Use Revoke station access, then pair this station again.
chinese: 远程服务为该台站保存的密钥，与其签署串流所用的密钥不一致，因此浏览器会拒绝其串流。请使用“撤销台站访问”，然后重新配对该台站。

english: Unlock your operating system’s credential store and try again. Remote stays disabled if its credential cannot be stored securely.
chinese: 请先解锁操作系统的凭据存储后重试。若凭据无法安全保存，远程功能将保持禁用。

english: This station's access was revoked from a browser, so it has stopped connecting. Nothing here is broken — pair it again below when you want it back.
chinese: 该台站的访问已从某个浏览器撤销，因此它已停止连接。此处并无故障 — 需要恢复时在下方重新配对即可。

english: Your Remote trial has ended, so this station could not be added to the account. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 你的远程试用已结束，因此该台站未能加入账户。你的电台、日志和设置均未改动。

english: Remote access for this account has been switched off, so this station could not be added to it. This is not the trial running out. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 该账户的远程访问已被关闭，因此该台站未能加入。这与试用到期不同。你的电台、日志和设置均未改动。

english: A Remote trial is one per callsign, so set your station callsign in Settings → Station first, then pair this station again. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 远程试用按呼号计算，一个呼号一次，因此请先在 设置 → 电台 中填写你的台站呼号，然后重新配对该台站。你的电台、日志和设置均未改动。

english: The callsign in Settings → Station is not an active US licence in the FCC's licence list, so this station could not be added. Check it for a typo. A new licence takes about a day to appear there. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 设置 → 电台 中的呼号在 FCC 执照列表中不是有效执照，因此该台站未能加入。请检查是否有笔误。新执照约需一天才会出现在列表中。你的电台、日志和设置均未改动。

english: This callsign has already had a Remote trial under another account, so this station could not be added. If this is your callsign, write to support from the email address on your licence. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 该呼号已在另一账户下使用过远程试用，因此该台站未能加入。若这是你的呼号，请用执照上登记的邮箱联系支持。你的电台、日志和设置均未改动。

english: This computer has already had a Remote trial under another account, so this station could not be added. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 此电脑已在另一账户下使用过远程试用，因此该台站未能加入。你的电台、日志和设置均未改动。

english: Adding a station to Remote needs a newer Nexus. Update Nexus, then pair this station again. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 向远程功能添加台站需要更新版本的 Nexus。请更新 Nexus，然后重新配对该台站。你的电台、日志和设置均未改动。

english: This email address already has a Remote trial running under a different sign-in, such as Google instead of a password, so this station could not be added. In your browser, sign out, sign in the way you did the first time, then pair this station again. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
chinese: 该邮箱地址已在另一种登录方式（例如 Google 而非密码）下运行了远程试用，因此该台站未能加入。请在浏览器中退出登录，用首次登录时的方式重新登录，然后重新配对该台站。你的电台、日志和设置均未改动。

english: Enter a name for this station to sign in or pair.
chinese: 输入该台站的名称以便登录或配对。

notes: Short label on: the station list of the remote browser. The same English text "Rename" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. logbook.filters.rename, settings.cw.macros.profiles.rename) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: the station list of the remote browser. The same English text "Cancel" is used by 30 different keys (e.g. logEntry.sent.moved.cancel, logbook.import.preview.cancel, logbook.parkStates.cancel) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: This code expires after ten minutes.
chinese: 该验证码十分钟后失效。

english: Remote stays on when Nexus restarts: if it was on when Nexus closed, it turns itself back on and reconnects. Approved browsers keep what you allowed. Turn off Remote only disconnects: turning it back on restores what each approved browser had.
chinese: Nexus 重启后远程功能会保持开启：若 Nexus 关闭时它是开启的，会自动重新开启并重连。已批准的浏览器保留你授予的权限。关闭远程只会断开连接：再次开启时会恢复各已批准浏览器原有的权限。

english: Remote can only come back after this computer restarts if Nexus starts too. Start Nexus when you sign in to this computer?
chinese: 只有当 Nexus 也随开机启动时，远程功能才能在电脑重启后恢复。登录此电脑时要启动 Nexus 吗？

english: Start Nexus when I sign in
This computer did not let Nexus start at sign-in. You can try again in Settings.
chinese: 此电脑不允许 Nexus 在登录时启动。可在设置中重试。
已批准，直到你将其移除。

english: Approved until {{until}} UTC. Using the station from this browser keeps it approved, up to {{limit}} UTC.
chinese: 已批准，有效期至 UTC {{until}}。从此浏览器使用台站会持续延长批准，最长至 UTC {{limit}}。

english: This approval ends {{until}} UTC. Approve the browser again to keep it.
chinese: 该批准将于 UTC {{until}} 结束。请重新批准该浏览器以保留它。

notes: In Nexus at the shack, beside a browser's name. {{key}} is that browser's device key as a short fingerprint, like 3F2A 9C1B 77E0 4D12; the browser shows the same one, and the operator compares the two before approving it. The same English text "Key {{key}}" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. lanWindow.stationKey) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: This browser can’t stream until you approve it again here. First check this key matches the one the browser shows.
chinese: 此浏览器需在此重新批准后才能串流。请先确认该密钥与浏览器显示的密钥一致。
notes: In Nexus at the shack, under a browser that is approved but whose key has not been checked here. "Stream" means Nexus shown live as a picture in a web browser, never a radio transmission.
Beside a browser in that list that is waiting for approval. "Stream" means Nexus shown live as a picture in a web browser, never a radio transmission.

Button beside an approved browser in that list: removes its approval. The same English text "Remove" is used by 9 different keys (e.g. logbook.tools.bulk.remove, settings.streetMaps.remove, settings.radios.remove.action) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Asks to operate this station over the internet.
chinese: 请求通过互联网操作该台站。

english: This computer can’t connect until you approve it again here. First check this key matches the one Nexus shows on it.
chinese: 此电脑需在此重新批准后才能连接。请先确认该密钥与那台电脑上 Nexus 显示的密钥一致。

english: Sign in with your Nexus Remote account in the browser that opens. There is no code: each of your other devices is then added when you sign in on it.
chinese: 在打开的浏览器中用你的 Nexus Remote 账户登录。此过程不需要验证码：之后你在其他设备上登录时会自动添加该设备。

english: Waiting for you to sign in, in the browser that opened…
chinese: 正在等待你在已打开的浏览器中登录…

english: Signing in to Nexus Remote is not available in this build yet. Pair with a code instead.
chinese: 此版本尚不支持登录 Nexus Remote。请改用验证码配对。

english: The sign-in did not finish. Try again.
notes: The same English text "The sign-in did not finish. Try again." is used by 2 different keys (e.g. lanWindow.internet.reason.signInFailed) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Another sign-in is already open on this computer. Finish or close it, then try again.
chinese: 此电脑已有另一个登录处于打开状态。请完成或关闭它后重试。

english: Your account already has two stations. Remove one on the Remote page first.
chinese: 你的账户已有两个台站。请先在远程页面移除一个。

english: Sign in again to keep adding devices: the key your station's sign-in was checked with has been retired.
chinese: 请重新登录以继续添加设备：验证你台站登录所用的密钥已作废。

english: Nexus could not read its list of computers removed here, so it adds no device by its sign-in and takes no computer on this network. Press Reset network identity under Network identity below. A reset removes every paired computer, so each one has to be paired again.
chinese: Nexus 无法读取其“已在此移除的电脑”列表，因此不会通过登录添加任何设备，也不会接收此网络上的任何电脑。请按下方“网络身份”中的“重置网络身份”。重置会移除所有已配对电脑，因此每台都需要重新配对。

english: Sign in with the account this station belongs to.
chinese: 请用该台站所属的账户登录。

english: Added by signing in as you: {{name}} ({{what}}), key {{key}}.
chinese: 通过以你身份登录而添加：{{name}}（{{what}}），密钥 {{key}}。

english: Added for someone you invited ({{role}}): {{name}} ({{what}}), key {{key}}.
chinese: 为你邀请的人（{{role}}）添加：{{name}}（{{what}}），密钥 {{key}}。

notes: The same English text "Got it" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. fieldDay.workIn.hint.dismiss, phone.keyer.flexDax.dismiss, firstContact.close) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Waiting for you to allow it to transmit.
chinese: 正在等待你允许其发射。

english: That device is no longer waiting to transmit. It was removed, or it was not added by signing in.
chinese: 该设备已不再等待发射。它已被移除，或并非通过登录添加。

english: The Remote service says this device is yours, but Nexus could not confirm it. Approve it only if you added it yourself.
chinese: 远程服务声称该设备属于你，但 Nexus 无法确认。仅当你亲自添加时才批准。

english: Removed here. The Remote service hears of it when this station is back online.
chinese: 已在此移除。待该台站重新上线后，远程服务会获知此事。

english: Removed. Nexus could not confirm whether this computer also shows as another row under Devices. Check the list, and remove it there too if it does.
chinese: 已移除。Nexus 无法确认此电脑是否也作为另一行出现在“设备”中。请检查列表，若有则一并移除。

english: Every computer, phone and browser that can reach this station, under whoever it belongs to.
chinese: 所有能访问该台站的电脑、手机和浏览器，归在各自所属人名下。

english: Added by signing in, not yet known whose
chinese: 通过登录添加，尚不知归属

english: Listening and tuning only. Transmit waits for you to press Allow to transmit, or about {{minutes}} min.
chinese: 仅收听与调谐。发射需你按“允许发射”，或等待约 {{minutes}} 分钟。

notes: The same English text "Details" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. dxped.calendar.view.list) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Invite someone by the address they sign in with. Their devices are added when they sign in. Someone invited to operate transmits with your station, under your callsign: you stay responsible as its licensee.
chinese: 用对方的登录邮箱邀请。对方登录后其设备会被添加。被邀请“操作”的人会以你的呼号、用你的台站发射：作为执照持有人，你仍需负责。

notes: The same English text "Operate" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. features.category.operate, features.operate.label, amp.operate) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Listen" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. remote.audio.start, remote.listen.open) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Someone invited to operate can do all you can from another computer: transmit under your callsign, edit, export or delete your log, upload with your saved logins (LoTW signed with your certificate), spot under your call and read your Winlink mail. Invite to operate only someone you would hand the shack to.
chinese: 被邀请“操作”的人可在另一台电脑上做你能做的一切：以你的呼号发射、编辑/导出/删除你的日志、用你保存的登录上传（LoTW 用你的证书签名）、以你的呼号发台站报告，以及读取你的 Winlink 邮件。只把“操作”权限邀请给你愿意把台站交给的人。
notes: Shown under the Role choice while inviting someone, when Operate is picked.

The same English text "Remove" is used by 9 different keys (e.g. logbook.tools.bulk.remove, settings.streetMaps.remove, settings.radios.remove.action) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Also taken off this network, since Nexus could not tell whose they were: {{names}}. Whoever uses them signs in on them again to come back.
chinese: 同时已从此网络移除，因为 Nexus 无法判断其归属：{{names}}。使用者在其上重新登录即可恢复。

english: This station has invited as many people as it can. Remove someone first.
chinese: 该台站已达邀请人数上限。请先移除某人。

notes: A fold in Settings ▸ Remote access that holds the pairing and permission options. The same English text "Advanced" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. setup.finish.license.advanced, settings.rigControl.advanced.title) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Button: approve a browser for this station, in the list and in the question Nexus shows when a browser asks to stream.

Title of the question Nexus shows at the shack when a browser asks to stream. {{browser}} is the browser's own name, such as "Chrome on Windows". "Stream" means Nexus shown live as a picture in a web browser, never a radio transmission.

english: A browser signed in to your Remote account asks to stream this station and operate it as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one the browser shows: {{key}}.
chinese: 一个登录了你远程账户的浏览器请求串流该台站，并像你在此一样操作它，包括发射。仅当该密钥与浏览器显示的密钥一致时才批准：{{key}}。
notes: Under that title. {{key}} is a code like A1B2 C3D4 E5F6 0718 that the operator compares with the one the browser shows. "Remote" is the product's name (Nexus Remote). "transmit included" is the radio sense: through the stream the browser can key the rig.

english: This browser was approved before, but it can’t stream until you approve it again here. When it streams, it can operate this station as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one the browser shows: {{key}}.
chinese: 此浏览器此前已获批准，但需在此重新批准后才能串流。串流时它可像你在此一样操作该台站，包括发射。仅当该密钥与浏览器显示的密钥一致时才批准：{{key}}。
notes: Under that title, for a browser approved before its key was checked here. {{key}} is a code like A1B2 C3D4 E5F6 0718 that the operator compares with the one the browser shows. "Stream" means Nexus shown live as a picture in a web browser, never a radio transmission; "transmit included" is the radio sense: through the stream the browser can key the rig.

english: Nexus on {{platform}}, signed in to your Remote account, asks to operate this station over the internet as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one Nexus shows on that computer: {{key}}.
chinese: {{platform}} 上登录了你远程账户的 Nexus 请求通过互联网像你在此一样操作该台站，包括发射。仅当该密钥与那台电脑上 Nexus 显示的密钥一致时才批准：{{key}}。

english: Nexus on {{platform}} was approved before, but it can’t connect until you approve it again here. Connected, it can operate this station as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one Nexus shows on that computer: {{key}}.
chinese: {{platform}} 上的 Nexus 此前已获批准，但需在此重新批准后才能连接。连接后它可像你在此一样操作该台站，包括发射。仅当该密钥与那台电脑上 Nexus 显示的密钥一致时才批准：{{key}}。

notes: Button in that question: refuse the browser.

english: A browser signed in to your Remote account. It can listen and tune now, and transmit waits for you. Allow it only if this key matches the one the browser shows: {{key}}.
chinese: 一个登录了你远程账户的浏览器。它现在可以收听和调谐，发射则等待你的许可。仅当该密钥与浏览器显示的密钥一致时才允许：{{key}}。

english: Nexus on {{platform}} signed in to your Remote account. It can listen and tune now, and transmit waits for you. Allow it only if this key matches the one Nexus shows on that computer: {{key}}.
chinese: {{platform}} 上登录了你远程账户的 Nexus。它现在可以收听和调谐，发射则等待你的许可。仅当该密钥与那台电脑上 Nexus 显示的密钥一致时才允许：{{key}}。

notes: The same English text "Not now" is used by 6 different keys (e.g. reveal.notNow, update.notNow.label, lanWindow.operateNo) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Lets Nexus on another computer on this network operate this station, with no internet needed. Pair each computer here once; it keeps access until you remove it.
chinese: 允许此网络上的另一台电脑上的 Nexus 操作该台站，无需互联网。每台电脑在此配对一次；在你移除之前会一直保持访问权。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Station ▸ Remote access ▸ Remote over this network. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Station ▸ Remote access ▸ Remote over this network. The same English text "Starting…" is used by 5 different keys (e.g. settings.connectWeb.url.pending, map.street.sheet.running.starting, lanWindow.opening) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Listening at {{address}}. Only computers paired here can connect.
chinese: 正在 {{address}} 上监听。只有在此配对的电脑才能连接。

english: Off: this station has no network key it can read. Press Reset network identity under Network identity below, then turn this on again. A reset removes every paired computer, so each one has to be paired again.
chinese: 关闭：该台站没有可读取的网络密钥。请按下方“网络身份”中的“重置网络身份”，然后重新开启。重置会移除所有已配对电脑，因此每台都需要重新配对。
notes: Names another control: "Reset network identity" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.reset. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show. Names another control: "Network identity" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.resetTitle. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: Off: remote control was ended here. Turn this on again when you want it.
chinese: 关闭：远程控制已在此结束。需要时再重新开启。

english: Not listening: {{address}} is not this computer’s address right now. Nexus listens there again when it is back, or choose another network.
chinese: 未在监听：{{address}} 当前不是此电脑的地址。它恢复后 Nexus 会重新在那里监听，或请另选网络。

english: Not listening: choose which of this computer’s networks to listen on.
chinese: 未在监听：请选择在此电脑的哪个网络上监听。

english: Not listening: another program is using its port.
chinese: 未在监听：其端口正被其他程序占用。

english: Not listening: this computer is not on a private network.
chinese: 未在监听：此电脑不在专用网络上。

english: Not listening: it could not start on this computer.
chinese: 未在监听：它无法在此电脑上启动。

english: Type this code in Nexus on the other computer. It works once, within ten minutes.
chinese: 在另一台电脑的 Nexus 中输入该验证码。它只能使用一次，有效期十分钟。

english: Whoever types it in time can operate this station, transmit included, so keep it to yourself.
chinese: 任何及时输入它的人都能操作该台站，包括发射，因此请勿外传。

english: Only at the station itself: this can’t be done through a stream.
chinese: 仅能在台站本机操作：此功能无法通过串流完成。

english: Eight computers are paired already. Remove one to pair another.
chinese: 已配对八台电脑。请移除一台后再配对。

english: Nexus could not read or keep this station’s network key and paired computers in your operating system’s credential store. Press Reset network identity under Network identity below. A reset removes every paired computer, so each one has to be paired again.
chinese: Nexus 无法在操作系统的凭据存储中读取或保存该台站的网络密钥与已配对电脑。请按下方“网络身份”中的“重置网络身份”。重置会移除所有已配对电脑，因此每台都需要重新配对。
notes: Names another control: "Reset network identity" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.reset. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show. Names another control: "Network identity" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.resetTitle. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: Nexus could not do that. Try again.
chinese: Nexus 无法完成该操作。请重试。

english: Resetting makes a new network key and removes every paired computer. Use it if this computer’s key may have been copied, then pair your computers again.
chinese: 重置会生成新的网络密钥并移除所有已配对电脑。若怀疑此电脑的密钥已被复制，请使用此项，然后重新配对你的电脑。

english: This station and the other computer both need Windows, for now.
chinese: 目前该台站与另一台电脑都必须运行 Windows。

english: The first time this is turned on, Windows asks whether Nexus may use networks. Allow Private networks only.
chinese: 首次开启时，Windows 会询问 Nexus 是否可以使用网络。请仅允许“专用网络”。
notes: "Private networks" is the choice Windows offers when it asks whether a program may use the network: use the words Windows shows in Russian.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Station ▸ Remote access ▸ Remote over this network. The same English text "Network" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. gettingStarted.radio.shot.netLabel, setup.rig.conn.network.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

One-word control on: Settings ▸ Station ▸ Remote access ▸ Remote over this network. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Virtual adapters and VPNs are not offered: other computers on this network can’t reach this one through them.
chinese: 不会列出虚拟网卡与 VPN：该网络上的其他电脑无法通过这些接口访问本机。

english: Windows won’t let other computers find this station by name here, so type its address on the other computer.
chinese: Windows 不允许其他电脑在此按名称发现该台站，请在另一台电脑上输入其地址。

english: A guest network, or one that keeps its devices apart, stops other computers reaching this one, and Nexus can’t tell that from here.
chinese: 访客网络或隔离设备的网络会阻止其他电脑访问本机，而 Nexus 在此无法判断这种情况。

english: When Windows asks whether Nexus may use this network, allow Private networks only.
chinese: 当 Windows 询问 Nexus 是否可以使用此网络时，请仅允许“专用网络”。
notes: "Private networks" is the choice Windows offers when it asks whether a program may use the network: use the words Windows shows in Russian.

english: Windows calls this network Public, so its firewall keeps other computers out. If this is your own network, make it Private in Windows Settings ▸ Network & internet.
chinese: Windows 将此网络标记为“公用”，因此其防火墙会阻止其他电脑访问。若这是你自己的网络，请在 Windows 设置 ▸ 网络和 Internet 中改为“专用”。
notes: "Public" and "Private" are Windows' names for the two kinds of network, and Settings ▸ Network & internet is Windows' own menu: use the names Windows shows in Russian.

english: Windows Firewall blocks Nexus on this network, as it does after its question is cancelled. Allow Nexus on Private networks in Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Allow an app through firewall.
chinese: Windows 防火墙在此网络上阻止了 Nexus，取消其询问后即会如此。请在 Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火墙和网络保护 ▸ 允许应用通过防火墙 中允许 Nexus 使用专用网络。
notes: "Private networks" and Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Allow an app through firewall are Windows' own names: use the names Windows shows in Russian.

english: Windows Firewall blocks every incoming connection on this network, so no other computer can reach this station.
chinese: Windows 防火墙阻止了此网络上的所有入站连接，因此任何其他电脑都无法访问该台站。

english: This computer’s firewall is set by an administrator’s policy, which may keep other computers out. Ask whoever manages it to allow Nexus.
chinese: 此电脑的防火墙由管理员策略设定，可能会阻止其他电脑访问。请让管理者允许 Nexus。

english: Windows Firewall blocks new programs on this network without asking. Allow Nexus on Private networks in Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Allow an app through firewall.
chinese: Windows 防火墙在此网络上会不经询问地阻止新程序。请在 Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火墙和网络保护 ▸ 允许应用通过防火墙 中允许 Nexus 使用专用网络。
notes: "Private networks" and Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Allow an app through firewall are Windows' own names: use the names Windows shows in Russian.

english: That address isn’t on this computer’s network. Join the station’s network, or check the address the station shows.
chinese: 该地址不在此电脑的网络上。请接入台站所在的网络，或核对台站显示的地址。

english: The station’s computer answered, but nothing listens at that port: Remote over this network is off there, or on another port. Check the address the station shows.
chinese: 台站电脑有响应，但该端口没有程序监听：那里的“经此网络使用远程”已关闭，或使用了其他端口。请核对台站显示的地址。
notes: Names another control: "Remote over this network" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.switch. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: No answer from the station. Remote over this network may be off there, its firewall may be blocking Nexus (allow it on Private networks at the station), the network may keep its devices apart (guest Wi-Fi often does), or the station may be asleep. Nexus can’t tell which from here.
chinese: 台站没有回应。那里的“经此网络使用远程”可能已关闭、其防火墙可能阻止了 Nexus（请在台站允许其使用专用网络）、网络可能隔离了设备（访客 Wi-Fi 常常如此），或者台站处于休眠。Nexus 在此无法判断是哪一种。
notes: "Private networks" is the choice Windows offers when it asks whether a program may use the network: use the words Windows shows in Russian. Names another control: "Remote over this network" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.switch. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: Finding stations by name doesn’t work on this computer. Type the address the station shows.
chinese: 此电脑无法按名称查找台站。请输入台站显示的地址。

english: No station answered by name on this network. Type the address the station shows.
chinese: 此网络上没有按名称响应的台站。请输入台站显示的地址。

english: Type the address the station shows, like {{address}} or {{withPort}}.
chinese: 请输入台站显示的地址，例如 {{address}} 或 {{withPort}}。

notes: Short label on: the Stations on this network window. The same English text "Starting…" is used by 5 different keys (e.g. settings.connectWeb.url.pending, map.street.sheet.running.starting, remote.lan.starting) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: This window lost touch with Nexus. Close it, then open it again from Settings.
chinese: 此窗口与 Nexus 失去联系。请关闭后从设置中重新打开。

english: No station is on this computer yet. Sign in to add yours.
chinese: 此电脑上还没有台站。请登录以添加你的台站。

notes: Short label on: the Stations on this network window. The same English text "Key {{key}}" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. remote.browserKey) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: the Stations on this network window. The same English text "Stream" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. remote.stream.open) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: the Stations on this network window. The same English text "Connecting…" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.integrations.clusterNodes.status.connecting) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: the Stations on this network window. The same English text "Forget" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.confirmations.credential.forget.action) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Forget this station? This computer’s keys for it are deleted, and using it from here again needs a new sign-in (or a new code, for a station paired with one). If the station still lists this computer, remove it there too.
chinese: 忘记该台站？此电脑为其保存的密钥将被删除，要从此处再次使用需重新登录（若该台站是通过验证码配对的，则需新的验证码）。若台站仍列出此电脑，请在那里一并移除。

english: Pair with a station on this network
chinese: 与此网络上的台站配对

english: At the station, press Pair a computer under Remote over this network. It shows its address and a code that works once, within ten minutes.
chinese: 在台站上按“经此网络使用远程”中的“配对其他电脑”。它会显示地址和一个只能使用一次、有效期十分钟的验证码。
notes: Names another control: "Remote over this network" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.switch. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show. Names another control: "Pair a computer" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.pair. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: As the station shows it, like {{example}}.
chinese: 按台站显示的样子输入，例如 {{example}}。

english: Looking for stations on this network…
chinese: 正在此网络上查找台站…

english: Found by name on this network. Press one to use its address.
chinese: 已在此网络上按名称找到。点击一个即可使用其地址。

notes: Short label on: the Stations on this network window. The same English text "Pairing code" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. remote.pairingCode) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The sixteen characters the station shows. Capitals or not, spaces or not.
chinese: 台站显示的十六个字符。大小写、空格均可。

english: The station shows it beside this computer’s key.
chinese: 台站会在该电脑密钥旁显示此名称。

notes: One-word control on: the Stations on this network window. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.
One-word control on: the Stations on this network window. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

Short label on: the Stations on this network window. The same English text "Cancel" is used by 30 different keys (e.g. logEntry.sent.moved.cancel, logbook.import.preview.cancel, logbook.parkStates.cancel) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Paired. Press Operate from this computer to work the station from here.
chinese: 已配对。从此电脑按“操作”即可在这里操作该台站。
notes: Names another control: "Operate from this computer" is the on-screen text of lanWindow.operate. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: That is not a station’s address. Type it as the station shows it, on this network.
chinese: 这不是台站地址。请按台站在此网络上显示的样子输入。

english: The code is sixteen characters, 0 to 9 and a to f. Check it against the station’s screen.
chinese: 验证码为十六个字符，由 0-9 和 a-f 组成。请与台站屏幕核对。

english: Give this computer a name of 1 to 32 characters.
chinese: 请为此电脑起一个 1 到 32 个字符的名称。

english: Nothing answered. Check that the station is on, that Remote over this network is on there, and that this computer is on the same network.
chinese: 没有回应。请确认台站已开机、那里的“经此网络使用远程”已开启，且此电脑与台站在同一网络。
notes: Names another control: "Remote over this network" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.switch. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: The station is not pairing now. Press Pair a computer at the station, then type the new code within ten minutes.
chinese: 台站当前未处于配对状态。请在台站按“配对其他电脑”，然后在十分钟内输入新验证码。
notes: Names another control: "Pair a computer" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.pair. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: The station refused the code. Check it against the station’s screen. After three wrong codes the station needs a new one.
chinese: 台站拒绝了该验证码。请与台站屏幕核对。连续三次错误后，台站需要生成新的验证码。

english: The code does not match the station’s. Check the code and the address. If both are right, something else on this network may be answering in the station’s place.
chinese: 该验证码与台站不匹配。请核对验证码和地址。若两者都正确，可能有此网络上的其他程序冒用台站身份响应。

english: The station has eight computers paired already. Remove one there, then try again.
chinese: 该台站已配对八台电脑。请在那里移除一台后重试。

english: The station could not keep the pairing. Check its credential store, then pair again with a new code.
chinese: 台站无法保存配对信息。请检查其凭据存储，然后用新验证码重新配对。

english: This computer’s Nexus is newer than the station’s. Update Nexus at the station, then try again.
chinese: 此电脑的 Nexus 比台站的新。请更新台站上的 Nexus 后重试。

english: The station’s Nexus is newer than this computer’s. Update Nexus on this computer, then try again.
chinese: 台站的 Nexus 比此电脑的新。请更新此电脑上的 Nexus 后重试。

english: This computer is paired with eight stations already. Forget one, then try again.
chinese: 此电脑已与八个台站配对。请忘记一个后重试。

english: This computer’s credential store did not answer. Unlock it, then try again.
chinese: 此电脑的凭据存储没有响应。请解锁后重试。

english: Something answered there that is not a Nexus station. Check the address.
chinese: 该地址响应的不是 Nexus 台站。请核对地址。

english: Nexus could not do that on this computer. Try again.
chinese: Nexus 无法在此电脑上完成该操作。请重试。

english: This station’s key has changed. If Nexus was reinstalled at the station, or its network identity reset, pair this computer again.
chinese: 该台站的密钥已变更。若台站重装了 Nexus 或重置了网络身份，请重新配对此电脑。

english: A station answered by name, but it is not the one this computer paired with, so Nexus did not connect to it. Check that the station is on and that Remote over this network is on there, or type the address it shows.
chinese: 按名称响应的台站并非此电脑所配对的那个，因此 Nexus 未与之连接。请确认该台站已开机且那里的“经此网络使用远程”已开启，或输入其显示的地址。
notes: Names another control: "Remote over this network" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.switch. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: The station no longer knows this computer. It may have been removed there: pair it again.
chinese: 该台站已不再认识此电脑。可能已在那里被移除：请重新配对。

english: This computer is no longer paired with that station.
chinese: 此电脑已不再与该台站配对。

english: The station ended the connection. Remote over this network may have been turned off there, or this computer removed.
chinese: 台站结束了连接。那里的“经此网络使用远程”可能已关闭，或此电脑已被移除。
notes: Names another control: "Remote over this network" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.switch. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: The connection to the station was lost.

notes: The main button on a paired station's row in the Stations on this network window: Nexus closes and starts again on this computer, driving that station. lanWindow.pairedNow names it: translate both exactly the same way.

english: Operate this station from here? Nexus closes and starts again driving it over this network, and this computer’s own station stays off until you press Leave.
chinese: 要从此处操作该台站？Nexus 将关闭并重新启动，改为经此网络驱动该台站；在你按“离开”之前，此电脑自身的台站会保持关闭。

english: As the station shows it, like {{example}}, or its computer’s name, like {{name}}.
chinese: 按台站显示的样子输入，例如 {{example}}，或其电脑名称，例如 {{name}}。

english: No computer on this network answers to that name. Check the name, or type the station’s address as it shows it.
chinese: 此网络上没有电脑响应此名称。请核对名称，或输入台站显示的地址。

notes: The same English text "Clear" is used by 16 different keys (e.g. logEntry.clear.label, logbook.search.clear, logbook.tools.bulk.clear) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Save" is used by 11 different keys (e.g. logEntry.sent.moved.save, settings.panel.save, settings.profiles.save.action) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Not now" is used by 6 different keys (e.g. reveal.notNow, update.notNow.label, remote.approval.notNow) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Operate runs Nexus here and works the radio from your own clicks and pop-outs. Streaming only shows a picture of the station’s screen.
chinese: “操作”会在此处运行 Nexus，用你自己的点击和弹窗来操作电台。“串流”只显示台站屏幕的图像。

english: Nexus is closing, to start again driving the station…
chinese: Nexus 正在关闭，以便重新启动并驱动该台站…

english: Internet road added (Beta): Operate from this computer uses it when this station is not on this network.
chinese: 已添加互联网通路（测试版）：当该台站不在此网络时，“从此电脑操作”会使用它。

english: Sign in to Nexus Remote in your web browser, so Operate from this computer can reach this station over the internet when it is not on this network.
chinese: 在你的网页浏览器中登录 Nexus Remote，这样当该台站不在此网络时，“从此电脑操作”可以通过互联网访问它。

english: Finish signing in to Nexus Remote in your web browser, then come back here.
chinese: 请在你的网页浏览器中完成 Nexus Remote 登录，然后回到此处。

english: Internet road added. Approve this computer at the station, under Remote access, before you use it, and only if the station shows this computer’s key: {{key}}.
chinese: 已添加互联网通路。使用前请先在台站的“远程访问”中批准此电脑，且仅当台站显示的密钥与此一致时才批准：{{key}}。
notes: In the Stations on this network window, once the internet road is added and while the station has not approved this computer. "Remote access" is the station's own settings section. {{key}} is this computer's key for that road as a short fingerprint, like 9F8E 7D6C 5B4A 3928 9F8E 7D6C 5B4A 3928; Nexus at the station shows the same one when it asks to approve this computer, and the operator compares the two.

english: This computer’s key for the internet road: {{key}}
chinese: 此电脑在互联网通路上的密钥：{{key}}
notes: On a station's row in the Stations on this network window, once the internet road is added. {{key}} is this computer's key for that road as a short fingerprint, like 9F8E 7D6C 5B4A 3928 9F8E 7D6C 5B4A 3928; Nexus at the station shows the same one when it asks to approve this computer, and under Remote access ▸ Your computers.

english: This station’s key for the internet road: {{key}}
chinese: 该台站在互联网通路上的密钥：{{key}}

english: Check this key before the internet road carries anything. At the station, under Remote access, “This station’s key” must show the same groups. Until you say it matches, Operate from this computer does not use the internet road.
chinese: 在互联网通路传输任何数据前请核对密钥。在台站的“远程访问”下，“该台站的密钥”必须显示相同的分组。在你确认一致之前，“从此电脑操作”不会使用互联网通路。

english: Check this key before the internet road carries anything. At the station, under Remote access, “This station’s key” must show the same groups. Until you say it matches, Operate from this computer does not use the internet road. Operating from this computer on the station’s own network checks it too: when the station shows this same key there, the internet road comes on by itself.
chinese: 在互联网通路传输任何数据前请核对密钥。在台站的“远程访问”下，“该台站的密钥”必须显示相同的分组。在你确认一致之前，“从此电脑操作”不会使用互联网通路。若在台站自身网络上从此电脑操作，也会自动核对：当台站显示相同密钥时，互联网通路会自动启用。

english: The service gave a different key for this station than the station itself. This internet road is off. Forget the station here and add it again.
chinese: 服务为该台站给出的密钥与台站自身的不一致。该互联网通路已关闭。请在此忘记该台站后重新添加。

english: Remove this station’s internet road? Its pairing on this network stays, so Operate from this computer still works here. To add the internet road again later, use “Sign in…” on this row.
chinese: 移除该台站的互联网通路？它在此网络上的配对会保留，因此“从此电脑操作”仍可在此使用。日后若需重新添加互联网通路，请使用该行的“登录…”。
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Sign in…" is the on-screen text of lanWindow.signIn. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: The service gave a different key for this station than the station itself. Nothing was added.
chinese: 服务为该台站给出的密钥与台站自身的不一致。未添加任何内容。

english: The internet road is part of Nexus Remote’s paid service, and your account does not include it now. Operating on this network stays free.
chinese: 互联网通路属于 Nexus Remote 的付费服务，你的账户当前不包含它。在此网络上操作仍免费。

english: Nexus Remote does not take sign-ins from Nexus yet. Try again after an update.
chinese: Nexus Remote 尚不接受来自 Nexus 的登录。请在更新后重试。

english: Another program is using port 42078, which Nexus signs in through. Close it, then try again.
chinese: 另一个程序正在使用端口 42078，而 Nexus 通过它登录。请关闭它后重试。

english: The sign-in was not finished within five minutes. Try again.
chinese: 登录未在五分钟内完成。请重试。

english: Confirm your email address with the link Nexus Remote sent you, then sign in again.
chinese: 请用 Nexus Remote 发送的链接确认你的邮箱地址，然后重新登录。

english: The sign-in did not finish. Try again.
notes: The same English text "The sign-in did not finish. Try again." is used by 2 different keys (e.g. remote.account.signInFailed) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: A sign-in is already waiting in your web browser.
chinese: 已有一个登录正在你的网页浏览器中等待。

english: No station was picked, so the internet road was not added.
chinese: 未选择台站，因此未添加互联网通路。

english: Your Nexus Remote account has more than one station. Pick the one you paired with here.
chinese: 你的 Nexus Remote 账户有多个台站。请选择在此配对的那个。

english: Forgotten on this computer, but Nexus Remote could not be told. At the station, remove this computer under Remote access ▸ Devices.
chinese: 已在此电脑上忘记，但未能通知 Nexus Remote。请在台站的“远程访问”▸“设备”下移除此电脑。

english: The internet road was removed on this computer and the pairing on this network was kept, but Nexus Remote could not be told. At the station, remove this computer under Remote access ▸ Devices.
chinese: 已在此电脑上移除互联网通路并保留了此网络上的配对，但未能通知 Nexus Remote。请在台站的“远程访问”▸“设备”下移除此电脑。

english: The station has eight devices already. Remove one at the station, then try again.
chinese: 该台站已有八台设备。请在台站移除一台后重试。

english: Your Remote account has no station that can take this computer. Check that the station is linked to your account.
chinese: 你的远程账户没有可接收此电脑的台站。请确认该台站已关联到你的账户。

english: The station has not given Nexus Remote its key yet. Turn Remote on at the station, then try again.
chinese: 该台站尚未将其密钥提供给 Nexus Remote。请在台站开启远程后重试。

english: Nexus Remote did not answer. Check this computer’s internet connection, then try again.
chinese: Nexus Remote 没有响应。请检查此电脑的互联网连接后重试。

english: Nexus Remote asked to wait. Try again in a minute.
chinese: Nexus Remote 要求稍候。请一分钟后重试。

english: Nexus Remote refused this sign-in. Sign in with the account the station is linked to.
chinese: Nexus Remote 拒绝了此次登录。请用该台站所关联的账户登录。

english: That station is on this computer already, paired with a code. Sign in once more to link it to your account.
chinese: 该台站已在此电脑上，且是通过验证码配对的。请再登录一次以将其关联到你的账户。

notes: The same English text "Pair again…" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. client.banner.pairAgain) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The station did not take this computer last time. Pair it again: at the station, press Pair a computer, then type the code it shows here.
chinese: 上次台站未接收此电脑。请重新配对：在台站按“配对其他电脑”，然后在此输入它显示的验证码。

notes: The same English text "Connect to my station" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. lanWindow.connect.start) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Nexus looks for your station on this network first. If it isn’t here, sign in with your Nexus Remote account to reach it over the internet.
chinese: Nexus 会先在此网络上查找你的台站。若不在，请用你的 Nexus Remote 账户登录以通过互联网访问它。

english: Looking for your station on this network…
chinese: 正在此网络上查找你的台站…

english: Found {{name}} at {{address}}. This computer isn’t paired with it yet: at the station, press Pair a computer, then type the code it shows here.
chinese: 在 {{address}} 找到 {{name}}。此电脑尚未与其配对：请在台站按“配对其他电脑”，然后在此输入它显示的验证码。

english: More than one station answered on this network. Which one is yours?
chinese: 此网络上有多个台站响应。哪个是你的？

english: Your station did not answer on this network.
chinese: 你的台站未在此网络上响应。

english: Sign in to reach it over the internet
chinese: 登录以通过互联网访问

notes: The same English text "Connect to my station" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. lanWindow.connect.title) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Advanced: the stations on this computer, an address, a code
chinese: 高级：此电脑上的台站、地址、验证码

english: Sign in with the Nexus Remote account your station is linked to, or one its owner invited to operate it. The station is then on this computer, on its network and over the internet, with no code to type.
chinese: 用你台站所关联的 Nexus Remote 账户登录，或用其所有者邀请来操作它的账户。之后该台站就会出现在此电脑上，既在其网络中也可经互联网访问，无需输入验证码。

english: For a station whose owner has not signed in to Nexus Remote at the station yet.
chinese: 适用于所有者尚未在台站上登录 Nexus Remote 的情况。

english: Your Nexus Remote account has more than one station. Pick the one to add to this computer.
chinese: 你的 Nexus Remote 账户有多个台站。请选择要添加到本机的那个。

english: Nexus did not find the station on this network. Type its address as the station shows it under Remote over this network, or its computer’s name.
chinese: Nexus 未在此网络上找到台站。请按台站在“经此网络使用远程”下显示的地址输入，或输入其电脑名称。
notes: Names another control: "Remote over this network" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.switch. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: Signed in. Operate from this computer reaches the station on its network, and over the internet when it is not there.
chinese: 已登录。“从此电脑操作”可在台站所在网络上访问它，不在同一网络时则经互联网访问。
notes: Names another control: "Operate from this computer" is the on-screen text of lanWindow.operate. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: Signed in with your Nexus Remote account. The station takes this computer on its network until {{date}}.
chinese: 已用你的 Nexus Remote 账户登录。台站会在其网络上接收此电脑，有效期至 {{date}}。
notes: {{date}} is a day written YYYY-MM-DD; keep it as it is.

english: Sign in again by {{date}} to keep operating this station on its network.
chinese: 请在 {{date}} 前重新登录，以便继续在台站网络上操作它。
notes: {{date}} is a day written YYYY-MM-DD; keep it as it is.

english: That station is on this computer already. To link it to your account, press Link to your account on its row.
chinese: 该台站已在此电脑上。要关联到你的账户，请在其行上按“关联到你的账户”。

english: You were invited to listen only. Nexus on this computer would operate the station, so it was not added. Listen in your web browser instead.
chinese: 你被邀请的权限仅为收听。此电脑上的 Nexus 会操作该台站，因此未添加。请改用网页浏览器收听。

english: Your station has not signed in to Nexus Remote yet. At the station, press Sign in to Nexus Remote (Settings → Remote), then try again here.
chinese: 你的台站尚未登录 Nexus Remote。请在台站按“登录 Nexus Remote”（设置 → 远程），然后在此重试。

english: Nexus could not confirm that the station Nexus Remote lists is yours, so it was not added. Sign in again at the station, then try again here.
chinese: Nexus 无法确认 Nexus Remote 列出的该台站属于你，因此未添加。请在台站重新登录，然后在此重试。

english: The station was not found on this network, so it was not added. Sign in again from a computer on the station’s network.
chinese: 未在此网络上找到该台站，因此未添加。请在台站所在网络中的电脑上重新登录。

english: The station is not taking sign-ins on its network. At the station, check that it is signed in to Nexus Remote and that Remote over this network is on.
chinese: 该台站未在其网络上接受登录。请在台站确认它已登录 Nexus Remote，且“经此网络使用远程”已开启。
notes: Names another control: "Remote over this network" is the on-screen text of remote.lan.switch. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: The station did not take this sign-in. Sign in with the account the station belongs to, or ask its owner to invite you.
chinese: 台站未接受此次登录。请用该台站所属的账户登录，或请其所有者邀请你。

english: The station could not check this sign-in. Make sure the station and this computer run the same Nexus, then try again.
chinese: 台站无法核验此次登录。请确认台站与此电脑运行相同版本的 Nexus 后重试。

english: The station could not keep this computer. Check the station’s credential store, then try again.
chinese: 台站无法保存此电脑信息。请检查台站的凭据存储后重试。

english: Another computer answered at that address, not your station. Check the address.
chinese: 该地址响应的是另一台电脑，不是你的台站。请核对地址。

english: Not reached on its own network yet: Operate from this computer uses the internet (Beta). On the station’s network, press Sign in on this network once to use it there too.
chinese: 尚未在其自身网络上访问到：“从此电脑操作”将使用互联网（测试版）。在台站所在网络上按一次“在此网络上登录”即可在那里也使用。

english: Signed in. The station was not found on this network, so it is added over the internet: Operate from this computer uses the internet (Beta) until you sign in here on the station’s network.
chinese: 已登录。此网络上未找到该台站，因此经互联网添加：“从此电脑操作”将使用互联网（测试版），直到你在台站所在网络上在此登录。
notes: Names another control: "Operate from this computer" is the on-screen text of lanWindow.operate. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: The station was not found on this network, so it stays on this computer over the internet.
chinese: 此网络上未找到该台站，因此它在本次电脑上仍经互联网使用。

english: Operate this station from here? Nexus closes and starts again driving it over the internet, and this computer’s own station stays off until you press Leave.
chinese: 要从此处操作该台站？Nexus 将关闭并重新启动，改为经互联网驱动该台站；在你按“离开”之前，此电脑自身的台站会保持关闭。
正在连接 {{station}} 上的台站…

english: Operating the station at {{station}} over this network.
chinese: 正在经此网络操作 {{station}} 上的台站。

english: Not live: the link to the station at {{station}} dropped. The screens show it as it last was, and Nexus connects again by itself.
chinese: 未连通：与 {{station}} 上台站的链路已中断。界面显示的是它最后的状态，Nexus 会自动重连。

english: Another device is operating the station at {{station}}.
chinese: 另一台设备正在操作 {{station}} 上的台站。

english: The station at {{station}} did not take this computer. {{reason}}
chinese: {{station}} 上的台站未接收此电脑。{{reason}}

english: Start Nexus again as this computer’s own station
chinese: 重新启动 Nexus，作为此电脑自身的台站

notes: The same English text "Pair again…" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. lanWindow.pairAgain) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Leave, and open Stations on this network to pair this computer with the station again
chinese: 离开，并打开“此网络上的台站”以将此电脑与该台站重新配对

english: Nexus here and at the station are two builds of the same version. Install the same build on both computers.
chinese: 此处与台站上的 Nexus 是同一版本的两个不同构建。请在两台电脑上安装相同的构建。

english: This computer runs Nexus {{computer}} and the station runs Nexus {{station}}. Update Nexus at the station to {{computer}}, and this computer connects again by itself.
chinese: 此电脑运行 Nexus {{computer}}，台站运行 Nexus {{station}}。请把台站上的 Nexus 更新为 {{computer}}，此电脑会自动重连。

english: This computer runs Nexus {{computer}} and the station runs Nexus {{station}}. Update Nexus on this computer to {{station}}, and it connects again by itself.
chinese: 此电脑运行 Nexus {{computer}}，台站运行 Nexus {{station}}。请把此电脑上的 Nexus 更新为 {{station}}，它会自动重连。

english: This computer runs Nexus {{computer}} and the station runs Nexus {{station}}: two builds of the same version. Install the same build on both computers.
chinese: 此电脑运行 Nexus {{computer}}，台站运行 Nexus {{station}}：同一版本的两个不同构建。请在两台电脑上安装相同的构建。

english: Nexus at the station has not given this computer control. Allow it there.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus 尚未授予此电脑控制权。请在那里允许。

english: Nexus at the station gave a reason this computer cannot read.
chinese: 台站上的 Nexus 给出的原因此电脑无法读取。

english: Operating the station over the internet (Beta).
chinese: 正在经互联网操作该台站（测试版）。

english: Not live: the internet link to the station dropped. The screens show it as it last was, and Nexus connects again by itself.
chinese: 未连通：与台站的互联网链路已中断。界面显示的是它最后的状态，Nexus 会自动重连。

english: Another device is operating the station.
chinese: 另一台设备正在操作该台站。

english: Connecting to the station over the internet (Beta)…
chinese: 正在经互联网连接台站（测试版）…

english: The station did not take this computer over the internet. {{reason}}
chinese: 台站未接收此电脑的互联网连接。{{reason}}
notes: {{reason}} is a whole sentence saying why the station did not take this computer.

english: Another computer took control of the station. Nothing here is transmitting.
chinese: 另一台电脑接管了该台站。此处没有任何发射。

english: This ends the other computer’s operating: anything it is transmitting stops now.
chinese: 这会结束另一台电脑的操作：它正在进行的任何发射会立即停止。

notes: The same English text "Cancel" is used by 30 different keys (e.g. logEntry.sent.moved.cancel, logbook.import.preview.cancel, logbook.parkStates.cancel) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Still there? The internet link ends in a minute unless you click.
chinese: 还在吗？若你不点击，互联网链路将在一分钟后结束。

english: This network lets no audio or second Stop road through: you can watch, tune and log, and transmitting from here is off.
chinese: 此网络不允许音频或第二条停止通路通过：你可以查看、调谐和记日志，但从此处发射已关闭。

english: Signing in again, so this computer keeps operating the station on its network: finish in your web browser.
chinese: 正在重新登录，以便此电脑继续在其网络上操作该台站：请在网页浏览器中完成。

english: Sign in again by {{date}} in Stations on this network to keep operating this station on its network.
chinese: 请在 {{date}} 前于“此网络上的台站”中重新登录，以便继续在台站网络上操作它。
notes: {{date}} is a day written YYYY-MM-DD; keep it as it is. Names another control: "Stations on this network" is the on-screen text of lanWindow.title. Translate the name and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: Nobody answered “Still there?”, so the internet link ended.
chinese: 无人回应“还在吗？”，互联网链路已结束。

english: The internet road is part of Nexus Remote’s paid service, and your account does not include it now. Operating on the station’s own network stays free.
chinese: 互联网通路属于 Nexus Remote 的付费服务，你的账户当前不包含它。在台站自身网络上操作仍免费。

english: The station has not approved this computer for the internet road, or removed it. Approve it there, or add the road again.
chinese: 台站未批准此电脑使用互联网通路，或已将其移除。请在那里批准，或重新添加通路。

english: The internet road waits until you check the station’s key. In Stations on this network, compare it with the station’s screen.
chinese: 在你核对台站密钥之前，互联网通路会等待。请在“此网络上的台站”中与台站屏幕比对。

english: The service gave a different key for this station than the station itself, so its internet road is off.
chinese: 服务为该台站给出的密钥与台站自身的不一致，因此其互联网通路已关闭。

english: This computer waits for approval at the station, under Remote access.
chinese: 此电脑正在等待台站的批准，位于“远程访问”下。

english: Nexus Remote cannot take this computer yet.
chinese: Nexus Remote 尚无法接收此电脑。

english: Nexus Remote no longer has this station on your account.
chinese: Nexus Remote 的你的账户中已无此台站。

english: Nexus Remote did not answer. Nexus tries again by itself.
chinese: Nexus Remote 没有响应。Nexus 会自动重试。

english: Nexus Remote asked to wait. Nexus tries again by itself.
chinese: Nexus Remote 要求稍候。Nexus 会自动重试。
Nexus Remote 拒绝了此电脑。

english: The internet link closed. Nexus tries again by itself.
chinese: 互联网链路已关闭。Nexus 会自动重试。
空中断开 {{count}} 次，共 {{seconds}} 秒
notes: Plural form "one" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101.

chinese: 空中断开 {{count}} 次，共 {{seconds}} 秒
notes: Plural form "other" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101. Plural form "few" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101.

chinese: 空中断开 {{count}} 次，共 {{seconds}} 秒
notes: Plural form "other" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101. Plural form "many" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101.

chinese: 空中断开 {{count}} 次，共 {{seconds}} 秒
notes: Plural form "other" — Russian has four rows per key: ::one (1, 21, 31, 101…), ::few (2–4, 22–24…), ::many (0, 5–20, 25–30…) and ::other (fractions). ::one must carry {{count}} if the English does, because it also fires on 21 and 101.

english: No word from the station: your over may have ended.
chinese: 台站没有反馈：你的发段可能已结束。

english: The station isn't in a phone mode.
Transmit isn't switched on at the station.
This frequency is outside your licence.
chinese: 该频率超出你的执照范围。

english: Another device is holding the transmitter.
chinese: 另一台设备正占用发射机。

english: The station is fixing its clock.
Listening and tuning only. Transmit waits for you to press Allow to transmit at the shack.
chinese: 仅收听与调谐。发射需你在台站按“允许发射”。

english: Listening and tuning only. Transmit waits for you to press Allow to transmit at the shack, or about {{minutes}} min.
chinese: 仅收听与调谐。发射需你在台站按“允许发射”，或等待约 {{minutes}} 分钟。

english: The link to the station dropped.
No microphone is set on this computer.
No microphone audio is reaching the station.
chinese: 没有话筒音频到达台站。

english: Your over ended: your audio did not reach the station for 0.2 s.
chinese: 你的发段已结束：音频有 0.2 秒未到达台站。

english: Your over ended: your PTT did not reach the station for 0.2 s.
chinese: 你的发段已结束：PTT 有 0.2 秒未到达台站。

english: Your over ended: it was stopped at the station.
chinese: 你的发段已结束：在台站被停止。

english: Your over ended: the station stopped hearing from this computer.
chinese: 你的发段已结束：台站不再收到此电脑的消息。

english: Your over ended: it reached the 10-minute limit.
chinese: 你的发段已结束：达到 10 分钟上限。

english: Your over ended: the station's TX watchdog stopped it.
chinese: 你的发段已结束：台站的发射看门狗将其停止。

english: Your over ended: the station's transmit audio changed.
chinese: 你的发段已结束：台站的发射音频发生变化。

english: The station did not take your PTT.

notes: The same English text "Normal" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.textSize.normal, settings.digital.decodeDepth.normal) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Test build: this computer is blocking its command link to the station.
chinese: 测试构建：此电脑正在阻断其到台站的命令链路。

english: Test build: this computer is blocking its Stop road to the station.
chinese: 测试构建：此电脑正在阻断其到台站的停止通路。

notes: The same English text "Audio" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.audio.legend) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: This computer's own, for the station it operates over this network: kept here, never sent to the station.
chinese: 此电脑自身的设置，用于其经此网络操作的台站：保存在本机，绝不发送到台站。

notes: The same English text "System default" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.audio.device.systemDefault) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Where you hear the station's receiver.
chinese: 你收听台站接收机的地方。

english: The audio output would not open: {{why}}

notes: The same English text "Volume" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. remote.audio.volume) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: How loud the station is heard here, over the level it keeps for its decoders. It changes nothing at the station.
chinese: 此处听到台站的音量，叠加在台站为其解码器保留的电平之上。不会改变台站的任何设置。

english: What you talk into when you transmit from here. Nexus opens it only while it is needed.
chinese: 从此处发射时你讲话所用的话筒。Nexus 仅在需要时打开它。

english: Speak normally: the bar should move well into the middle.
chinese: 正常说话：条形图应明显进入中段。

notes: The same English text "Test" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.connections.qrz.test.action, settings.js8.sound.test.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The test tone could not play.
This computer's audio did not start, so the station's audio cannot be heard here.
chinese: 此电脑的音频未能启动，因此此处听不到台站音频。

english: This computer could not keep that choice. Try again.
chinese: 此电脑无法保存该选择。请重试。

english: This build has no place for that command, so nothing was sent to the station.
chinese: 此版本没有该命令的处理位置，因此未向台站发送任何内容。

english: That runs on this computer, not at the station.
chinese: 该操作在此电脑上运行，不在台站上。

english: That can only be done at the station, on its own screen.
chinese: 该操作只能在台站本机的屏幕上完成。

english: That transmission is not available from this computer yet.
chinese: 该发射操作暂不支持从此电脑进行。

english: This computer’s PTT reaches the station another way. Nothing was sent.
chinese: 此电脑的 PTT 通过另一条通路到达台站。未发送任何内容。

english: Transmitting from here needs the second Stop link to the station, and this connection has none. Nothing was sent.
chinese: 从此处发射需要到台站的第二条停止链路，而当前连接没有。未发送任何内容。

english: The station has not heard this computer’s Stop link in the last 5 seconds, so it takes no transmission from here. Nothing was sent.
chinese: 台站在最近 5 秒内未收到此电脑的停止链路，因此不接受来自此处的发射。未发送任何内容。

english: What this screen shows of the station is more than 2 seconds old, so the station takes no transmission from here until it catches up. Nothing was sent.
chinese: 此屏幕显示的台站状态已超过 2 秒未更新，因此在其跟上之前台站不接受来自此处的发射。未发送任何内容。

english: Your PTT press has ended. Let go of PTT and press again to talk.
chinese: 你的 PTT 按压已结束。请松开 PTT 后再次按下讲话。

english: Lock ended at its time limit: nobody answered “Still talking?”. Click PTT to let go, then again to talk.
chinese: 锁定已达时间上限：无人回应“还在说吗？”。请点击 PTT 松开，再次点击以讲话。

english: A voice message is being recorded on this computer. Stop the recording, then press PTT.
chinese: 此电脑正在录制语音消息。请停止录音后再按 PTT。

english: The PTT is held on this computer. Let go of PTT, then record.
chinese: 此电脑的 PTT 处于按住状态。请松开 PTT 后再录制。

english: A password typed here is never sent: the station uses the one it has stored.
chinese: 在此输入的密码绝不会被发送：台站使用其已保存的密码。

english: Another device has control of the station.
chinese: 另一台设备控制着该台站。

english: The station is busy with this computer’s other requests. Try again.
chinese: 台站正忙于此电脑的其他请求。请重试。

english: Too many requests at once for the station. Try again.
chinese: 对台站的请求过于频繁。请重试。

english: The station had that request already, and did not run it again.
chinese: 台站已收到过该请求，未再次执行。

english: Changed at the station. Reload and save again.
chinese: 已在台站更改。请重新加载后再保存。

english: The station could not read that request.
Transmit was stopped after you pressed this, so the station did not do it. Press it again if you still want it.
chinese: 你按下此操作后发射被停止，因此台站未执行它。若仍需要，请再按一次。

english: That is too large to send to the station.
chinese: 内容过大，无法发送到台站。

english: The link to the station dropped before it answered. Check at the station whether it happened.
chinese: 台站尚未回应，与它的链路就已中断。请在台站核实该操作是否已发生。

english: This network blocks the roads Stop and audio need, so transmitting from here is off. Nothing was sent.
chinese: 此网络阻断了“停止”和音频所需的通路，因此此处发射已关闭。未发送任何内容。

english: What you typed on this card has not been saved.
chinese: 你在该卡片上输入的内容尚未保存。

english: {{label}} cannot be emptied here: the log keeps the stored value when the box is empty. Type a new value, or put the old one back.
chinese: {{label}} 无法在此清空：当输入框为空时，日志会保留已存的值。请输入新值，或把原值填回。

english: The date and start time must be a UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a 24-hour time (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS).
chinese: 日期和开始时间必须是 UTC 日期（YYYY-MM-DD）与 24 小时制时间（HH:MM 或 HH:MM:SS）。

english: The end time must be a 24-hour UTC time (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS).
chinese: 结束时间必须是 24 小时制 UTC 时间（HH:MM 或 HH:MM:SS）。

english: The frequency must be a number of MHz.
chinese: 频率必须是 MHz 数值。

english: TX power must be a number of watts.
{{tag}} is not an ADIF field name: use capitals, digits and _ only.
chinese: {{tag}} 不是 ADIF 字段名：只能使用大写字母、数字和 _。

english: {{tag}} is part of this contact's contest exchange, shown below: exports, uploads and awards read it from there, so it cannot be changed here.
chinese: {{tag}} 属于本次联络的竞赛交换信息，见下方：导出、上传和奖项都从那里读取，因此不能在此修改。

english: Imported with a date only: no time of day was recorded. Leave the box empty to keep it that way.
chinese: 导入时只有日期：未记录具体时刻。留空可保持原样。

english: Every other ADIF field this contact carries. The satellite, the DXCC entity, the station callsign and the operator are changed from the list (SAT, the country, Bulk edit); confirmations and uploads are the services'.
chinese: 本次联络携带的其他所有 ADIF 字段。卫星、DXCC 实体、台站呼号和操作员请从列表修改（SAT、国家、批量编辑）；确认与上传属于各服务。

notes: The same English text "Field" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. topbar.field.label, logbook.tools.bulk.field) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Value" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. logbook.tools.bulk.value) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Add a field" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. logbook.tools.bulk.add) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "QSL" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. logbook.column.qsl, logbook.columns.group.qsl) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Open this contact on the card
Read only here: contacts are edited at the station.
chinese: 此处只读：联络需在台站编辑。

english: Saving takes off what belonged to {{old}}: {{fields}}. Undo puts it back.
chinese: 保存会移除原属于 {{old}} 的内容：{{fields}}。撤销可恢复。

english: Already uploaded to LoTW — not sent again: {{fields}}
chinese: 已上传至 LoTW — 不再重复发送：{{fields}}

notes: The same English text "Cancel" is used by 30 different keys (e.g. logEntry.sent.moved.cancel, logbook.import.preview.cancel, logbook.parkStates.cancel) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Award status" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. awards.status.head) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Only this contact’s {{award}} status changes (CREDIT_SUBMITTED / CREDIT_GRANTED). Nothing is sent. Undo it from the History below.
chinese: 只改变本次联络的 {{award}} 状态（CREDIT_SUBMITTED / CREDIT_GRANTED）。不会发送任何内容。可在下方“历史”中撤销。

english: Marked {{freq}} for {{call}} on the band map
chinese: 已在波段图上为 {{call}} 标记 {{freq}}

english: Frequency markers belong to a contest: turn Contest mode on to mark a frequency.
chinese: 频率标记属于竞赛功能：请开启竞赛模式后再标记频率。

english: Not while transmitting: tuning now would move your signal on the air. Try again when the over ends.
chinese: 发射期间不可操作：此时调谐会把你的信号在空中的位置移走。请在发段结束后再试。

english: Not marked: the dial is outside the amateur bands.
chinese: 未标记：当前频率不在业余波段内。

english: That marker is gone: its call was logged on this band, or it was removed.
chinese: 该标记已不存在：其呼号已在本波段记录，或标记已被移除。

english: No activation running. Start one on the POTA / SOTA view.
chinese: 没有进行中的激活。请在 POTA / SOTA 视图中启动一个。
