chinese: 台站未进入 {{contest}}。你的填写已还原，{{running}} 已重新开启。

english: The station did not enter {{contest}}, and putting the earlier settings back failed: {{error}}. Contest mode may still be saved on: check Settings ▸ Contesting.
chinese: 台站未进入 {{contest}}，且还原先前设置失败：{{error}}。竞赛模式可能仍处于保存开启状态：请检查 设置 ▸ 竞赛。

notes: The same English text "Back" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. radioSetup.nav.back) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Next" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. sat.strip.next.label, radioSetup.nav.next) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Cancel" is used by 30 different keys (e.g. logEntry.sent.moved.cancel, logbook.import.preview.cancel, logbook.parkStates.cancel) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Close" is used by 10 different keys (e.g. logbook.import.done.close, logbook.form.close, logbook.qrzCorrect.close) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: {{contest}} is not running now. It was stopped while this setup was open.
chinese: {{contest}} 当前未进行。它在此设置打开期间被停止了。

english: The running contest changed while this setup was open. Check it here, then go on.
chinese: 此设置打开期间进行中的竞赛已变化。请在此核对后再继续。

english: Nothing was saved: the station could not say whether a contest is running now. Try again.
chinese: 未保存任何内容：台站无法说明当前是否有竞赛进行。请重试。

english: The station did not enter {{contest}}: {{reason}} Your answers were put back. Contest mode was already saved on, so the station tries again at the next save.
chinese: 台站未进入 {{contest}}：{{reason}} 你的填写已还原。竞赛模式此前已保存为开启，因此台站会在下次保存时重试。

english: The station did not enter {{contest}}. Your answers were put back. Contest mode was already saved on, so the station tries again at the next save.
chinese: 台站未进入 {{contest}}。你的填写已还原。竞赛模式此前已保存为开启，因此台站会在下次保存时重试。

english: The station could not check this exchange. Change a field to try again.
chinese: 台站无法校验该交换信息。请修改某个字段后重试。

english: Your move took effect: you send {{exchange}}. Saving the other changes failed: {{error}}.
chinese: 你的改频已生效：你发送 {{exchange}}。其他更改保存失败：{{error}}。

notes: The same English text "Spot me" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. ota.selfSpot.button) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Post ONE spot of your call on this frequency to the DX cluster, with the comment beside it. Once per press; then a {{secs}} s wait.
chinese: 把你在该频率上的呼号作为一条台站报告发到 DX 集群，附上旁边的备注。每次按下仅发一条，之后需等待 {{secs}} 秒。
已播报到 DX 集群：{{line}}

english: Not spotted: set your callsign in Settings first.
chinese: 未播报：请先在设置中填写你的呼号。

english: Not spotted: no DX cluster is connected. Set a cluster in Settings ▸ Logging & Connectors ▸ Integrations & Feeds ▸ Spot Sources.
chinese: 未播报：未连接任何 DX 集群。请在 设置 ▸ 日志与连接器 ▸ 集成与数据源 ▸ 台站报告源 中配置集群。

english: Not spotted again yet: one spot a minute. {{secs}} s to go.
chinese: 暂不能再次播报：每分钟一条。还需 {{secs}} 秒。

english: Not spotted: the dial is outside the amateur bands.
chinese: 未播报：当前频率不在业余波段内。

english: Not spotted: Contest mode is off.
chinese: 未播报：竞赛模式已关闭。

english: Not spotted: this contest's rules allow no spotting.
chinese: 未播报：本竞赛规则不允许播报。

english: Not spotted: this contest allows spotting only over amateur radio while it runs.
chinese: 未播报：本竞赛在比赛期间仅允许通过业余无线电播报。

english: Not spotted: the DX cluster did not take the spot.
chinese: 未播报：DX 集群未接受该报告。

english: This contest may not allow self-spotting. Press Spot anyway within {{secs}} s to post.
chinese: 本竞赛可能不允许自我播报。若仍要播报，请在 {{secs}} 秒内按“仍然播报”。

notes: The same English text "Your entry" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. contestSetup.entry.title) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Contesting. The same English text "Contest" is used by 11 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.looks.contest, nav.fieldDay.label, features.fieldDay.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 显示已发 RST 输入框

english: Adds an RST sent box to the contest entry, beside the received report. It shows the report each contact logs as sent (59 on phone, 599 on CW and digital), and a report typed there is logged for that contact only. Space and Tab skip it. It shows only in contests whose exchange sends a report.
chinese: 在竞赛录入区、接收报告旁边增加一个已发 RST 输入框。它显示每次联络记录为已发送的报告（电话 59，CW 与数字 599）；在此输入的只会记入该次联络。空格和 Tab 可跳过它。仅在交换信息包含信号报告的竞赛中显示。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Contesting. The same English text "Contest" is used by 11 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.looks.contest, nav.fieldDay.label, features.fieldDay.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Which contest you are entering. It decides the exchange, what counts as a duplicate, and how the log is scored — so the setup below belongs to the one you pick.
chinese: 你参加的是哪个竞赛。它决定交换信息、何为重复，以及日志如何计分 — 因此下方设置都属于你所选的那个。

english: Contest mode is on for {{contest}}. Saving a different pick ends it and starts the new one at once, without calling CQ. Each contest keeps its own contacts.
chinese: {{contest}} 的竞赛模式已开启。保存其他选择会立即结束它并开始新的竞赛，且不会呼叫 CQ。每个竞赛的联络各自保存。

english: Your station is {{role}}. Your location decides this, so moving across the line changes it.
chinese: 你的台站角色为 {{role}}。这由你的位置决定，跨过州界即会改变。

english: This contest works the same way for everyone, so there is no role to choose. Contests with an in-state and an out-of-state side will show yours here.
chinese: 本竞赛对所有参与者规则相同，因此无需选择角色。含州内与州外两方的竞赛会在此显示你的角色。

english: How many operators are at this station
What your Cabrillo log declares about the station. Pick CHECKLOG if you are sending the log to help the sponsor check others rather than to be scored.
chinese: 你的 Cabrillo 日志对台站的声明。若你提交日志只是为帮助主办方核查他人而不参与评比，请选择 CHECKLOG。

english: Which power category you are entering
Whether your entry uses spotting assistance
chinese: 你的参赛是否使用播报辅助

english: Your log declares NON-ASSISTED, but Unassisted entry is off.
chinese: 你的日志声明为 NON-ASSISTED，但“无辅助参赛”未开启。
notes: “Unassisted entry” is the name of the switch below (settings.contestCategory.unassisted.label): use the same words.
“Unassisted entry” is the name of the switch below (settings.contestCategory.unassisted.label): use the same words.

english: Whether this is a school club station
chinese: 是否为学校俱乐部台站

notes: The same English text "Not set" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.station.experience.notSet, contestSetup.entry.unset) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The rest of what your Cabrillo log declares about the entry. Sweepstakes also sends these on the air, as the precedence letter, so it will not start until you have picked one of each: ARRL counts 5 watts or less as QRP, 100 watts or less as low power, and anything above that as high power, and an entry using spots, a skimmer or a cluster is Single Operator Unlimited.
chinese: 你的 Cabrillo 日志对参赛组别声明的其余内容。Sweepstakes 还会把它作为优先级字母在空中发送，因此在你为每一项都选定之前不会开始：ARRL 将 5 瓦及以下计为 QRP、100 瓦及以下计为低功率、超过则计为高功率；使用台站报告、skimmer 或集群的参赛组别为Single Operator Unlimited。
do_not_translate: Single Operator Unlimited | Single Operator | Sweepstakes | Cabrillo | ARRL | QRP

english: Winter Field Day takes QRP or LOW (its limit is 100 W PEP), and HIGH writes no CATEGORY-POWER line.
chinese: 冬季野外日仅接受 QRP 或 LOW（上限 100 W PEP），HIGH 不会写出 CATEGORY-POWER 行。

english: Goes on the EMAIL line of the Cabrillo log you export for a contest whose log has one (the CQ contests), so the sponsor can reach you about your entry. The NAME line is your operator name from the Station tab. Leave it blank to leave the line out.
chinese: 写入你导出的 Cabrillo 日志的 EMAIL 行（适用于日志含该行的竞赛，即 CQ 系列），便于主办方就你的参赛联系你。NAME 行取自“台站”页的操作员姓名。留空则省略该行。

english: The class the sponsor scores your entry in, from this contest's own rules, written on the ENTRY-CLASS line of the Cabrillo log. In the Illinois QSO Party a club running more than one transmitter at once enters UNLIMITED, and the high and low power classes split at 100 watts PEP. To certify a QRP entry, pick QRP under Power category.
chinese: 主办方按本竞赛自身规则为你评比的等级，写入 Cabrillo 日志的 ENTRY-CLASS 行。在伊利诺伊 QSO 聚会中，同时使用多部发射机的俱乐部参加 UNLIMITED，高功率与低功率等级以 100 瓦 PEP 为界。要证明 QRP 参赛，请在功率类别中选择 QRP。

notes: The same English text "Club" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. fieldDay.club.head) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Your contest club, for the CLUB line of the Cabrillo log when the contest's rules have one (the CQ contests, the Illinois QSO Party). Spell out the club's full name, as CQ asks. Leave it blank to leave the line out.
chinese: 你的竞赛俱乐部，用于竞赛规则含该行的 Cabrillo 日志 CLUB 行（CQ 系列、伊利诺伊 QSO 聚会）。请按 CQ 要求写出俱乐部全名。留空则省略该行。

english: The OPERATORS line of the Cabrillo log lists everyone who was set as Operator at the key when they logged a contact. Add anyone else here, as callsigns separated by spaces or commas.
chinese: Cabrillo 日志的 OPERATORS 行会列出记录联络时被设为“操作员”的所有人。此处可补充其他人，呼号之间用空格或逗号分隔。

english: Which multi-operator class you are entering

How many signals your multi-operator entry puts on the air at once, in the classes this contest's sponsor scores: ONE is one at a time (Multi-One, Multi-Single), TWO is Multi-Two, UNLIMITED is Multi-Multi, and LIMITED is the ARRL VHF contests' Limited Multioperator. It goes on the CATEGORY-TRANSMITTER line of the Cabrillo log, with the OPERATORS line the sponsor needs from a multi-operator entry. Nexus marks every contact as transmitter 0, so add the second transmitter's contacts to a Multi-Two log before you send it.
chinese: 你的多人参赛同时在空中的信号数，按本竞赛主办方评比的类别：ONE 为同时一个（多人单机、多人单发射机），TWO 为多人双机，UNLIMITED 为多人多机，LIMITED 为 ARRL VHF 竞赛的受限多人。它写入 Cabrillo 日志的 CATEGORY-TRANSMITTER 行，同时附上主办方要求多人参赛提供的 OPERATORS 行。Nexus 会把所有联络标记为发射机 0，因此在提交多人双机日志前，请自行补入第二台发射机的联络。

english: Which overlay category you are also entering

An extra category the sponsor scores beside your entry, for the CATEGORY-OVERLAY line, if you qualify under its rules (CQ's overlays are for single operators). For Rookie and Youth, CQ asks for the date you were first licensed or your birth year in the soapbox.
chinese: 在你参赛组别之外、主办方另行评比的附加类别，写入 CATEGORY-OVERLAY 行 — 前提是你符合其规则（CQ 的附加类别面向单人操作）。对 Rookie 与 Youth，CQ 要求在 soapbox 中写明首次获照日期或出生年份。

english: Where the sponsor can mail a certificate or plaque, for the ADDRESS lines of the Cabrillo log: the street here, one line each, and the rest in the boxes below. A part the sponsor's template has no line for goes on one more ADDRESS line, the way its template writes it. Leave it blank to leave the address out. Remote never sees it.
chinese: 主办方寄送证书或奖牌所用的地址，写入 Cabrillo 日志的 ADDRESS 行：街道在此，每行一条，其余填入下方各框。主办方模板中没有对应行的部分会再写一行 ADDRESS，按其模板的写法。留空则省略地址。远程功能永远不会看到它。

english: Which band category you are entering

ALL for an all-band entry, or the one band a single-band entry is entered on, for the CATEGORY-BAND line of the Cabrillo log. A single-band entry still logs every contact, other bands included, and the sponsor scores only the band named here. In the CQ contests a multi-operator entry is ALL. Leave it unset to leave the line out.
chinese: 全波段参赛选 ALL，单波段参赛选其所用的那一个波段，写入 Cabrillo 日志的 CATEGORY-BAND 行。单波段参赛仍会记录所有联络（含其他波段），主办方只评比此处指定的波段。在 CQ 系列中，多人参赛为 ALL。留空则省略该行。

english: Your comments on the contest, for the SOAPBOX lines of the Cabrillo log. Each line you type is a line there, and a long one is wrapped to fit. The California QSO Party asks for its award lines here (YL, YOUTH, MOBILE, NEW CONTESTER…). Leave it blank to leave it out.
chinese: 你对本竞赛的评论，写入 Cabrillo 日志的 SOAPBOX 行。你输入的每一行就是那里的一行，过长会自动折行。加州 QSO 聚会的评奖行（YL、YOUTH、MOBILE、NEW CONTESTER…）也在此填写。留空则省略。

english: What your station sends when a contest asks for it. Fill in the ones your contest uses — a QSO party wants your county or your state, Sweepstakes wants your check. Nothing here is guessed: an exchange that goes on the air has to be one you typed.
chinese: 竞赛需要时你的台站所发送的内容。请填写你参加的竞赛会用到的项 — QSO 聚会需要你的县或州，Sweepstakes 需要你的 check。这里绝不猜测：要发到空中的交换信息必须是你亲手输入的。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Contesting. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word. The same English text "County" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. logEntry.fd.county.label, logbook.column.county) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Your county, abbreviated the way the QSO party abbreviates it (Franklin is FRAN). Only in-state entries send this.
chinese: 你所在的县，按 QSO 聚会的缩写方式（Franklin 写作 FRAN）。仅州内参赛者发送此项。

english: Where your station is for this contest: your state, province or territory, two letters. This is not your ARRL section — Western New York is WNY as a section and NY as a state, and a QSO party wants the state. It is separate from the Station tab's State, the one your everyday macros send, so a portable or mobile entry can put here where it is operating.
chinese: 本竞赛中你的台站所在地：你的州、省或属地，两个字母。这不是你的 ARRL 分区 — 西纽约作为分区是 WNY、作为州是 NY，而 QSO 聚会要的是州。它独立于“台站”页的“州”（你日常宏所发送的那个），因此便携或移动参赛可在此填写实际作业地。

notes: The Check of the ARRL Sweepstakes exchange (the hint in the next row says what goes in it) — a contest term, not the verb. The same English text "Check" is used by 5 different keys (e.g. logEntry.fd.check.label, logbook.confirmations.check, logbook.tools.tab.check) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The last two digits of the year you were first licensed. Sweepstakes asks for it, and you send the same two digits all contest.
chinese: 你首次获照年份的后两位。Sweepstakes 要求此项，整个比赛中发送相同的两位数字。

notes: The same English text "CQ zone" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. logbook.column.cqz) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Your CQ zone, 1 to 40. CQ WW asks for it. Leave it at 0 if you do not know it yet.
chinese: 你的 CQ 分区，1 至 40。CQ WW 要求此项。若尚不清楚可保持 0。

notes: The same English text "ITU zone" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. logbook.column.ituz) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Your ITU zone, 1 to 90. IARU asks for it. Leave it at 0 if you do not know it yet.
chinese: 你的 ITU 分区，1 至 90。IARU 要求此项。若尚不清楚可保持 0。

english: The power you send as part of this contest’s exchange, in the sponsor’s own words (KW, 500, 5). It goes on the air exactly as you type it; the power your log declares is Power category, under Your entry.
chinese: 作为本竞赛交换信息一部分发送的功率，用主办方的原话（KW、500、5）。它会按你输入的原文发到空中；你的日志声明的功率则是“你的参赛”下的功率类别。

english: This score leaves out the bonus points this contest works out from your log — this build does not compute them, so what the sponsor credits you will be higher. Everything the log needs to be accepted is here; the number is not your claimed score.
chinese: 该比分未计入本竞赛依据你的日志计算出的奖励分 — 此版本不计算这些分数，因此主办方给你的分数会更高。日志被接受所需的全部内容都已在此；但这个数字不是你的申报总分。

english: Turns off the CW decoder (AI and classic), DX cluster / RBN spots, the PSK Reporter needs feed, Super Check Partial and call history together, and records the change with a timestamp. Takes effect at once. Your own settings for each of those are left alone and come back when you switch this off.
chinese: 一次性关闭 CW 解码器（AI 与传统）、DX 集群 / RBN 台站报告、PSK Reporter 所需数据源、Super Check Partial 和呼号历史，并带时间戳记录该变更。立即生效。你对各项的自有设置保持不变，关闭本项后恢复。
do_not_translate: PSK Reporter | PSK | RBN | CW | DX

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Contest category. The same English text "UNASSISTED" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. assist.state.unassisted) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
One-word control on: Settings ▸ Contest category. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Kept in assistance_journal.json beside your settings, so it survives restarts. Newest first.
chinese: 保存在设置旁的 assistance_journal.json 中，重启后依然保留。最新的在前。

english: Super Check Partial and call history
chinese: Super Check Partial 与呼号历史

notes: The same English text "Super Check Partial" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. logEntry.scp.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Lists the calls active in recent contests that match what you type in the contest strip’s Call box. Nexus downloads the list (MASTER.SCP, about 360 KB of callsigns) from supercheckpartial.com, which W9KKN maintains, the first time a contest starts with this on. It is never shipped with Nexus.
chinese: 列出近期竞赛中活跃、且与你输入到竞赛条 Call 框的呼号相匹配的台站。开启本项后首次开始竞赛时，Nexus 会从 supercheckpartial.com（由 W9KKN 维护）下载该列表（MASTER.SCP，约 360 KB 呼号）。它绝不随 Nexus 一起分发。

english: Check for a newer list once a day
While a contest runs, Nexus asks the site at most once a day whether the list has changed, and downloads it only if it has. Off keeps the list you have; Update now still checks.
chinese: 竞赛进行期间，Nexus 每天最多向该站点询问一次列表是否有变化，仅在变化时下载。关闭则保留现有列表；“立即更新”仍会检查。

notes: The same English text "Update now" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.callsignState.update.action, settings.orbitalElements.update.action) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Checking…" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. settings.streetMaps.updates.checking, contestSetup.sends.checking, settings.fdRules.update.busy) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: No list yet. It downloads the first time a contest starts.
chinese: 尚无列表。首次开始竞赛时会自动下载。

english: The last check failed: {{error}}. The list you have is still used.
chinese: 上次检查失败：{{error}}。仍使用现有列表。

english: Unassisted mode is on, so Super Check Partial and call history are off until it ends.
chinese: 无辅助模式已开启，因此 Super Check Partial 与呼号历史在被关闭期间不可用。

english: A call-history file you choose, in N1MM’s format. As you type a call that is in it, Nexus fills the exchange boxes it can check (a county, state, section or zone the contest accepts) and marks them; what you type always wins. A file is used only for the contest it was imported for, and never leaves this computer.
chinese: 你自行选择的呼号历史文件，采用 N1MM 格式。当你输入的呼号在其中时，Nexus 会填入它可核验的交换信息框（本竞赛接受的县、州、分区或区域）并加以标记；你输入的内容始终优先。文件仅用于导入时指定的竞赛，且绝不离开本机。

english: Fill the exchange from call history
chinese: 用呼号历史填充交换信息

notes: The same English text "Importing…" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. setup.log.import.busy, logbook.import.preview.busy, settings.orbitalElements.import.busy) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The file will be used for the contest picked above: {{contest}}.
chinese: 该文件将用于上方选定的竞赛：{{contest}}。
已为 {{contest}} 导入 {{count}} 个呼号。

english: That file could not be imported: {{error}}

notes: The same English text "Clear" is used by 16 different keys (e.g. logEntry.clear.label, logbook.search.clear, logbook.tools.bulk.clear) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: This file is for {{contest}}, not the contest picked above, so it is not used now.
chinese: 该文件属于 {{contest}}，不是上方选定的竞赛，因此当前未使用。

notes: The same English text "Enter Sends Message" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. contest.esm.switch.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: With ESM on, Enter in the contest log strip sends the contact’s next message from your F-keys, and the contact logs at its last step. ESM is off until you turn it on, in each cockpit separately. Enter never turns TX on, and nothing is sent by a timer.
chinese: 开启 ESM 后，在竞赛日志条中按 Enter 会通过你的 F 键发送该联络的下一条消息，联络在其最后一步被记录。ESM 默认关闭，需在各驾驶舱中分别开启。Enter 绝不会开启发射，也不会由定时器触发任何发送。

english: Enter plays the voice keyer’s recordings. When you are running, you say his call and your exchange yourself: a recording cannot say a callsign.
chinese: Enter 会播放语音键控中的录音。主叫时，对方的呼号和你的交换信息需要你自己说出：录音无法念出呼号。

english: In search and pounce, your call goes once per station. The next Enter asks for a repeat instead of sending your call again.
chinese: 在搜索呼叫中，对每个台站只发送一次你的呼号。下一次按 Enter 会请求对方重复，而不是重发你的呼号。

notes: {{profile}} is the operator’s own name for a CW macro profile.

english: This profile uses the built-in sets, so its steps in a contest are theirs. To map your own keys, customize the profile in Settings ▸ CW.
chinese: 该方案使用内置按键组，因此竞赛中的步骤即为内置步骤。要自定义按键映射，请在 设置 ▸ CW 中定制该方案。

english: Saved with this profile. A step with no key sends nothing, and the strip names it.
chinese: 随该方案保存。未指定按键的步骤不发送任何内容，日志条会标出该步骤。

english: Each set keeps its own mapping. A key you changed in the cockpit keeps its place, so its step sends your text.
chinese: 每个按键组保存各自的映射。你在驾驶舱中修改过的按键会保留其位置，因此对应步骤会发送你的文本。

english: Record a slot for each step you want Enter to play. An empty slot plays nothing.
chinese: 为每个希望 Enter 播放的步骤录制一个槽位。空槽位不播放任何内容。

english: For {{contest}}, the contest picked above. Start contest… walks you through its setup and turns Contest mode on; Stop contest… offers the end-of-contest checklist and turns it off. Both take effect at once. When it is on, the log strips in every mode, the Contest screen and the exports follow its rules.
chinese: 针对上方选定的竞赛 {{contest}}。“开始竞赛…”会引导你完成设置并开启竞赛模式；“停止竞赛…”会提供赛后清单并将其关闭。两者立即生效。开启后，各模式的日志条、竞赛面板与导出都会遵循其规则。

notes: The same English text "Off" is used by 17 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.contrast.off, settings.workspace.night.off, settings.workspace.field.off) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Set your Class + Section to start operating. Contest mode is on, but the station won't enter {{contest}} until both are filled in below.
chinese: 设置你的等级 + 分区后才能开始操作。竞赛模式已开启，但在下方两项都填好之前，台站不会进入 {{contest}}。

english: Number of transmitters + class letter: A=club/group portable, B=1–2 person portable, C=mobile, D=home (mains power), E=home (emergency power), F=EOC. E.g. 3A = 3 transmitters, club portable.
chinese: 发射机数量 + 等级字母：A=俱乐部/团体便携，B=1–2 人便携，C=移动，D=居家（市电），E=居家（应急电源），F=应急指挥中心。例如 3A = 3 部发射机、俱乐部便携。

english: The number of transmitters (your class), then your category letter: H=Home, I=Indoor, O=Outdoor, M=Mobile (e.g. 2O = 2 transmitters, outdoor).
chinese: 发射机数量（即你的等级），然后是类别字母：H=在家、I=室内、O=室外、M=移动（例如 2O = 2 台发射机、室外）。

english: “{{section}}” isn't a known ARRL/RAC section — pick one from the list.
chinese: “{{section}}” 不是已知的 ARRL/RAC 分区 — 请从列表中选择一个。

english: “{{section}}” ({{name}}) is no longer an ARRL/RAC section — it was replaced by {{successors}}. Pick the one you operate from.
chinese: “{{section}}”（{{name}}）已不再是 ARRL/RAC 分区 — 它已被 {{successors}} 取代。请选择你实际操作的地区。

english: Your ARRL / RAC section (e.g. WI, ENY, ONN). Start typing the code or a state name and pick from the list — validated against all {{count}} sections. Required for the Cabrillo log.
chinese: 你的 ARRL / RAC 分区（例如 WI、ENY、ONN）。开始输入代码或州名，然后从列表中选择 — 会对照全部 {{count}} 个分区进行校验。Cabrillo 日志必填。

english: Runs entirely on battery or other natural power, ≤5W output
chinese: 完全依靠电池或其他自然能源运行，输出 ≤5W

english: 100W or less from any power source

chinese: 超过 100W — 市电/发电机供电

english: Multiplies your QSO points. QRP/battery = ×5 (ARRL bonus for going off-grid). Choose before the event.
chinese: 乘以你的 QSO 得分。QRP/电池 = ×5（ARRL 对离网运行的加分）。请在活动开始前选好。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Field Day rules. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word. The same English text "Checking…" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. settings.streetMaps.updates.checking, contestSetup.sends.checking, settings.contestAids.update.busy) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Rules data downloaded — applies at next launch (data {{date}}).
chinese: 规则数据已下载 — 下次启动时生效（数据 {{date}}）。
规则数据已是最新（数据 {{date}}）。

english: Update downloaded (data {{date}}) — applies at next launch.
chinese: 更新已下载（数据 {{date}}）— 下次启动时生效。

english: Rules data is from {{year}} — check for updates before the event.
chinese: 规则数据来自 {{year}} 年 — 请在活动前检查更新。
正在使用内置规则数据。

english: Scoring, dates, exchanges and multipliers for every contest in the Contest list above. Checked on demand; a downloaded update applies at the next launch.
chinese: 上方竞赛列表中每项竞赛的计分、日期、交换信息与倍数规则。按需检查；下载的更新在下次启动时生效。

english: Three names, three different jobs — the club call goes on the air, the position is which tent you are sitting in, and the operator is whoever is at the key right now. Changing one of them here changes it everywhere in Nexus: the callsign and the operator are the same two boxes the Station tab holds.
chinese: 三个名称，三项不同的职责 — 上天的是呼号，位置名表示你坐在哪个帐篷里，操作员则是此刻正按着电键的那个人。在这里改动其中一项，Nexus 全局都会同步：呼号与操作员就是“电台”标签页里的那两个输入框。

english: The call that goes on the air and onto every contact you log — at a club event that is the club's call, the same one at every position on site.
chinese: 上天并写入你每一份联络记录的呼号 — 在俱乐部活动中就是俱乐部的呼号，场地内每个位置都用同一个。

english: Which tent, trailer or table this station is — it names you on the club band board so everyone can see which position is on which band, and it never goes on the air.
chinese: 这个电台在哪个帐篷、拖车或桌前 — 它会在俱乐部的波段板上标出你，让所有人看到哪个位置在哪个波段上，并且它从不上天。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Field Day operators. The same English text "Operator at the key" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.station.fdOperator.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 留空 = 使用上方呼号

english: Whoever is running this position right now — change it every time someone takes the seat, and their contacts are stamped with it (ADIF OPERATOR) so the club can split the log by operator afterwards.
chinese: 此刻正在操作这个位置的人 — 每次换人都要更新，其联络会打上此标记（ADIF OPERATOR），便于俱乐部事后按操作员拆分日志。

english: Merges every position's contacts into one club log on this PC — and opens a port on your local network (the only time Nexus listens beyond this computer).
chinese: 把每个位置的联络合并成本机上的同一份俱乐部日志 — 并在你的局域网上开一个端口（这是 Nexus 唯一一次在本机之外监听）。

english: A club event uses TCP {{host}} (the Host port), UDP {{search}} (Find club events) and TCP {{board}} (the club TV scoreboard). A firewall that is on must let Nexus in on them.
chinese: 俱乐部活动使用 TCP {{host}}（主机端口）、UDP {{search}}（查找俱乐部活动）和 TCP {{board}}（俱乐部电视比分板）。已开启的防火墙必须放行 Nexus 使用这些端口。
允许 Nexus 通过 Windows 防火墙
移除 Nexus 的防火墙规则

english: Nexus could not read Windows Firewall on this laptop.
chinese: Nexus 无法读取本机的 Windows 防火墙。

english: Windows Firewall is off on this laptop for Private and Public networks, so there is nothing to allow.
chinese: 本机的 Windows 防火墙在专用和公用网络上均已关闭，因此无需放行。

english: Nexus has no club sync rule in Windows Firewall on this laptop yet.
chinese: Nexus 在本机的 Windows 防火墙中还没有俱乐部同步规则。

english: Nexus's club sync rules in Windows Firewall are out of date (made for another port, or another copy of Nexus). Press Allow Nexus through Windows Firewall again.
chinese: Nexus 在 Windows 防火墙中的俱乐部同步规则已过期（为其他端口或另一个 Nexus 副本创建）。请再次点击“允许 Nexus 通过 Windows 防火墙”。

english: Nexus's club sync rules are in Windows Firewall for Private and Public networks: TCP {{host}}, UDP {{search}} and TCP {{board}}.
chinese: Nexus 的俱乐部同步规则已在 Windows 防火墙的专用和公用网络中生效：TCP {{host}}、UDP {{search}} 和 TCP {{board}}。

english: Windows also blocks Nexus on Private networks with a rule of its own (what Cancel at its question leaves), and a block wins over every allow. Delete it in Windows Defender Firewall ▸ Advanced settings ▸ Inbound Rules: the Nexus rules with a block sign.
chinese: Windows 还会用自己的规则在专用网络上阻止 Nexus（即在其询问时点“取消”所留下的那条），而阻止优先于任何放行。请到“Windows Defender 防火墙 ▸ 高级设置 ▸ 入站规则”中删除带阻止标志的 Nexus 规则。

english: Windows also blocks Nexus on Public networks with a rule of its own (what Cancel at its question leaves), and a block wins over every allow. Delete it in Windows Defender Firewall ▸ Advanced settings ▸ Inbound Rules: the Nexus rules with a block sign.
chinese: Windows 还会用自己的规则在公用网络上阻止 Nexus（即在其询问时点“取消”所留下的那条），而阻止优先于任何放行。请到“Windows Defender 防火墙 ▸ 高级设置 ▸ 入站规则”中删除带阻止标志的 Nexus 规则。

english: Windows also blocks Nexus on Private and Public networks with rules of its own (what Cancel at its question leaves), and a block wins over every allow. Delete them in Windows Defender Firewall ▸ Advanced settings ▸ Inbound Rules: the Nexus rules with a block sign.
chinese: Windows 还会用自己的规则在专用和公用网络上阻止 Nexus（即在其询问时点“取消”所留下的那些），而阻止优先于任何放行。请到“Windows Defender 防火墙 ▸ 高级设置 ▸ 入站规则”中删除带阻止标志的 Nexus 规则。

english: Windows Firewall blocks every incoming connection on Private networks, whatever is allowed. Turn that off under Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Private network.
chinese: Windows 防火墙阻止专用网络上的所有入站连接，无论放行了什么。请在“Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火墙和网络保护 ▸ 专用网络”中关闭该设置。

english: Windows Firewall blocks every incoming connection on Public networks, whatever is allowed. Turn that off under Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Public network.
chinese: Windows 防火墙阻止公用网络上的所有入站连接，无论放行了什么。请在“Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火墙和网络保护 ▸ 公用网络”中关闭该设置。

english: Windows Firewall blocks every incoming connection on Private and Public networks, whatever is allowed. Turn that off for each under Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection.
chinese: Windows 防火墙阻止专用和公用网络上的所有入站连接，无论放行了什么。请在“Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火墙和网络保护”中分别关闭这两项。

english: Windows did not add Nexus's rules: its administrator prompt was declined, or a step failed.
chinese: Windows 未添加 Nexus 的规则：管理员提示被拒绝，或某一步失败。

english: Windows did not remove Nexus's rules: its administrator prompt was declined, or a step failed.
chinese: Windows 未移除 Nexus 的规则：管理员提示被拒绝，或某一步失败。

english: Not while transmitting: Windows' administrator prompt takes the whole screen, Stop with it. Press again when the over ends.
chinese: 发射时不可操作：Windows 的管理员提示会占据整个屏幕，请随它一起停止发射，本次发射结束后再按。

english: Windows is still asking about the last press.
chinese: Windows 仍在处理上一次的请求。

english: Nexus cannot name its own program in a rule from the folder it runs from (a % in its name, or a character Windows' command line would misread). Allow Nexus by hand under Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Allow an app through firewall, on Private and Public networks.
chinese: Nexus 无法在其运行所在的文件夹中用规则命名自己的程序（名称中含 %，或含 Windows 命令行会误读的字符）。请手动放行：在“Windows 安全中心 ▸ 防火墙和网络保护 ▸ 允许应用通过防火墙”中，于专用和公用网络上勾选 Nexus。

english: A rule cannot name port 0: set the Host port and the scoreboard's port first.
chinese: 规则无法指定端口 0：请先设置主机端口和比分板端口。

english: Positions on this network can now find and join this event. There is no join password — a club site LAN is trusted, and anyone on it could add rows to the club log, which you will see. If this PC dies, enable hosting on any other position: everyone re-joins and nothing is lost.
chinese: 本网络上的位置现在可以发现并加入此活动。没有加入密码 — 俱乐部场地局域网是可信的，网络上的任何人都能向俱乐部日志添加记录，你会看到。如果这台电脑挂了，在任一其他位置启用主办即可：大家重新加入，什么都不会丢。

english: Shown to joining positions and in discovery.
chinese: 显示给加入的位置以及在发现列表中。

english: TCP port for the club sync (default 42073).
chinese: 俱乐部同步使用的 TCP 端口（默认 42073）。

english: host:port of the club host — use Find club events, or type it from the host's screen.
chinese: 俱乐部主机的 host:port — 可用“查找俱乐部活动”，或照主机屏幕上显示的地址输入。

english: Hosting — this position joins its own event automatically.
chinese: 正在主办 — 此位置会自动加入自己的活动。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Field Day club board. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Nothing heard in {{secs}} s. Check that the host has Host a club event on, that both laptops are on the same network (some Wi-Fi keeps laptops apart), and, on Windows, that this laptop's firewall lets Nexus hear the host: press Allow Nexus through Windows Firewall, above. Or type the address the host shows after “Positions join at” into Join event at.
chinese: {{secs}} 秒内没有听到任何响应。请确认主机已开启“主办俱乐部活动”，两台电脑在同一网络上（有些 Wi-Fi 会把电脑彼此隔开），并且在 Windows 上本机防火墙允许 Nexus 听到主机：点击上方的“允许 Nexus 通过 Windows 防火墙”。或者，把主机在“位置加入地址”后显示的地址填入“加入活动地址”。

english: Join the event at {{host}} now. This saves only the join address; other changes here still need Save.
chinese: 立即加入 {{host}} 处的活动。此处只保存加入地址；其他改动仍需点击保存。

english: Serves a read-only scoreboard page for a TV or projector on this network — nothing to install on the TV, and viewers can only look. The first enable may pop a Windows Firewall prompt; allow it or viewers see nothing.
chinese: 为本网络上的电视或投影仪提供一个只读比分板页面 — 电视上无需安装任何东西，观众只能看。首次启用可能弹出 Windows 防火墙提示；请允许，否则观众什么也看不到。

english: TCP port the scoreboard page is served on (default 7373).
chinese: 提供比分板页面的 TCP 端口（默认 7373）。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Field Day board. The same English text "Copy" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. settings.connectWeb.url.copy, settings.transmit.share.copy.action, contestOver.submit.copy) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Starting up — save settings, then this row shows the address.
chinese: 正在启动 — 保存设置后，此行会显示地址。

english: When this station is a position, its TV shows the board of the host it joined, so the host needs Spectator scoreboard on too, on the same port. With no club at all, the TV says so and what to do.
chinese: 当此电台是某个位置时，它的电视显示所加入主机的比分板，因此主机也需在同一端口上开启“观众比分板”。若完全没有俱乐部，电视会说明这一点以及该怎么办。

notes: The same English text "DUPE" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. logEntry.fd.dupe.badge) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 根据呼号历史预测（县界 {{line}}）：{{rule}} {{value}}

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Licenses, in the panel header. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: This build does not carry the license texts. An installed Nexus has them in resources/ui/THIRD-PARTY.txt and resources/rust/THIRD-PARTY.txt.
chinese: 此版本未附带许可文本。已安装的 Nexus 中，它们位于 resources/ui/THIRD-PARTY.txt 和 resources/rust/THIRD-PARTY.txt。

english: Could not confirm the VFO mapping
chinese: 无法确认 VFO 映射
清除所有工作频率覆盖？

english: The stock WSJT-X frequency table is restored.
chinese: 将恢复 WSJT-X 的原始频率表。

english: Could not save the routing rules

Route by band AND mode — band coverage above sends a whole band to one radio. Add rules here when TWO radios share a band and the MODE decides which one: 2 m FT8 to the digital rig, 2 m FM and APRS to the FM rig. Rules are checked top to bottom and the FIRST match wins; anything no rule matches falls back to band coverage, then to the default radio.
chinese: 按波段和模式路由 — 上方的波段覆盖会把整个波段交给一部电台。当两部电台共用同一波段、而由模式决定用哪部时，在此添加规则：2 米 FT8 走数字电台，2 米 FM 和 APRS 走 FM 电台。规则自上而下检查，第一个匹配者生效；任何规则都不匹配的，回退到波段覆盖，再回退到默认电台。

english: No rules — routing is by band only (today's behavior).
chinese: 无规则 — 仅按波段路由（即当前行为）。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Audio routing. The same English text "Satellite" is used by 5 different keys (e.g. logPrompt.propMode.satellite, qso.detail.satName, sat.dome.readout.satellite) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Satellite passes only: picking a transponder checks Satellite rules before the mode rules, so the FM & APRS rule can keep terrestrial packet while satellites go to the sat rig. Terrestrial tunes never match this rule.
chinese: 仅卫星过境：选择转发器后，会先检查卫星规则再检查模式规则，这样 FM 与 APRS 规则可以保留地面分组，而卫星则走卫星电台。地面调谐永远不会匹配此规则。

english: Check this rule earlier (first match wins)
chinese: 提前检查此规则（第一个匹配者生效）

notes: The same English text "Any band" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. operate.decodes.hideB4Scope.any, radioSetup.bands.any) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Radio {{id}}" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. radioSwitch.radio) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Everything else" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. radioSetup.step.rest, radioSetup.rest.title) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Where would this go?" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. radioSetup.check.title) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: When Nexus switches radio by itself

A band or mode your rules give to another radio switches to it, and transmitting stops first. “Tell me” shows one line saying so, with Undo and Why? buttons. Peg-lock in the radio switcher keeps the active radio and stops the switching.
chinese: 当你的规则把某个波段或模式交给另一部电台时，会切换到它，并先停止发射。“告诉我”会显示一行说明，带“撤销”和“为什么？”按钮。电台切换器中的钉选锁定会保持当前电台并停止切换。

english: Could not save the radio switch choice
chinese: 无法保存电台切换选项

english: Hamlib has no way to key this radio over CAT. Pick how your interface keys it: VOX if it keys on audio, like a SignaLink, or Serial RTS or Serial DTR if it keys on a serial line.
chinese: Hamlib 无法通过 CAT 键控这部电台。请选择你的接口如何键控：若靠音频键控（如 SignaLink），选 VOX；若靠串口线键控，选串口 RTS 或串口 DTR。

english: Which of the radio’s audio inputs transmits when Nexus keys it over CAT. Front/Mic is how Nexus has always keyed the radio. Rear/Data keys its data input instead: choose it if your sound card reaches the radio through its rear DATA or ACC jack (where a SignaLink plugs in) or its own USB audio, and the radio sends no audio from Nexus although it does on VOX. english: Tick this if your interface keys the radio from the CAT port’s RTS line — a Digirig Mobile and most other one-cable interfaces are wired this way. Nexus then holds RTS down, instead of leaving it up where it puts some rigs into transmit the moment the port opens. If your radio transmits as soon as Nexus starts, this is the setting. chinese: 如果你的接口是通过 CAT 端口的 RTS 线键控电台（Digirig Mobile 及大多数单线接口都是这样接的），请勾选此项。Nexus 随后会保持 RTS 为低电平，而不是让它悬空 — 悬空时某些电台会在端口一打开就进入发射。如果你的电台在 Nexus 一启动就发射，就是这个设置。若是一根普通串口线直连电台，请保持关闭：电台可能正用这根线做流控，夺走它可能让 CAT 失效。

english: Keeps your transmitted audio between 1500–2000 Hz by shifting the TX dial in 500 Hz steps, so audio harmonics fall outside the transmit filter — cleaner signal. Rig = uses VFO B split. If you change it and CAT stops working, put it back on Auto: on some rigs Hamlib quietly refuses the setting and then answers without ever having opened the radio, so you get a CAT light and a rig that ignores you.
chinese: 告诉 Nexus 你的线缆实际做什么，而不是让它猜。除非你有一部启动就发射的电台，否则保持“自动”— 自动不会改变你台站今天的工作方式。若改了之后 CAT 失效，请改回自动：在某些电台上，Hamlib 会默默拒绝该设置，然后在你根本没打开电台的情况下照常应答，于是你看到 CAT 指示灯亮着，电台却对你的指令毫无反应。

english: For the one fault this exists to fix: a rig that keys at launch, before you have touched anything. Leave it on Auto unless that is happening to you — Auto changes nothing about how your station works today. If you change it and CAT stops working, put it back on Auto. Only you can see whether the rig unkeys; nobody can test this from our end, so treat it as something to try on a rig you are watching.
chinese: 专为一种故障而存在：电台在你还没碰任何东西之前就启动发射。除非你正遇到这种情况，否则保持“自动”— 自动不会改变你台站今天的工作方式。若改了之后 CAT 失效，请改回自动。只有你能看到电台是否停止发射；这一点我们这边无法测试，所以请把它当作在你正盯着的那部电台上试试看的选项。

english: The power a tune-up keys at — leave it empty and Nexus never touches your power, which is what it does today. It can only turn the rig DOWN, never up: it keys at whichever is lower, this or the power you are already running, so 50 % here while you run 25 % still tunes at 25 %. On a 100 W rig, 10 % is about 10 W — enough for an antenna tuner, kind to a loop.
chinese: 调谐时使用的功率 — 留空则 Nexus 从不触碰你的功率，也就是现在的行为。它只能把电台调低，绝不会调高：取此值与当前功率中较低的那个，所以此处设 50% 而你正跑 25% 时，仍以 25% 调谐。在 100W 电台上，10% 约 10W — 足够驱动天调，对环形天线也温和。

chinese: 使用 Flex 原生客户端时，“调谐”是电台自身的载波，功率为 SmartSDR 中设置的调谐功率。Nexus 不会为其写入功率，因此此设置在那里不适用。
Nexus 启动 rigctld 所用的端口。
数据模式使用普通 SSB

english: Leave this off unless you know you need it. Nexus normally puts the radio in its DATA submode (DATA-U / USB-D / PKTUSB) for FT8, FT4, RTTY-AFSK and SSTV, because on most rigs that is the only mode where the USB codec reaches the transmitter. Turn this on and Nexus commands plain USB/LSB for those modes instead, and stays there — through band changes and when you call a station. Correct if your transmit audio goes in the microphone path, as with an interface wired to the mic jack (some RIGblaster models) — or if you simply prefer plain USB to the DATA submode (for its wider receive passband, say) and your rig is set to send its USB-codec audio in SSB, which on many modern rigs (FT-991A, IC-7300 and the like) is a single menu item. Either way the rig has to put the audio you're feeding onto the air in plain SSB: where it does not — the codec feeds only the data port and nothing carries in SSB — plain SSB takes audio from the mic and the radio transmits no RF at all, a red TX light and nothing on the air. Per radio, since it depends on how that rig is cabled and set. True FSK RTTY is unaffected — it keeps the rig's own RTTY mode.
chinese: 除非你确定需要，否则请保持关闭。Nexus 通常会让电台切到 DATA 子模式（DATA-U / USB-D / PKTUSB）来跑 FT8、FT4、RTTY-AFSK 和 SSTV，因为在多数电台上，这是 USB 编解码器唯一能到达发射机的模式。开启此项后，Nexus 对这些模式改为命令电台使用普通 USB/LSB，并保持不变 — 跨波段切换和呼叫电台时也一样。如果你的发射音频走的是麦克风通路（例如接在麦克风插孔上的接口，某些 RIGblaster 型号），或者你只是更喜欢普通 USB 而非 DATA 子模式（比如为了它更宽的接收通带），并且你的电台已设为在 SSB 下送出 USB 编解码器的音频（在很多现代电台上，如 FT-991A、IC-7300 之类，这只是菜单里的一项），那就选它。无论如何，电台必须把你送入的音频以普通 SSB 送上天：若做不到 — 编解码器只馈送数据端口，SSB 下没有任何通路 — 普通 SSB 就会从麦克风取音频，电台完全不发射频，TX 红灯亮着而天上一片安静。按电台分别设置，因为这取决于该电台如何接线与设置。真正的 FSK RTTY 不受影响 — 它仍用电台自带的 RTTY 模式。

english: Hold the data mode while SSTV is receiving
chinese: SSTV 接收期间保持数据模式

english: Keeps this radio in the data submode for the whole time the SSTV receiver is running, instead of only while a picture is queued or going out — FM-D / DATA-FM on an FM channel, and USB-D / LSB-D on HF. Off by default, which is what Nexus does today: it commands the data submode around a send and puts the radio back in plain FM or SSB in between, so a rig parked on an SSTV calling channel keeps dropping out of the data mode. That revert is deliberate — an SSTV send once keyed a data mode into an FM repeater input — but it is the wrong answer if you sit on an SSTV calling channel for the evening. Stop the receiver before you go back to voice. The receiver keeps running after you leave the SSTV screen, and while it runs this radio is held in the data submode, where transmit audio comes from the data port and your microphone modulates nothing. Per radio, since it depends on how that rig is cabled and what you use it for.
chinese: 在 SSTV 接收机运行的整段时间内，让这部电台保持在数据子模式，而不是只在图片排队或发送时才切换 — FM 频道上为 FM-D / DATA-FM，HF 上为 USB-D / LSB-D。默认关闭，也就是 Nexus 现在的行为：它在发送前后命令数据子模式，中间把电台切回普通 FM 或 SSB，因此停在 SSTV 呼叫频道上的电台会不断掉出数据模式。这种回退是有意为之 — 曾经有一次 SSTV 发送把数据模式键控进了 FM 中继的输入端 — 但如果你整晚守在 SSTV 呼叫频道上，这就是错的答案。回到话音前请先停止接收机。离开 SSTV 界面后接收机仍在运行，而在它运行期间这部电台被保持在数据子模式，此时发射音频来自数据端口，你的麦克风什么也调制不了。按电台分别设置，因为这取决于该电台如何接线以及你拿它做什么用。

english: Set the radio's menu 077 FM PKT PORT SELECT to USB, or beacons go out silent. With this on, APRS puts this radio in DATA-FM instead of plain FM; repeater voice stays plain FM. Off, APRS uses plain FM, as it always has.
chinese: 把电台菜单 077 FM PKT PORT SELECT 设为 USB，否则信标会静默发出。开启此项后，APRS 会让这部电台进入 DATA-FM 而非普通 FM；中继话音仍为普通 FM。关闭时，APRS 使用普通 FM，一如既往。

english: Nexus drives this Icom's CI-V directly instead of launching rigctld — unlocking the rig's real spectrum scope in the waterfall ("CI-V RF") and instant dial tracking. The scope needs 115200 baud, set the same on BOTH the radio and Nexus: (1) on the rig, Menu ▸ SET ▸ Connectors ▸ CI-V ▸ "CI-V USB Baud Rate" = 115200; (2) on the rig, same menu, "CI-V USB Port" = "Unlink from [REMOTE]"; (3) the Baud field above = 115200 to match. Below that the rig refuses to stream the scope (CAT still works; the panadapter just stays off). Save to apply; turn off any time to return to the classic Hamlib path.
chinese: Nexus 直接驱动这部 Icom 的 CI-V，而不启动 rigctld — 解锁瀑布图中电台真正的频谱（“CI-V RF”）与即时的频率跟踪。频谱需要115200 波特率，且在电台上和 Nexus 中都设为相同值：（1）电台上，Menu ▸ SET ▸ Connectors ▸ CI-V ▸“CI-V USB Baud Rate”= 115200；（2）电台上，同一菜单，“CI-V USB Port”=“Unlink from [REMOTE]”；（3）上方波特率字段 = 115200 以匹配。低于此值电台会拒绝推送频谱（CAT 仍可用；全景只是不亮）。保存后生效；随时关闭即可回到经典 Hamlib 路径。

english: Carry this FlexRadio's audio over the network (VITA-49 DAX) instead of the "DAX Audio RX" / "DAX TX" sound devices, which are invisible under Remote Desktop. Needs Flex native client (Beta) on. With SmartSDR CAT this does nothing: audio stays on the sound devices, and the setting is kept for the client. On the client, the decoders read receive audio straight from the radio, and digital modes and the Remote stream's voice transmit over DAX. Phone at the shack keeps the radio's own mic, so the voice keyer can't play there. Turning this off or disconnecting puts your own DAX setting back, and Nexus never changes it while SmartSDR's DAX is connected. Beta, unverified on hardware: if decodes or transmit stop, turn it back off. Save to apply.
chinese: 通过网络（VITA-49 DAX）传输这部 FlexRadio 的音频，而不是用“DAX Audio RX”/“DAX TX”声音设备 — 那两个在远程桌面下不可见。需开启 Flex 原生客户端（Beta）。配 SmartSDR CAT 时此项不起作用：音频仍走声音设备，该设置只为客户端保留。在客户端下，解码器直接从电台读取接收音频，数字模式与 Remote 串流的话音发射走 DAX。台站现场的话音仍用电台自带的麦克风，因此语音键控器在那里放不出声音。关闭此项或断开连接会恢复你自己的 DAX 设置，而 Nexus 在 SmartSDR 的 DAX 已连接时从不改动它。Beta，未在硬件上验证：若解码或发射停止，请关掉它。保存后生效。

chinese: 无法切换 CI-V 诊断日志

english: Recording to {{path}} — this keeps running while you're on other screens, so go to the FT8 or Phone cockpit and reproduce the issue (Tune or transmit) now. Come back and turn it off when done, then send that file. It shows exactly what's on the bus during the fault.
chinese: 正在录制到 {{path}} — 你去别的界面时它仍在运行，所以现在请到 FT8 或话音操作台复现问题（调谐或发射）。完成后回来关掉它，然后把该文件发来。它会精确记录故障期间总线上的内容。

english: Records every byte to/from the radio on the native CI-V path to a file in your Downloads — a support tool for hardware-only issues like the IC-9700 PTT flicker. Turn on, reproduce the problem, turn off, then send the file.
chinese: 在原生 CI-V 路径上，把与电台往返的每个字节记录到“下载”文件夹中的文件里 — 这是针对仅硬件可见问题的支持工具，例如 IC-9700 的 PTT 闪烁。开启、复现问题、关闭，然后发送该文件。
Flex 电台 IP（原生全景 + DAX）

english: Your FlexRadio's LAN IP (SmartSDR API, port 4992) — turns on the native RF panadapter. This is the radio's address, not the SmartSDR-CAT port above.
chinese: 你 FlexRadio 的局域网 IP（SmartSDR API，端口 4992）— 用于开启原生射频全景。这是电台的地址，不是上方的 SmartSDR-CAT 端口。

english: The "Share this radio" address other programs connect to (Hamlib NET rigctl default 4532). Change it only if something else on this computer already owns the port.
chinese: 其他程序连接用的“共享此电台”地址（Hamlib NET rigctl 默认 4532）。只有当本机上已有别的程序占用了该端口时才需更改。

notes: The same English text "Test CAT" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. radioSetup.cat.test) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Rig control. The same English text "Testing…" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. setup.rig.testCat.busy, settings.connections.test.busy, radioSetup.cat.testing) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Save settings, connect to the rig, and read its frequency
chinese: 保存设置、连接电台并读取其频率

english: Play receive audio on this computer

Plays the RECEIVED audio — exactly what the decoder hears — out of a device on this computer, for level and RFI diagnosis or simply to listen to the band. This is not a transmit monitor: it never plays your own voice back. Off by default; UNVERIFIED on-air until the attended session.
chinese: 把接收到的音频 — 也就是解码器听到的完全相同的内容 — 从本机的某个设备播放出来，用于电平和 RFI 诊断，或单纯听波段。这不是发射监听：它从不回放你自己的声音。默认关闭；在有人值守的实测之前属于未验证功能。

english: Your headphones or speakers — must NOT be the rig's TX output device.
chinese: 你的耳机或音箱 — 绝不能是电台的 TX 输出设备。

english: Headphone listening volume (does not affect TX).
chinese: 耳机收听的音量（不影响 TX）。

english: Where the RF scope's picture comes from: the radio's own panadapter (or the sound card's audio where the radio has none), or an SDRplay RSP receiver through SDRconnect. SDRconnect is SDRplay's own program, free and closed-source, which you install and run beside Nexus with its WebSocket API turned on; it serves every RSP except the original RSP1.
chinese: 射频频谱的画面来自哪里：电台自带的全景（电台没有时用声卡的音频），或经 SDRconnect 接入的 SDRplay RSP 接收机。SDRconnect 是 SDRplay 自家的程序，免费但闭源，你在 Nexus 旁边安装并运行它，并开启其 WebSocket API；它支持除初代 RSP1 之外的所有 RSP。

english: SDRconnect draws the receiver's whole span with each station at its own frequency, centred on the rig's dial. Receive only: Nexus never transmits through it and sends it no CAT.
chinese: SDRconnect 会画出接收机的整个跨度，每个电台都在自己的频率上，以电台的频率为中心。仅接收：Nexus 从不经它发射，也不向它发送 CAT。

english: 127.0.0.1 is this computer. Put the name or address of another computer if SDRconnect runs there.
chinese: 127.0.0.1 表示本机。若 SDRconnect 运行在其他电脑上，请填入其名称或地址。

english: SDRconnect's WebSocket API port: 5454 unless you moved it in SDRconnect.
chinese: SDRconnect 的 WebSocket API 端口：默认为 5454，除非你在 SDRconnect 中改过。

english: Keep the dial in the centre
Retune only when the dial nears the edge
chinese: 仅在频率接近边缘时重新调谐

english: How the receiver's centre follows the rig's dial. Retuning only near the edge moves SDRconnect's own display far less.
chinese: 接收机中心如何跟随电台频率。仅在接近边缘时重新调谐，对 SDRconnect 自身显示画面的移动要小得多。

english: Feed the receiver from the rig's RX OUT, or from a splitter with transmit protection, never from a plain T-piece on the transmit line: an RSP takes at most 0 dBm, and 100 W is +50 dBm.
chinese: 请从电台的 RX OUT 或带发射保护的分路器给接收机馈送信号，绝不要用发射线上的普通 T 型接头：RSP 最大只能承受 0 dBm，而 100 W 是 +50 dBm。

english: Corrects both legs of a pass: the downlink you listen on and the uplink you transmit on. Nexus tunes only while auto-track is following a pass and you have picked a transponder in the Satellites section. The downlink needs no setup here; the uplink is confirmed once per radio, on the pass itself.
chinese: 对一次过境的两条链路都做校正：你收听的下行和你发射的上行。仅当自动跟踪正在跟随某次过境、且你在“卫星”区选定了转发器时，Nexus 才会调谐。下行无需在此设置；上行则需按电台分别确认，且要在过境当时进行。

english: Retunes the radio through a pass so you stay on the station you are working. On: the downlink follows the bird as soon as you arm a pass and hold a transponder. Clearing this stops both legs.
chinese: 在过境期间重新调谐电台，让你始终停留在正在通联的电台频率上。开启后：一旦你备好某次过境并保持选定转发器，下行就会跟随卫星。清除此项会同时停止两条链路。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Satellite Doppler. The same English text "Satellite VFO mapping" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. sat.rail.vfoMap.aria) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The uplink mapping is confirmed per radio, for the radio you are operating. Confirm it for this radio on the pass rail during a pass, or make it the active radio first.
chinese: 上行映射按电台分别确认，针对你当前操作的电台。请在过境时于过境栏上为这部电台确认，或先把它设为当前电台。

english: Which VFO carries your uplink. Match this to how your radio is wired. A wrong mapping transmits on your own downlink — into the satellite's output passband, on top of everyone else working the bird. Picking one applies immediately and confirms it for the radio you are operating; a second radio gets its own confirmation on the pass rail. Every mapping except Uplink only keeps the downlink corrected.
chinese: 哪个 VFO 承载你的上行。请与你的电台接线方式相符。映射错误会在你自己的下行上发射 — 打进卫星的输出通带，压在其他所有联络这颗卫星的人身上。选择后立即生效，并为当前操作的电台完成确认；第二部电台需在过境栏上单独确认。除“仅上行”外，所有映射都会保持下行校正。
重新调谐前的最小多普勒偏移（Hz）

english: Corrections smaller than this are not sent. 20 Hz is inaudible on SSB and keeps the CAT link quiet. 0 sends every update.
chinese: 小于此值的校正不会发送。20 Hz 在 SSB 上听不出来，且能让 CAT 链路保持安静。0 表示每次更新都发送。

english: Shortest gap between corrections. 1000 ms is what a low-orbit pass needs. Shorter fights your own tuning knob and saturates a serial CAT link.
chinese: 两次校正之间的最短间隔。低轨过境需要 1000 ms。更短会与你自己的调谐旋钮打架，并使串口 CAT 链路饱和。

english: Audible tones at pass start and end
chinese: 过境开始与结束时的提示音

english: A rising tone the moment an armed pass starts and a falling one when it ends, alongside the popup — hear AOS with your hands on the rotor. On by default; clearing this silences only the tones, never the popups.
chinese: 已备好的过境开始时响起一个上升音，结束时响起下降音，与弹窗同时出现 — 让你双手扶着旋转器也能听见 AOS。默认开启；清除此项只会静音提示音，绝不会关掉弹窗。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Orbital elements. The same English text "Update now" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.callsignState.update.action, settings.contestAids.update.action) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Orbital elements. The same English text "Updating…" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.callsignState.update.busy, settings.countryFile.update.busy) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Orbital elements. The same English text "Importing…" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. setup.log.import.busy, logbook.import.preview.busy, settings.contestAids.history.import.busy) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Import a downloaded element file (Celestrak TLE, AMSAT keps, a new launch's SupGP set) — the offline-shack escape hatch. Imports persist across refreshes; the newest epoch per satellite wins.
chinese: 导入已下载的根数文件（Celestrak TLE、AMSAT 根数、新发射卫星的 SupGP 集）— 离线台站的应急出口。导入内容在刷新后仍保留；每颗卫星以最新历元为准。
根数已导入 — 导入 {{imported}} 条，共 {{total}} 条

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Orbital elements. The same English text "{{count}} birds" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. sat.elements.summary.birds) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Not loaded yet — fetched on first launch, then refreshed every 6 h.
chinese: 尚未加载 — 首次启动时获取，之后每 6 小时刷新一次。

english: Keplerian elements (TLEs) for the amateur satellites — pass times, pointing and Doppler all come from them. Refreshed every 6 h from hamradiotools.io: the bird list comes from the SatNOGS database (CC BY-SA 4.0), the elements from CelesTrak and SatNOGS. Import a file for an offline shack or a just-launched bird.
chinese: 业余卫星的开普勒根数（TLE）— 过境时间、指向和多普勒都由它推算。每 6 小时从 hamradiotools.io 刷新：卫星列表来自 SatNOGS 数据库（CC BY-SA 4.0），根数来自 CelesTrak 和 SatNOGS。离线台站或刚发射的卫星则可导入文件。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Amplifier. The same English text "Amplifier" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. connect.pane.amp.title, amp.strip.aria, settings.amplifier.model.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Connect a supported amplifier on its own serial port to see power, SWR, temperature and alarms. Use the cockpit controls for Operate/Standby and band steps. Set automatic band following below.
chinese: 在独立串口上连接受支持的功放，即可查看功率、驻波比、温度和告警。用操作台控件进行“运行/待机”和波段步进。自动波段跟随在下方设置。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Amplifier. The same English text "Amplifier" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. connect.pane.amp.title, amp.strip.aria, settings.amplifier.legend) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Amplifier. The same English text "None" is used by 6 different keys (e.g. logbook.filters.savedNone, contest.esm.picker.none, memories.editor.tone.none) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Place the Amplifier pane in Conditions to see the readings. Nothing here changes how the radio transmits.
chinese: 在“条件”中放置功放面板即可查看读数。此处任何设置都不会改变电台的发射方式。

english: Step the amplifier to the band you are on, without being asked. Off by default — this is the one amplifier control that acts on its own. It never moves the amplifier while you are transmitting, and it steps one band at a time, checking where the amplifier actually is after each one rather than assuming it got there. ⚠️ If your amplifier already follows the radio through its own band-data cable, as most SPE installations do, leave this off: the hardware is doing the same job, and two things steering one band is worse than either alone.
chinese: 无需询问即把功放步进到你所在的波段。默认关闭 — 这是唯一会自行动作的功放控件。它在发射时绝不移动功放，并且一次只步进一个波段，每步之后检查功放实际所在位置，而不是假定它已经到了。⚠️ 如果你的功放已通过其自带的波段数据线跟随电台（多数 SPE 安装方式如此），请保持关闭：硬件在做同一件事，两套东西同时操控一个波段比只用其一更糟。

english: Its own port, not the one CAT uses — a serial port can only be open once, so sharing it stops the radio connecting. The speed is worked out for you.
chinese: 用它自己的端口，不是 CAT 用的那个 — 串口只能打开一次，共用会让电台连不上。速率会自动推算。

notes: The same English text "Connection" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.rigControl.conn.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: A KPA1500 on your network can be reached by its IP address instead of a cable. The KPA500 has no network port.
chinese: 网上的 KPA1500 可以用 IP 地址访问，无需线缆。KPA500 没有网口。

english: Shown on the KPA1500’s NET IP ADDRESS menu. Nexus talks to the amplifier’s UDP server, which any number of programs can use at once, so Elecraft’s KPA1500 Remote can stay connected beside it.
chinese: 显示在 KPA1500 的 NET IP ADDRESS 菜单中。Nexus 与功放的 UDP 服务器通信，该服务器可同时供任意多个程序使用，因此 Elecraft 的 KPA1500 Remote 可以同时保持连接。

notes: The same English text "Port" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.connectWeb.port.label, settings.aprs.is.port.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: 1500 unless you changed the amplifier’s command port.
chinese: 默认为 1500，除非你改过功放的命令端口。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Rotator. The same English text "Rotator" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. rotor.strip.aria) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The rotator itself, and its pointing manners. The manners apply to satellite auto-track.
chinese: 旋转器本身，以及它的指向习惯。“习惯”适用于卫星自动跟踪。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Rotator. The same English text "None" is used by 6 different keys (e.g. logbook.filters.savedNone, contest.esm.picker.none, memories.editor.tone.none) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 其他 Hamlib 型号编号…

english: Hamlib rotator model number (rotctl -l lists them)
chinese: Hamlib 旋转器型号编号（rotctl -l 可列出）

english: Nexus runs the control daemon (rotctld) for you, the same way it does CAT. Then use the Rotor pane in Conditions, ↗ on Needed rows, or the compass anywhere.
chinese: Nexus 会替你运行控制守护进程（rotctld），就像它对 CAT 所做的那样。随后可用“条件”中的旋转器面板、“需要”行上的 ↗，或任意位置的罗盘。

english: Serial baud rate for the rotator controller
chinese: 旋转器控制器的串口波特率

english: Match the rate your controller is set to — Hamlib does not offer one fixed rate for this model.
chinese: 与你的控制器所设的速率一致 — Hamlib 对该型号不提供固定速率。

english: This controller runs at {{rate}} baud — the rate its Hamlib backend declares. Leave it here.
chinese: 此控制器以 {{rate}} 波特率运行 — 这是其 Hamlib 后端声明的速率。保持此值。

english: This controller runs at {{rate}} baud, not {{set}} — at the wrong rate it never answers and reads as broken hardware. Set {{rate}}, or re-pick the model above to fill it in.
chinese: 此控制器以 {{rate}} 波特率运行，而不是 {{set}} — 速率不对它永远不会应答，看起来就像硬件坏了。请设为 {{rate}}，或重新选择上方型号以自动填入。

english: PstRotatorAz: enter {{address}} as the port (its UDP Control Port), and turn on UDP Control in its Setup (the baud is not used). Nexus listens for its replies on that port + 1, {{reply}}, so no other program may use it.
chinese: PstRotatorAz：把 {{address}} 作为端口填入（其 UDP 控制端口），并在其 Setup 中开启 UDP Control（波特率不使用）。Nexus 会在该端口 + 1 即 {{reply}} 上监听其回复，因此其他程序不得占用它。
外部 rotctld 地址（高级）

english: Point Nexus at a rotctld you run yourself (or one on another machine). It OVERRIDES the model and port above and stops the integrated daemon. Needs the port — a bare host name is not an address.
chinese: 让 Nexus 指向你自己运行的 rotctld（或另一台机器上的）。它会覆盖上方的型号与端口，并停用内置守护进程。必须带端口 — 只有主机名不算地址。
停放位置（° 方位角 / 仰角）

english: The stow position — wind-safe, or wherever your mast rests. Used only when After a pass is set to Park.
chinese: 收存位置 — 抗风安全处，或你的桅杆平时停的位置。仅在“过境结束后”设为“停放”时使用。
待命位置（° 方位角 / 仰角）

english: Where the antenna waits for the next pass. Used only when After a pass is set to Ready.
chinese: 天线等待下一次过境的位置。仅在“过境结束后”设为“待命”时使用。

english: What the rotator does after a pass
chinese: 过境结束后旋转器的动作

english: Stop — leave the antenna where the pass ended
chinese: 停止 — 让天线停在过境结束时的指向

english: Park — drive to the park position
chinese: 停放 — 转到停放位置

english: Ready — drive to the ready position
chinese: 待命 — 转到待命位置

english: Stop is the default and moves nothing: the antenna stays pointed where the bird set. Park and Ready drive the rotator on their own at LOS, so set those positions above first.
chinese: “停止”是默认且不动任何东西：天线停在卫星把它留下的指向。“停放”和“待命”会在 LOS 时自行驱动旋转器，所以请先在上面设好对应位置。
容差（° 方位角 / 仰角）

english: A new target closer than this is not commanded. Without a deadband the rotator hunts and the relays chatter for the whole pass. 2° is about a G-5500's own resolution.
chinese: 新目标与当前指向的差值小于此值时不发送指令。没有死区的话，旋转器会整场过境来回搜索，继电器嗒嗒作响。2° 大致相当于 G-5500 自身的分辨率。
校准修正（° 方位角 / 仰角）

english: Added to every command. Use it when the controller reads one heading and the boom points at another.
chinese: 加到每条指令上。当控制器读出一个方向而横梁实际指向另一个方向时使用。

english: Allow the rotator to flip past 90 degrees elevation
chinese: 允许旋转器翻越高仰角（超过 90°）

english: Takes a high pass by turning azimuth 180° and running elevation past 90°, instead of swinging the mast around at the top of the pass. Off by default: many rotators cannot mechanically go past 90° elevation. Check your controller before turning this on.
chinese: 对付高仰角过境时，把方位角转 180° 并让仰角越过 90°，而不是在过境最高点把桅杆绕一大圈。默认关闭：许多旋转器在机械上无法超过 90° 仰角。开启前请确认你的控制器支持。
你的第一次 FT8 联络

english: Reading this changes no setting and transmits nothing.
chinese: 阅读此内容不会改动任何设置，也不会发射。

english: Listen first. With the radio connected and on an FT8 frequency, the stations Nexus hears appear in Band Activity every 15 seconds.
chinese: 先听。电台已连接并处于 FT8 频率上时，Nexus 每 15 秒会把听到的电台显示在“波段活动”中。

english: A line with CQ is a station calling anyone. A higher dB number is a stronger signal.
chinese: 带 CQ 的一行是某台在呼叫任何人。dB 数值越大，信号越强。

english: Double-click that line to answer it. That turns TX on: Nexus starts calling the station right away, or on the next period, and sends each message of the contact for you.
chinese: 双击该行即可应答。这会打开 TX：Nexus 会立刻或在下一个周期开始呼叫该台，并替你发送这次联络中的每条消息。

english: Double-click that line to answer it. TX stays off, because {{setting}} is off in Settings: press {{txOff}} to turn TX on, then Nexus calls the station and sends each message of the contact for you.
chinese: 双击该行即可应答。TX 保持关闭，因为设置中的 {{setting}} 已关闭：按 {{txOff}} 打开 TX，随后 Nexus 就会呼叫该台并替你发送这次联络中的每条消息。

english: TX starts off each time Nexus opens ({{txOff}}). {{stop}} ends a transmission at once; {{txOn}} turns TX off once the current period ends.
chinese: Nexus 每次启动时 TX 都是关闭的（{{txOff}}）。{{stop}} 可立即结束发射；{{txOn}} 会在当前周期结束后关闭 TX。

notes: The same English text "Got it" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. fieldDay.workIn.hint.dismiss, phone.keyer.flexDax.dismiss, remote.account.gotIt) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Showing the settings you need first. The rest of this tab is folded to its headings.
chinese: 先显示你需要的设置。此标签页的其余部分已折叠到各自的标题下。

notes: The same English text "Show all" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. program.count.showAll) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Operate your station from this computer
chinese: 从这台电脑操作你的台站

english: Finds your station on this network, or reaches it over the internet when you sign in with your Nexus Remote account. F11 switches the window to full screen and back, and Esc over the picture still stops transmitting.
chinese: 在本网络上查找你的台站，或在你登录 Nexus Remote 账户后经互联网接入。F11 可切换全屏与恢复窗口，画面上按 Esc 仍会停止发射。

english: Nexus could not open the Connect to my station window. Try again.
chinese: Nexus 无法打开“连接到我的台站”窗口。请重试。

english: Log each completed contact to the ADIF logbook by itself. A contact you opened by clicking their RR73 or RRR exchanges no reports and is never logged by itself: it waits for your confirm in the popup.
chinese: 自动把每次完成的联络记入 ADIF 日志。你通过点击对方 RR73 或 RRR 发起的联络没有交换报告，绝不会自动记录：它会在弹窗中等待你确认。

english: Open a popup to check and edit each completed contact (WSJT-X “Prompt me to log QSO”). It opens by itself with Auto-log on or off and holds each contact until you log or discard it; if 64 are left waiting, the oldest is logged, never one you opened by clicking their RR73 or RRR. With both off, nothing is logged until you press Log.
chinese: 为每次完成的联络弹出窗口，供你核对和编辑（即 WSJT-X 的“Prompt me to log QSO”）。无论是否开启自动记录它都会弹出，并保留每次联络直到你记录或丢弃；若积压到 64 条，最旧的一条会被记录，但绝不会记录你通过点击对方 RR73 或 RRR 发起的那一条。两者都关闭时，在你按“记录”之前什么都不会记入。

english: Write the exchanged reports into the logged QSO’s comment, e.g. “FT8  Sent: -07  Rcvd: -12” — the same format WSJT-X uses.
chinese: 把交换的报告写入已记录 QSO 的备注，例如“FT8  Sent: -07  Rcvd: -12”— 与 WSJT-X 使用的格式相同。
用 RRR 确认收到（不用 RR73）

english: Acknowledge the final report with a bare RRR (partner still owes a 73) instead of the combined RR73. Off = RR73 (modern FT8 practice).
chinese: 用单独的 RRR 确认最终报告（对方还欠一个 73），而不是合并的 RR73。关闭 = 使用 RR73（现代 FT8 做法）。
记录后清除 DX 呼号

english: Wipe the DX Call / DX Grid fields once a contact is logged (WSJT-X option, off by default).
chinese: 联络记录后清空 DX Call / DX Grid 字段（WSJT-X 选项，默认关闭）。
