Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital. The same English text "Deep" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. operate.header.decodeDepth.deep) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Deep finds the most signals (WSJT-X default); Fast saves CPU on old hardware. All Decoder settings drive the native decoder — on a WSJT-X UDP source (companion mode) decodes arrive already made and none of them apply.
chinese: “深”能找到最多信号（WSJT-X 默认）；“快”在老旧硬件上节省 CPU。所有解码器设置只作用于原生解码器 — 使用 WSJT-X UDP 源（伴随模式）时，解码结果已由对方生成，这些设置都不生效。

english: The decoder's search range. Default 200–2900 Hz. Raise F high toward 4000 Hz to decode stations calling above ~2.9 kHz (common on crowded FT8 bands); lower the range to focus on a narrow filter or dodge strong close-in QRM.
chinese: 解码器的搜索范围。默认 200–2900 Hz。把频高上限提到 4000 Hz 附近，可解码在约 2.9 kHz 以上呼叫的电台（拥挤的 FT8 波段上很常见）；收窄范围则可专注于窄滤波器或避开近距离强 QRM。

english: Retry marginal signals against hypotheses built from your call, the DX call and the QSO state (WSJT-X "Enable AP", on by default) — including the cross-cycle replay of last cycle's QSOs. FT8 only: FT4's AP is part of its Normal/Deep depth and has no separate switch.
chinese: 用你的呼号、对方呼号和 QSO 状态构建的假设重试边缘信号（WSJT-X 的“Enable AP”，默认开启）— 包括对上一周期 QSO 的跨周期重放。仅 FT8：FT4 的 AP 属于其标准/深深度的一部分，没有独立开关。

english: Limit AP to the "CQ" guess — no MyCall/DxCall hypotheses (FT8 and FT4). WSJT-X switches to this by itself after 5 minutes without transmitting, as a guard against stale-context false decodes; here it is your explicit choice. Off = full AP, the stock behavior.
chinese: 把 AP 限制在“CQ”猜测上 — 不使用 MyCall/DxCall 假设（FT8 与 FT4）。WSJT-X 在 5 分钟未发射后会自行切到此模式，以防上下文过期造成的误解码；这里由你显式选择。关闭 = 完整 AP，即原始行为。

english: Decode only within ±25 Hz of your green RX marker (the same one-station window WSJT-X uses for a double-click re-decode) instead of the whole passband — isolates one weak station and saves CPU. FT8 and FT4 only: 50 Hz is narrower than a single JT65, Q65 or MSK144 signal, so those modes keep the full passband. Applies while the RX marker sits inside the passband above; off = full passband, the stock behavior.
chinese: 仅在你的绿色 RX 标记 ±25 Hz 范围内解码（即 WSJT-X 双击重解码所用的单台窗口），而不是整个通带 — 可隔离单个弱信号并节省 CPU。仅 FT8 与 FT4：50 Hz 比单个 JT65、Q65 或 MSK144 信号还窄，因此那些模式仍用完整通带。仅当 RX 标记落在上方通带内时生效；关闭 = 完整通带，即原始行为。
do_not_translate: MSK144 | WSJT-X | JT65 | FT4 | FT8 | Q65 | Hz | RX

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital. The same English text "Off" is used by 17 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.contrast.off, settings.workspace.night.off, settings.workspace.field.off) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Off = normal FT8/FT4 operation. Hound = DXpedition pile-up discipline (calls above 1000 Hz; your report auto-moves to the Fox's frequency).
chinese: 关闭 = 常规 FT8/FT4 操作。Hound = DXpedition 堆叠纪律（在 1000 Hz 以上呼叫；你的报告会自动移到 Fox 的频率）。
do_not_translate: DXpedition | Hound | FT4 | FT8 | Fox | Hz

chinese: 旅程 — 追踪每周连续

english: Off by default. A gentle “weeks on the air” counter on the Journey board — never a daily streak, never a penalty for a break.
chinese: 默认关闭。在“旅程”看板上显示一个温和的“在空中多少周”计数 — 从不按天计，也不因中断而扣分。

english: Off = passive (hunt & pounce): Nexus listens and only transmits when you act. On = periodically calls CQ to announce you're on frequency.
chinese: 关闭 = 被动（守听并出击）：Nexus 只监听，仅在你操作时发射。开启 = 周期性呼叫 CQ 宣告你在频率上。

english: On (default) = a weak frame that fails is recovered by joint-combining its retransmissions (RV0+RV1+RV2), and unacknowledged QSO overs escalate redundancy. Off = RV0-only (each frame decoded on its own).
chinese: 开启（默认）= 失败的弱帧通过联合合并其重传（RV0+RV1+RV2）来恢复，未被确认的 QSO 发射会提高冗余度。关闭 = 仅 RV0（每帧独立解码）。

english: Measure your PC clock against public NTP servers and CORRECT for it: TempoFast/TempoDeep are slot-timed to UTC, and Nexus shifts its own transmit and decode windows by the measured offset so they land on the true UTC grid even when the clock is off. The top bar shows what is being applied. Turn off for fully-offline operation (no network calls) — the last measurement then keeps steering until it ages out.
chinese: 用公共 NTP 服务器测量本机时钟并据此校正：TempoFast/TempoDeep 按 UTC 划分时隙，Nexus 会按测得的偏移量平移自己的发射与解码窗口，即使时钟不准也能落在真实 UTC 栅格上。顶栏会显示当前应用的校正。完全离线运行时请关闭（不发起任何网络请求）— 最后一次测量会继续引导，直到过期。

english: Your transmit power in watts — logged on every contact as its power (ADIF TX_PWR), and unlocks the Journey miles-per-watt & QRP feats. Leave blank if unknown.
chinese: 你的发射功率（瓦）— 会作为功率记录到每次联络（ADIF TX_PWR），并解锁“旅程”中的每瓦英里数与 QRP 成就。不知道可留空。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Digital. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Distances, temperature and wind speed. Automatic follows your operating system's region. Applies everywhere in the app immediately.
chinese: 距离、温度和风速。自动跟随操作系统的区域设置。立即在应用内全局生效。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ JT65. The same English text "Submode (tone spacing)" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.q65.submode.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ JT65. The same English text "B — 2x spacing" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.q65.submode.b) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: C — 4 倍间隔，最耐多普勒

english: JT65 always uses a 60 s T/R period, so spacing is the only choice. A is what you want on HF; EME operators move up to B or C as Doppler spread on the higher bands smears the tones. Both stations must use the same submode.
chinese: JT65 始终使用 60 秒的收发周期，因此间隔是唯一可选项。HF 上应选 A；EME 操作者在高波段多普勒展宽把音调糊开时会改用 B 或 C。双方必须使用相同子模式。

english: The classic weak-signal and moonbounce mode, decoded and transmitted. Messages are the older 22-character format, not the 37-character one FT8 and friends use.
chinese: 经典的弱信号与月面反射模式，可解码也可发射。消息使用较早的 22 字符格式，而非 FT8 一类使用的 37 字符格式。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ MSK144. The same English text "T/R period" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.fst4.period.label, settings.q65.period.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 5 秒 — 快速交替，适合大流星雨

english: 30 s — sparse pings, more to stack
chinese: 30 秒 — 稀疏回波，可堆叠更多

english: MSK144 sends a 72 ms message over and over, so a single meteor trail lasting a tenth of a second can carry the whole thing. Shorter periods turn the exchange around faster during a shower; longer ones give the decoder more frames to stack when pings are sparse. Both stations must use the same period.
chinese: MSK144 会反复发送一条 72 ms 的消息，因此单条持续十分之一秒的流星余迹就能承载全部内容。较短的周期在流星雨期间交换更快；回波稀疏时较长周期给解码器更多可堆叠的帧。双方必须使用相同周期。

english: MSK144 transmits for nearly the whole period, sending the same 72 ms frame hundreds of times — that is how meteor scatter works, and a contact can take many minutes of apparent silence. The audio frequency is fixed at a 1500 Hz centre; the signal is 1 kHz wide, so there is nowhere to tune it. Shorthand (MSK40) messages are off, matching WSJT-X’s default.
chinese: MSK144 几乎在整个周期内发射，把同一 72 ms 帧发送数百次 — 这就是流星散射的工作方式，一次联络可能要经历数分钟的表面静默。音频频率固定在 1500 Hz 中心；信号宽 1 kHz，因此无处可调。简写（MSK40）消息默认关闭，与 WSJT-X 的默认一致。

english: Round Robin is scheduling — this percentage is not used. Set the slot to 0 to schedule by percentage.
chinese: 轮转由调度决定 — 此处百分比不使用。把槽位设为 0 即可改按百分比调度。

english: Ignored while Round Robin is active — the rotation decides which intervals transmit. Set the slot to 0 to schedule by percentage again.
chinese: 轮转生效期间此项被忽略 — 由轮转决定哪些间隔发射。把槽位设为 0 即可恢复按百分比调度。

english: Fraction of intervals to transmit on. 0 = listen only. A beacon that transmits every interval hears nothing, so a minority is the convention — 20–30% is typical. Below 40% Nexus also avoids back-to-back transmissions while still hitting the rate you asked for.
chinese: 发射所占的间隔比例。0 = 仅收听。每个间隔都发射的信标什么也听不到，所以只占少数是惯例 — 通常 20–30%。低于 40% 时 Nexus 还会避免连续发射，同时仍达到你要求的比例。

english: Required, and it has to be real. WSPR reports are published to a public propagation database that other operators draw conclusions from, so a wrong figure corrupts their data as well as yours. The beacon stays silent until this is set. 23 = 200 mW, 30 = 1 W, 37 = 5 W, 43 = 20 W.
chinese: 必填，且必须真实。WSPR 报告会发布到公开的传播数据库，其他操作者据此下结论，因此错误的数字既污染你的数据，也污染他们的。未设置前信标保持静默。23 = 200 mW，30 = 1 W，37 = 5 W，43 = 20 W。

english: 0 = use the transmit-% schedule. Otherwise your slot in a coordinated rotation: stations agreeing on the same slot count and each taking a different slot never transmit at the same time, because the assignment is fixed by UTC. A rotation needs at least 2 slots.
chinese: 0 = 使用发射占比调度。否则表示你在协同轮转中的槽位：约定相同槽位数的台站各占不同槽位，因分配由 UTC 固定，永远不会同时发射。轮转至少需要 2 个槽位。

english: A one-station rotation is no rotation — Round Robin needs at least 2 slots, so it is off and the transmit-% schedule applies.
chinese: 只有一台的轮转不算轮转 — 轮转至少需要 2 个槽位，因此已关闭，改用发射占比调度。

english: How many stations are in the rotation. Ignored when the slot is 0.
chinese: 参与轮转的台站数量。槽位为 0 时忽略。

english: Beacons transmit your callsign, grid and power — there is no QSO sequence, so Call CQ and S&P are inactive on these tiers. Transmit still has to be armed as usual; the schedule never keys a radio whose transmit you have not enabled.
chinese: 信标会发射你的呼号、网格和功率 — 没有 QSO 流程，因此这些层级上“呼叫 CQ”和“守听并出击”不可用。发射仍需照常启用；调度绝不会键控一部你未启用发射的电台。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ FST4. The same English text "T/R period" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.msk144.period.label, settings.q65.period.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 120 秒 — 最短 FST4W 信标间隔

english: Shared by both tiers. Longer periods hear weaker signals at fewer exchanges per hour. FST4W beacons run at 120/300/900/1800 s; FST4 QSO work is usually 15–60 s. Both stations (or the beacon you are listening for) must be on the same period.
chinese: 两个层级共用。周期越长越能听到弱信号，但每小时交换次数更少。FST4W 信标使用 120/300/900/1800 秒；FST4 QSO 通常为 15–60 秒。双方（或你在收听的信标）必须使用相同周期。

english: FST4 is the QSO mode; FST4W is the WSPR-like beacon mode — pick which one on the tier selector. Nexus decodes both and transmits neither. Note that FST4W hashed callsigns show as <...>: the lookup table upstream fills from a file this build does not carry.
chinese: FST4 是 QSO 模式；FST4W 是类似 WSPR 的信标模式 — 在层级选择器中挑选。Nexus 两者都能解码，但都不发射。注意 FST4W 的哈希呼号会显示为 <...>：上游用于填充的查表文件此版本未附带。
Q65 — EME / VHF 以上散射

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Q65. The same English text "T/R period" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.msk144.period.label, settings.fst4.period.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 30 秒 — 6 米流星 / 电离层散射

english: Longer periods integrate longer and hear weaker signals, at one exchange per period. Both stations must use the same period. Changing this changes the decode frame length, so it takes effect on the next slot.
chinese: 周期越长积分越久、越能听到弱信号，但每周期只完成一次交换。双方必须使用相同周期。更改此项会改变解码帧长，因此在下一个时隙生效。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Q65. The same English text "Submode (tone spacing)" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.jt65.submode.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Q65. The same English text "B — 2x spacing" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.jt65.submode.b) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: E — 16 倍间隔，最耐多普勒

english: Wider spacing survives more Doppler spread and frequency drift but costs sensitivity. Move up the letters as the path degrades — EME on the higher bands usually needs B or C.
chinese: 间隔越宽越能抵抗多普勒展宽与频率漂移，但牺牲灵敏度。路径变差时逐级上调 — 高波段 EME 通常需要 B 或 C。

english: Q65 transmits and receives. The period and submode set both what you hear and what you send, and BOTH STATIONS MUST MATCH — a correspondent on a different period or submode will not decode you.
chinese: Q65 可发可收。周期与子模式同时决定你听到什么和发送什么，且双方必须一致 — 周期或子模式不同的对方无法解码你。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Phone. The same English text "Mode" is used by 17 different keys (e.g. logEntry.override.mode.label, logbook.field.mode.label, logbook.column.mode) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Phone. The same English text "Phone mode" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. freq.mode.aria, phone.mode.aria) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: FM drives the rig to FM + the shift/tone below.
chinese: FM 会把电台切到 FM，并使用下方的偏移/亚音。

english: Offset is the band standard (2 m 600 k, 70 cm 5 M…).
chinese: 偏移量按波段标准（2 米 600 k，70 厘米 5 M…）。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Phone. The same English text "Off" is used by 17 different keys (e.g. settings.workspace.contrast.off, settings.workspace.night.off, settings.workspace.field.off) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

One-word control on: Settings ▸ Phone. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word. The same English text "Microphone" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. remote.stream.mic.notes) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Mic gain and voice-keyer message recording are in the Phone cockpit (live CAT + one-touch record).
chinese: 麦克风增益与语音键控消息录制在话音操作台中（实时 CAT + 一键录制）。

english: Mic used when RECORDING a voice-keyer message. Default records from the audio input device — but on a digital setup that's the rig's RX audio, so you'd record the band, not your voice. Pick your actual mic here. If it can't open, recording falls back to the input device (never silent).
chinese: 录制语音键控消息时使用的麦克风。默认从音频输入设备录制 — 但在数字配置下那是电台的 RX 音频，你会录到波段而不是自己的声音。请在此选择你真正的麦克风。若无法打开，录制会回退到输入设备（绝不会静默失败）。

notes: Abbreviation shown on: Settings ▸ CW. Check the screen before expanding or translating it. The same English text "CW" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. awards.chart.mode.cw) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Short label on: Settings ▸ CW. The same English text "Keyer" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. cw.keyer.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: CAT — the rig keys CW (Hamlib send_morse; newer rigs only)
chinese: CAT — 由电台发 CW（Hamlib send_morse；仅较新电台）

english: Serial keyline (DTR/RTS) — key the rig's KEY jack
chinese: 串口键控线（DTR/RTS）— 键控电台的 KEY 插孔

english: Soundcard — audio tone through a data mode (workaround)
chinese: 声卡 — 经数据模式发送音频音调（变通方案）

english: How Nexus sends CW. CAT uses the rig's internal keyer, but older rigs (e.g. IC-756PRO III) don't support it. Serial keyline toggles DTR/RTS into the rig's KEY jack (rig in CW, rig shapes the signal — a clean method that needs only a keying cable). WinKeyer drives a K1EL.Soundcard keys an audio tone — a workaround; set drive so ALC reads zero. It takes your radio out of CW into a data mode (DATA-U/DATA-L, so the tone reaches the transmitter instead of the mic jack); pick any other keyer and CW mode comes straight back. Also switchable live from the CW cockpit.
chinese: Nexus 如何发送 CW。CAT 使用电台内部键控器，但较老的电台（如 IC-756PRO III）不支持。串口键控线把 DTR/RTS 翻转送入电台的 KEY 插孔（电台处于 CW 模式，由电台整形信号 — 干净的方法，只需一根键控线）。WinKeyer 驱动 K1EL 硬件。声卡键控一个音频音调 — 属于变通方案；请调整驱动力使 ALC 读数为零。它会把你的电台带离 CW，进入数据模式（DATA-U/DATA-L，好让音调到达发射机而不是麦克风插孔）；选择其他任何键控器，CW 模式会立刻恢复。也可在 CW 操作台中实时切换。
do_not_translate: <b> | WinKeyer | DATA-L | DATA-U | Nexus | DATA | K1EL | ALC | CAT | CW | IC-756PRO | DTR/RTS
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Soundcard" is the on-screen text of cw.keyer.soundcard.label. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint points at a menu entry that no longer exists.

english: CAT CW keying is unproven on this radio. Its Hamlib backend sends a different keying command from the one other radios use, and it reports success either way — so if nothing is transmitted, Nexus cannot tell you. If CW doesn't go out, use the Serial keyline, WinKeyer, or Soundcard keyer.
chinese: CAT CW 键控在这部电台上尚未验证。其 Hamlib 后端发送的键控命令与其他电台使用的不同，而无论成败它都会报成功 — 所以如果没有发出任何信号，Nexus 无法告诉你。若 CW 发不出去，请改用串口键控线、WinKeyer 或声卡键控。

english: On a Flex over SmartSDR CAT, Esc stops Nexus at once, but the radio may finish the word it is sending: SmartSDR CAT has no documented CW stop, so Nexus hands the radio one word at a time. For a stop that cuts mid-word, choose the WinKeyer keyer on SmartSDR CAT's WinKeyer port, or use the Flex native client.
chinese: 在通过 SmartSDR CAT 连接的 Flex 上，Esc 会立即让 Nexus 停止，但电台可能把正在发送的那个词发完：SmartSDR CAT 没有公开的 CW 停止指令，因此 Nexus 一次只交给电台一个词。若需要能中途截断的停止，请在 SmartSDR CAT 的 WinKeyer 端口上选择 WinKeyer 键控器，或使用 Flex 原生客户端。

english: CW tone pitch (300–1200 Hz) — the soundcard keyer tone and the CW scope zero-beat marker.
chinese: CW 音调音高（300–1200 Hz）— 影响声卡键控音调与 CW 频谱中的零拍标记。

english: Use reverse CW on every band
chinese: 在所有波段使用反向 CW

english: Put your radio in its reverse CW mode (CW-R / CW-L) instead of its normal CW, on every band. Off by default, so Nexus asks for plain CW and your radio stays where its own menu puts it. This changes only the pitch you hear on a signal — CW and CW-R transmit identically, and the station you work cannot tell — so it is a personal preference, not a band rule. Which sideband it actually selects depends on the radio: on a Yaesu it is CW-L, while on an Icom it follows that rig's own CW Normal Side menu. The Soundcard keyer ignores this, because it never puts the rig in CW at all.
chinese: 把电台置于反向 CW 模式（CW-R / CW-L），而不是常规 CW，且在所有波段。默认关闭，因此 Nexus 请求的是普通 CW，你的电台保持其菜单设定的状态。这只改变你听到某个信号时的音高 — CW 与 CW-R 的发射完全相同，与你通联的台站察觉不到 — 所以这是个人偏好，不是波段规则。实际选中哪个边带取决于电台：Yaesu 上是 CW-L，而 Icom 上则跟随该机自身的 CW Normal Side 菜单。声卡键控器忽略此项，因为它根本不把电台切到 CW。
do_not_translate: <b> | Nexus | Yaesu | CW-L | CW-R | Icom | CW

english: The serial port your WinKey presents. 1200 baud. A WinKey micro inside a multi-function interface (Timewave Navigator, microHAM) counts — use that device's CW/WinKey port, not its CAT port.
chinese: 你的 WinKey 呈现的串口。1200 波特。多功能接口（Timewave Navigator、microHAM）内置的 WinKey 芯片也算 — 请使用该设备的 CW/WinKey 端口，而不是它的 CAT 端口。
键控接口（与 CAT 分开）

english: The USB-to-serial into your keying interface (Buxcomm, a homebrew DTR cable, …) that plugs into the rig's KEY jack. Must be a SEPARATE port from CAT. Set the rig to CW and its key-jack to straight-key / bug. An interface with a WinKey chip in it — Timewave Navigator, microHAM, a K1EL WinKeyer — does not key on DTR: pick the WinKeyer backend above instead and give it that device's CW port.
chinese: 接入你键控接口（Buxcomm、自制 DTR 线等）的 USB 转串口，该接口插在电台的 KEY 插孔上。必须是与 CAT 分开的端口。请把电台设为 CW 模式，并把其键控插孔设为直键/臭虫键。内置 WinKey 芯片的接口 — Timewave Navigator、microHAM、K1EL WinKeyer — 不会用 DTR 键控：请改选上方的 WinKeyer 后端，并给它该设备的 CW 端口。

english: Which control line keys the rig. DTR is standard (RTS = PTT); flip to RTS if your interface is wired the other way.
chinese: 哪条控制线键控电台。DTR 是标准（RTS = PTT）；若你的接口是反接的，改用 RTS。

english: Keys your callsign in CW once the final 73 has fully left the air, in Q65, FST4 and MSK144 (stock WSJT-X option, default off). As in WSJT-X, FT8 and FT4 send no CW ID, and neither do FT2, TempoFast or TempoDeep. Uses the normal CW keying path — PTT + tone — after the over, never on top of it.
chinese: 在最后的 73 完全离开空中之后，用 CW 拍发你的呼号，适用于 Q65、FST4 和 MSK144（WSJT-X 原始选项，默认关闭）。与 WSJT-X 一致，FT8 和 FT4 不发送 CW 标识，FT2、TempoFast 和 TempoDeep 也不发。使用常规 CW 键控路径 — PTT + 音调 — 在发射之后，绝不叠在其上。
do_not_translate: CW | 73 | Q65 | FST4 | MSK144 | WSJT-X | FT8 | FT4 | FT2 | TempoFast | TempoDeep | PTT

english: Using the built-in F1–F8 set. Customize to make them your own (labels + templates; tokens: {MYCALL} {RST} {NAME} and ! = the worked call).
chinese: 正在使用内置的 F1–F8 组合。自定义可让它们成为你自己的（标签 + 模板；令牌：{MYCALL} {RST} {NAME}，以及 ! = 对方呼号）。
notes: Contains CW macro tokens in SINGLE braces ({NAME}, {RST}...). These are matched literally by the macro expander — copy them exactly, do not translate or reorder them against the words that explain them.
One-word control on: Settings ▸ CW. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Tokens: {MYCALL} {NAME} {MYGRID} {MYSTATE} {RST} · ! = the worked call · {HISNAME} {HISSTATE} = the worked station's QRZ name/state (fill in Settings ▸ Station for {MYSTATE}; the rest auto-fill from the copilot / roster click + QRZ lookup). Each key KEEPS its role — the Guided copilot's next-step highlight follows the role, so customized text still rolls through F1→F2→F3→F4 exactly as before. Keep the ! token wherever you want the other station's call inserted. Save to apply.
chinese: 令牌：{MYCALL} {NAME} {MYGRID} {MYSTATE} {RST} · ! = 对方呼号 · {HISNAME} {HISSTATE} = 对方在 QRZ 上的姓名/州（{MYSTATE} 需在“设置 ▸ 台站”中填写；其余由副驾/名单点击 + QRZ 查询自动填充）。每个键都保留其角色 — 引导式副驾的下一步高亮跟随角色，因此自定义文本仍会像以前一样按 F1→F2→F3→F4 推进。请在你希望插入对方呼号的位置保留 ! 令牌。保存后生效。

chinese: 打开 RTTY 时开始接收

english: The RTTY screen starts the decoder as soon as you open it — tune a signal and the text prints, no setup. Turn this off to arm the receiver by hand (the Arm RX button in the decoded-text pane). This arms the RECEIVER only — transmitting is never armed for you.
chinese: RTTY 界面一打开就启动解码器 — 调到某个信号上文字就会打印，无需设置。关闭此项则需手动启用接收（解码文本窗格中的“启用接收”按钮）。这只会启用接收机 — 发射绝不会替你启用。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ RTTY. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: AFSK — soundcard tones through the rig in LSB (default)
chinese: AFSK — 声卡音调经电台以 LSB 发送（默认）

english: True FSK — serial keyline (DTR/RTS), rig in RTTY mode
chinese: 真 FSK — 串口键控线（DTR/RTS），电台处于 RTTY 模式

english: How Nexus transmits RTTY. AFSK plays the two-tone waveform through the same TX audio path as FT8 (soundcard-clocked = jitter-free; set drive so ALC reads just zero). True FSK bit-bangs the rig's FSK input over a serial control line with the rig in RTTY mode — unlocking its narrow RTTY filters (e.g. the FTDX10's) — with PTT on CAT or its own line. Software FSK timing is casual/Field-Day grade; AFSK is the timing-cleanest path.
chinese: Nexus 如何发送 RTTY。AFSK 通过与 FT8 相同的发射音频通路播放双音波形（由声卡定时 = 无抖动；请调整驱动力使 ALC 刚好读到零）。真 FSK 通过一条串口控制线按位翻转电台的 FSK 输入、电台处于 RTTY 模式 — 从而解锁其窄带 RTTY 滤波器（例如 FTDX10 的）— PTT 走 CAT 或它自己的线。软件 FSK 的时序只到休闲/Field Day 水平；AFSK 是时序最干净的路径。
do_not_translate: <b> | Nexus | AFSK | RTTY | ALC | CAT | FSK | FT8 | PTT | TX | FTDX10

english: The sideband the rig runs AFSK on. LSB is the RTTY convention. On USB, Nexus puts the rig in its upper data mode (DATA-U / USB-D / DIGU) and swaps the tones itself, so mark stays high on the air and the decoder still copies — leave Reverse off.
chinese: 电台跑 AFSK 所用的边带。LSB 是 RTTY 惯例。在 USB 下，Nexus 会把电台置入其上部数据模式（DATA-U / USB-D / DIGU）并自行交换音调，这样 mark 在空中仍是高音，解码器照样能抄收 — 请保持“反向”关闭。
do_not_translate: AFSK | LSB | RTTY | USB | Nexus | DATA-U | USB-D

english: e.g. the FTDX10's USB Enhanced COM
chinese: 例如 FTDX10 的 USB Enhanced COM

english: The port whose control line feeds the rig's FSK input. Empty = the CAT serial port.
chinese: 其控制线馈送电台 FSK 输入的端口。留空 = 使用 CAT 串口。

english: DTR (the common wiring — RTS stays free for PTT)
chinese: DTR（常见接法 — RTS 留给 PTT）

english: Which control line carries the data bits. PTT must ride its OWN path — CAT PTT or the separate PTT line, never this one; Nexus refuses a send if they collide.
chinese: 哪条控制线承载数据位。PTT 必须走它自己独立的通路 — CAT PTT 或独立的 PTT 线，绝不能用这条；若两者冲突，Nexus 会拒绝发送。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ RTTY. The same English text "Signal" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. map.colorBy.snr.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Drives the TX bit clock and the RX demodulator (true 45.45, never rounded to 45).
chinese: 同时驱动发射位时钟与接收解调器（真 45.45，绝不取整为 45）。

english: Mark/space spacing — the TX tone pair and the RX demodulator both.
chinese: mark/space 间距 — 同时用于发射音调对与接收解调器。

english: Swaps mark and space on TX and in the RX decoder, to work a station sending upside down. Not for running USB: pick the AFSK sideband instead, which keeps the sense right on its own.
chinese: 在发射和接收解码器中交换 mark 与 space，用于与颠倒发射的台站通联。不要用它来跑 USB：请改选 AFSK 边带，它会自行保持正确的极性。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ RTTY. The same English text "Auto call" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. rtty.autoCq.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: How long Auto call waits before it calls CQ again, in seconds — and the same wait before it asks a station for a repeat. The clock starts when your over has finished going out, not when it was queued. 30 seconds is what Auto call has always done; change it only if you want a faster or slower cycle. Anything under 5 seconds would key over the answer you just asked for, so 5 is the floor.
chinese: 自动呼叫在再次呼叫 CQ 之前等待多久（秒）— 以及向某台请求重发前的相同等待。计时从你本次发射完全结束开始，而不是从排队时开始。30 秒是自动呼叫一直以来的做法；只有在你想让节奏更快或更慢时才改。低于 5 秒会在你刚刚请求的答复上直接键控，因此下限是 5。

english: How many times Auto call asks again inside a contact before it lets that station go. This does not limit CQ. An unanswered CQ repeats until you stop it — that is what the Stop button and the TX switch are for.
chinese: 自动呼叫在一次联络中向某台再请求多少次后才放手。这不会限制 CQ。无人应答的 CQ 会一直重复直到你停止 — 这正是“停止”按钮和 TX 开关的用途。

notes: Abbreviation shown on: Settings ▸ PSK. Check the screen before expanding or translating it.

chinese: 打开 PSK 时开始接收

english: The PSK screen starts the decoder as soon as you open it — click a trace on the waterfall and the text prints, no setup. Turn this off to arm the receiver by hand (the Arm RX button in the decoded-text pane). Stopping the receiver yourself is already remembered for the rest of the session. This arms the RECEIVER only — transmitting is never armed for you.
chinese: PSK 界面一打开就启动解码器 — 在瀑布图上点击一条迹线，文字就会打印，无需设置。关闭此项则需手动启用接收（解码文本窗格中的“启用接收”按钮）。你自己停止接收机的状态会在本次会话内记住。这只会启用接收机 — 发射绝不会替你启用。
打开 JTTY 时开始接收

english: The JTTY screen starts its decoder as soon as you open it. Turn this off to arm the receiver by hand (the Arm RX button in the All decodes pane). Stopping the receiver yourself is already remembered for the rest of the session. This arms the RECEIVER only — transmitting is never armed for you.
chinese: JTTY 界面一打开就启动其解码器。关闭此项则需手动启用接收（“全部解码”窗格中的“启用接收”按钮）。你自己停止接收机的状态会在本次会话内记住。这只会启用接收机 — 发射绝不会替你启用。

notes: Abbreviation shown on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8. Check the screen before expanding or translating it.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8. The same English text "Transmit speed" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.header.speed.aria) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The speed your frames go out at, and the period the TX clock follows: Slow 30 s, Normal 15 s, Fast 10 s, JS8 40 6 s, JS8 60 4 s. Normal is what most of the band runs. JS8 40 (called Turbo before JS8Call 3.0) and JS8 60 are for strong signals; JS8Call 3.0 marks JS8 60 experimental. The speed chips in the JS8 header change this same setting.
chinese: 你的帧以何种速度发送，以及 TX 时钟跟随的周期：Slow 30 秒、Normal 15 秒、Fast 10 秒、JS8 40 6 秒、JS8 60 4 秒。波段上大多用 Normal。JS8 40（JS8Call 3.0 之前称为 Turbo）和 JS8 60 用于强信号；JS8Call 3.0 将 JS8 60 标为实验性。JS8 顶栏的速度胶囊改动的是同一个设置。
do_not_translate: JS8 40 | JS8 60 | Turbo | JS8Call | JS8 | TX

english: Every speed is decoded at once by default, as JS8Call does — a Slow station and a JS8 60 station on the same band both print. Untick a speed to save CPU on a small machine; each activity row is marked with its speed letter (E/A/B/C/I). A list saved before JS8 60 arrived keeps the four speeds it had: tick JS8 60 to add it.
chinese: 默认同时解码所有速度，与 JS8Call 一致 — 同一波段上的 Slow 台站和 JS8 60 台站都会打印出来。取消勾选某个速度可在小机器上节省 CPU；每条活动行都标有其速度字母（E/A/B/C/I）。在 JS8 60 出现之前保存的列表会保留原有四个速度：勾选 JS8 60 即可加入。

notes: Label of a number field in Settings, JS8 section: how many minutes after a station was last heard it is taken off the JS8 Stations list. "Aging" is what JS8Call calls this.

english: Off (0) by default, as in JS8Call. Otherwise a station not heard for this many minutes leaves the Stations list, unless you have it selected or it has an unread message for you, and your HEARING? replies leave it out. Up to 1440 (a day).
chinese: 默认关闭（0），与 JS8Call 一致。否则，若某台站已有这么多分钟未被听到，就会从台站列表中移除，除非你选中了它或它有给你的未读消息，且你的 HEARING? 回复也会排除它。最大 1440（一天）。
notes: Help text under the Callsign aging field. Stations is the name of the JS8 screen's list of heard stations. HEARING? is a JS8 command word and is not translated.

Label of a number field in Settings, JS8 section: after how many minutes a row of the JS8 cockpit's Band activity pane (one row per frequency offset in the passband) is taken off. "Aging" is what JS8Call calls this.

english: 2 by default, as in JS8Call. A row of the Band activity pane whose newest decode is this many minutes old leaves the pane, unless RX is on its offset. 0 keeps every row. Up to 1440 (a day).
chinese: 默认 2，与 JS8Call 一致。若“波段活动”窗格中某行的最新解码已过这么多分钟，该行会离开窗格，除非 RX 正落在它的偏移上。0 表示保留所有行。最大 1440（一天）。
notes: Help text under the Band activity aging field. Band activity is the name of the JS8 pane with one row per frequency offset (js8.panel.offsets — not yet in this kit). RX, the receive offset, is not translated.

Heading of a group in Settings, JS8 section: the JS8 frequency list, returning to the last frequency, and the band schedule. The same English text "Frequencies" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. sat.radio.frequencies.head) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Return to the last used frequency

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, opening JS8 tunes the rig back to the frequency you last used in JS8, instead of the band's JS8 frequency.
chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致。开启后，打开 JS8 会把电台调回你上次在 JS8 中使用的频率，而不是该波段的 JS8 频率。

chinese: JS8Call 建议的频率。改动、增加或删除任一项后，列表就变成你自己的：JS8 中的波段选择器会显示它，打开 JS8 时调谐到该波段上的第一个。

chinese: 你自己的列表：JS8 中的波段选择器会显示它，打开 JS8 时调谐到该波段上的第一个。重置可恢复 JS8Call 的建议频率。

chinese: 无法保存 JS8 频率

notes: The same English text "Import…" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. awards.custom.import) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: That file holds no JS8 frequencies Nexus can read. Use a file this list exported.
chinese: 该文件中没有 Nexus 能读取的 JS8 频率。请使用本列表导出的文件。

english: JS8 frequencies imported: {{count}}. Save to keep them.
chinese: 已导入 JS8 频率：{{count}}。保存后生效。
替换你的 JS8 频率？

english: Your list is replaced by the one in this file.
chinese: 你的列表会被此文件中的列表替换。

notes: Switch in Settings, JS8 section: JS8Call's "Automatically switch bands / frequencies at specific times of day". It moves the radio by itself, so keep the meaning plain.

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, Nexus changes the rig's frequency BY ITSELF at the times below, with nobody at the radio: a notice first, then the change 30 seconds later unless you cancel it. Never while transmitting or while a message is going out.
chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致。开启后，Nexus 会在下列时间自行更换电台频率，无人值守：先提示，30 秒后执行更改，除非你取消。绝不在发射时或消息正在发送时进行。
notes: BY ITSELF is in capitals on purpose: the radio changes frequency with nobody at it.

english: Each row: a frequency, and from when until when (UTC) to be on it. The frequency does not change back when a row ends; add another row for that. Where rows overlap, the one that starts later wins.
chinese: 每行：一个频率，以及从何时到何时（UTC）使用它。某行结束时频率不会自动改回；请另加一行。行之间重叠时，开始较晚的那行优先。

english: The frequency does not change back at this time. Add another row to return.
chinese: 到此时间频率不会自动改回。要返回请再加一行。

english: Frequency of the new row in MHz

0 = a heartbeat only when you press HB. Otherwise, while the HB chip is on, one goes out every this-many minutes on a random free slot between 500 and 1000 Hz. The HB chip itself is never remembered across launches, and nothing keys unless TX is on.
chinese: 0 = 仅在你按 HB 时发送一次心跳。否则，在 HB 胶囊开启时，每隔这么多分钟在 500 至 1000 Hz 之间的随机空闲时隙发送一次。HB 胶囊状态本身绝不会跨启动记忆；且除非 TX 已开启，否则不会键控。

english: 0 = the CQ button sends one CQ, as it does today. Above 0 the button becomes a switch: leave it on and a CQ goes out every this-many minutes, with the seconds to the next one counting down on the button — the POTA and beacon habit. A station answering you turns it off, so does the idle watchdog, and so does Stop TX. It is never remembered across launches, and nothing keys unless TX is on.
chinese: 0 = CQ 按钮只发送一次 CQ，与现在一致。大于 0 时该按钮变成开关：保持开启就每隔这么多分钟发出一次 CQ，按钮上会倒计时到下一次 — 这是 POTA 与信标的习惯。有台站应答你时会关闭它，空闲看门狗也会，停止发射也会。它绝不会跨启动记忆，且除非 TX 已开启，否则不会键控。
notes: "Stop TX" is the button's own name, English on purpose (the README).

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, a heard heartbeat is answered with your signal report (HEARTBEAT SNR), one frame per station, and a message you hold for that station is offered to it. Needs TX on.
chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致。开启后，听到的心跳会用你的信号报告（HEARTBEAT SNR）应答，每台一帧，并且你为那台保留的消息也会提供给它。需要 TX 开启。

english: Never acknowledge heartbeats from these callsigns
chinese: 永不答应这些呼号的心跳
notes: Label of a text field in Settings, JS8 section: a comma-separated list of callsigns. JS8Call names this setting the same way.

english: Comma-separated, empty by default as in JS8Call. A heartbeat from a station on this list draws no acknowledgement.
chinese: 逗号分隔，默认留空，与 JS8Call 一致。来自此列表中台站的心跳不会被应答。
notes: Help text under the heartbeat deny-list field. A heartbeat is JS8's periodic beacon; the acknowledgement is the automatic reply to it.
JS8Call’s heartbeat networking switch: heartbeats and their acknowledgements go out only with it on.

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call (its Mode ▸ Enable Heartbeat Networking). On, the cockpit shows the HB button and Answer heartbeats can answer the heartbeats you hear; off, no heartbeat and no heartbeat acknowledgement goes out. The same switch as the cockpit’s HB NET.
chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致（其“Mode ▸ Enable Heartbeat Networking”）。开启后，操作台会显示 HB 按钮，且“应答心跳”可以应答你听到的心跳；关闭则不发心跳，也不发心跳确认。与操作台的 HB NET 是同一个开关。
notes: Mode ▸ Enable Heartbeat Networking is JS8Call’s own menu item, in that program’s English.

chinese: 允许心跳在 500–1000 Hz 之外

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, your heartbeats and heartbeat acknowledgements go out on your own TX offset. Off, each goes on a free spot between 500 and 1000 Hz, and a heartbeat stays on your offset if it is at or below 1000 Hz.
chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致。开启后，你的心跳与心跳确认会发在你自己的 TX 偏移上。关闭时，每次都会发在 500 至 1000 Hz 之间的空闲位置，而若你的偏移在 1000 Hz 及以下，心跳会留在该偏移上。

english: Pause heartbeats while a call is in the To box
chinese: “收件人”框中有呼号时暂停心跳
notes: The To box is the JS8 dock’s addressee field.

english: On by default, as in JS8Call (its pause while in a QSO). While the cockpit’s To box holds a call, the heartbeat repeat pauses and starts again one interval after you clear the box, no heartbeat is acknowledged, and a repeating CQ stops. Turning the heartbeat repeat on clears the To box.
chinese: 默认开启，与 JS8Call 一致（其在 QSO 期间的暂停）。当操作台的“收件人”框中有呼号时，心跳重复会暂停，并在你清空该框后间隔一个周期重新开始；此间不应答任何心跳，重复的 CQ 也会停止。重新开启心跳重复会清空“收件人”框。

english: Don’t acknowledge stations that heartbeat more often than every 55 minutes
chinese: 不应答心跳频繁于每 55 分钟一次的台站

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call 3.0. On, a station heard heartbeating again within 55 minutes of its last acknowledged heartbeat is added to Never acknowledge heartbeats from these callsigns, as JS8Call adds it to its list, and the cockpit’s HB ACK chip names it. Take it off that list to acknowledge it again; turning this off leaves the list as it is.
chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 3.0 一致。开启后，若某台站在其上次被确认的心跳后 55 分钟内再次听到心跳，会被加入“永不答应这些呼号的心跳”，正如 JS8Call 将其加入其列表，操作台的 HB ACK 胶囊会标出它。要再次应答它，请把它从该列表中移除；关闭此项则列表保持不变。

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, nothing addressed to @ALLCALL is answered (a QUERY MSGS included) or marked as addressed to you, and @ALLCALL leaves the To box’s list. Heartbeats and CQs are handled as before.
chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致。开启后，任何发往 @ALLCALL 的内容都不会被应答（包括 QUERY MSGS），也不会被标记为发给你的，且 @ALLCALL 会从“收件人”框的列表中移除。心跳与 CQ 的处理方式不变。

english: On by default, as in JS8Call: SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, STATUS?, HEARING? and QUERY MSGS addressed to you are answered, and a MSG to you or to a group you joined, or a MSG TO: you hold for another station, gets an ACK; each one first asks for your Yes in the cockpit, unless you turn that off below. On @ALLCALL only QUERY MSGS is answered, when a message waits for that station, at most once every 15 minutes. Off, a reply is put in the message box for you to send, as JS8Call does, and QUERY MSGS is not answered. Needs TX on.
chinese: 默认开启，与 JS8Call 一致：发给你的 SNR?、GRID?、INFO?、STATUS?、HEARING? 和 QUERY MSGS 会被应答；发给你的、或发给你所加入群组的 MSG，以及你为另一台站保留的 MSG TO:，会得到 ACK；除你在下方关闭确认外，每次都会先在操作台中征求你的“是”。在 @ALLCALL 上仅当有消息在等该台站时才应答 QUERY MSGS，且最多每 15 分钟一次。关闭后，回复会被放进消息框由你发送，与 JS8Call 一致，且 QUERY MSGS 不应答。需要 TX 开启。
do_not_translate: JS8Call | SNR? | GRID? | INFO? | STATUS? | HEARING? | QUERY MSGS | MSG | MSG TO: | ACK | @ALLCALL | TX
notes: Help text under the Auto-reply switch in Settings, JS8 section. The capitalised words are JS8 command words and are not translated; @ALLCALL is JS8's address for everyone. The cockpit is the JS8 screen.

english: Ask for confirmation before sending automatic replies
chinese: 发送自动回复前征求确认
notes: Label of an on/off switch in Settings, JS8 section. JS8Call calls it "Ask for confirmation before sending autoreply transmissions".

english: On by default, as in JS8Call: every automatic reply (to a query, an ACK, a relay, a heartbeat acknowledgement) waits in the cockpit for your Yes, and is not sent if you say No or do not answer within 89 seconds. Off, each goes by itself in the next period.
chinese: 默认开启，与 JS8Call 一致：每次自动回复（对询问、ACK、中继、心跳确认）都会在操作台中等待你的“是”，若你选“否”或 89 秒内未作答则不发送。关闭后，每次都会在下一个周期自行发出。
notes: Help text under the confirmation switch. ACK is a JS8 command word and is not translated. The cockpit is the JS8 screen.
Label of a text field in Settings, JS8 section: a comma-separated list of callsigns. JS8Call names this setting the same way.

english: Comma-separated. Empty, the JS8Call default, answers everyone. Otherwise only a station on this list, by its call as heard or its base call (W1AW covers W1AW/P), is answered; anyone else is not acted on at all: no reply, no relay, nothing filed or held for them.
chinese: 逗号分隔。留空（JS8Call 默认）则应答所有人。否则只应答此列表中的台站，按其听到的呼号或基础呼号（W1AW 覆盖 W1AW/P）；对其他人完全不动作：不回复、不中继，也不为其归档或保留任何东西。
notes: Help text under the allow-list field. W1AW and W1AW/P are callsigns and are not translated; a base call is a callsign without its /P or prefix part.

chinese: 永不自动回复这些呼号
notes: Label of a text field in Settings, JS8 section: a comma-separated list of callsigns. JS8Call names this setting the same way.

english: Comma-separated, empty by default as in JS8Call. A station on this list (W1AW covers W1AW/P) is not acted on at all: no reply, no relay, its message not filed.
chinese: 逗号分隔，默认留空，与 JS8Call 一致。此列表中的台站（W1AW 覆盖 W1AW/P）完全不动作：不回复、不中继，其消息也不归档。
notes: Help text under the deny-list field. W1AW and W1AW/P are callsigns and are not translated.

english: On by default, as in JS8Call: a message routed through your callsign is passed along (with Auto-reply off, it is put in the message box for you to send), and MSG TO: messages are held in your inbox until the addressee asks for them. This is third-party traffic — whether it is permitted where you operate is your call.
chinese: 默认开启，与 JS8Call 一致：经你呼号路由的消息会被转发（若关闭自动回复，则放入消息框由你发送），且 MSG TO: 消息会在你的收件箱中保留，直到收件人索取。这属于第三方转信 — 在你所在地区是否允许，由你判断。
notes: Help text under the Relay switch in Settings, JS8 section. MSG TO: is a JS8 command word and is not translated. The message box is the JS8 cockpit's text field where you type a message.

english: After this long with nothing typed, heartbeats, auto-replies and relaying all switch off and the cockpit says so — the JS8Call rule, so an unattended station goes quiet. 60 by default; 0 turns the watchdog off; anything below 5 counts as 5. TX enable is left as it was.
chinese: 在这么长时间无任何输入后，心跳、自动回复和中继全部关闭，操作台会说明 — 即 JS8Call 的规则，让无人值守的台站安静下来。默认 60；0 关闭看门狗；小于 5 按 5 计。TX 启用状态保持不变。

notes: Names the INFO text of JS8: what this station sends back when another station asks it INFO? over the air. INFO is JS8's own command word, so it stays as it is.

english: What an INFO? query gets back — rig, antenna, power, a QTH. Upper-case letters, digits and basic punctuation pack tightest; anything else costs extra frames.
chinese: INFO? 询问会得到什么 — 电台、天线、功率、QTH。大写字母、数字和基本标点打包最紧；其他字符会多耗帧。

notes: Names the STATUS text of JS8: what this station sends back when another station asks it STATUS? over the air. STATUS is JS8's own command word, so it stays as it is.

english: What a STATUS? query gets back. Leave it blank for the JS8Call form: IDLE, the idle minutes, and the app name.
chinese: STATUS? 询问会得到什么。留空则使用 JS8Call 的格式：IDLE、空闲分钟数以及应用名称。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8. The same English text "Groups" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. memories.editor.groups.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The @GROUP names you belong to, comma-separated — a message to one of them counts as addressed to you. @ALLCALL is everyone and is always on.
chinese: 你所属的 @GROUP 名称，逗号分隔 — 发给其中之一的消息视为发给你。@ALLCALL 代表所有人，始终启用。
notes: @ALLCALL is a JS8 address and stays as it is. In "@GROUP", GROUP stands for the name of any group, written with an @ in front.

Title of a group of switches in Settings, JS8 section: how JS8 sends a message. The same English text "Sending" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. logEntry.sent.label, rtty.txline.sending) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Label of a switch in Settings, JS8 section. A JS8 message goes out as several frames, one per period; PTT is the transmit key and is not translated.

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, the radio stays keyed from the end of one frame of a message until the next frame starts, instead of dropping PTT after each frame and keying again. PTT still drops after the last frame, and at once when you stop transmitting.
chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致。开启后，从一条消息某帧结束到下一帧开始，电台保持键控，而不是每帧之后释放 PTT 再重新键控。最后一帧后 PTT 仍会释放，你停止发射时也会立即释放。
notes: Help text under the Hold PTT between frames switch. A frame is one transmission of part of a JS8 message, one per period.

english: Allow TX offset changes while sending
chinese: 发送期间允许更改 TX 偏移
notes: Label of a switch in Settings, JS8 section. The TX offset is the audio frequency the station transmits on in the passband (the red marker on the waterfall).

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call: while a message is waiting to go or going out, the TX offset stays where it is. On, you can move it at once: the frame on the air moves too, from where it has got to, and the frames still to go are sent at the new offset.
chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致：当消息正在等待发送或正在发送时，TX 偏移保持不变。开启后你可以立即移动它：空中的这一帧也会从它已到达的位置跟着移动，尚未发送的帧则按新偏移发送。
notes: Help text under the Allow TX offset changes while sending switch.
Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Sending, beside a list of delays in seconds. TX is the transmitter.

english: How long before each period a JS8 frame keys the radio, as JS8Call's Tx delay (0.2 s by default). The frame's first tone still goes out on time, at the period's start delay, so a radio slow to key no longer sends it late. Lengthen it for an amplifier or a radio whose relay is slow.
chinese: 每个周期之前多久键控电台，即 JS8Call 的 Tx delay（默认 0.2 秒）。该帧的第一个音调仍会按时在周期的起始延迟处发出，因此键控较慢的电台不再发晚。对功放或继电器较慢的电台请加长。
notes: Help text under the TX delay list. A frame is one transmission of part of a JS8 message, one per period; to key the radio is to switch it to transmit. Tx delay is the name of the same setting in JS8Call and stays in English.
One entry of the TX delay list: {{s}} is a number of seconds such as 0.2, written with a dot.
Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.
Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.

english: What the CQ button and the repeating CQ send. {{default}}, the JS8Call default, is one CQ frame, and so is any of the eight CQ forms in the list. Longer text takes more frames. It must start with CQ or hold your callsign. Empty sends CQ CQ CQ and your square.
chinese: CQ 按钮和重复 CQ 所发送的内容。{{default}} 是 JS8Call 的默认值，为一个 CQ 帧，列表中的八种 CQ 形式也都是。文本更长会占用更多帧。它必须以 CQ 开头或包含你的呼号。留空则发送 CQ CQ CQ 和你的网格。
notes: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.
Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.

english: What REPLY sends to the call in the To box. {{default}} is the JS8Call default.
chinese: REPLY 向“收件人”框中的呼号发送的内容。{{default}} 是 JS8Call 的默认值。
notes: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.

The same English text "Add" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. watchlist.add.submit, js8.calls.add.ok, settings.js8.freqs.add.action) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The Saved menu by the JS8 compose box lists these, in this order. A saved message goes to the call in the To box, or to everyone when the box is empty.
chinese: JS8 撰写框旁的“已保存”菜单按此顺序列出这些消息。已保存消息会发给“收件人”框中的呼号，框为空时发给所有人。
notes: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.

english: These words are replaced with your own when a message is used, in saved messages and in the CQ, reply, INFO and STATUS text:
chinese: 使用消息时，以下词语会被替换为你自己的内容，适用于已保存消息以及 CQ、回复、INFO 和 STATUS 文本：
notes: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.

english: Send CQ, REPLY, SNR, INFO, STATUS, saved messages and a station's asks at once
chinese: 立即发送 CQ、REPLY、SNR、INFO、STATUS、已保存消息以及台站的请求
notes: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.

english: On by default, as in JS8Call. Off, those buttons put their message in the compose box and Send sends it. The repeating CQ always sends.
chinese: 默认开启，与 JS8Call 一致。关闭后，这些按钮会把消息放进撰写框，由“发送”发出。重复 CQ 始终直接发送。
notes: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.

english: Show calls and commands as pills in the compose box
chinese: 在撰写框中把呼号与命令显示为胶囊
notes: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.

english: On by default, as in JS8Call 3.0. Point at a pill to read what that part of the message does.
chinese: 默认开启，与 JS8Call 3.0 一致。把指针悬停在胶囊上可查看消息该部分的作用。
notes: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.

english: Suggest cheaper words in the compose box
chinese: 在撰写框中建议更省字数的词
notes: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.

english: On by default, as in JS8Call. A word the JS8 dictionary sends in pieces is underlined. Right-click it for words that take less airtime.
chinese: 默认开启，与 JS8Call 一致。JS8 字典需要分段发送的词会加下划线。右键点击它可获得占用空中时间更少的词。
notes: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Composing: the JS8 message box’s settings, as JS8Call 3.0.3 has them.
Title of a group of settings in Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8: spotting heard stations to the internet. APRS-IS is the APRS internet network's name.

chinese: 把 @APRSIS 消息播报到 APRS-IS
notes: Label of an on/off switch in Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8. @APRSIS is a JS8 group address; APRS-IS is a network's name. To spot = to report a heard station to a network.

english: Off by default (JS8Call ships it on), and it works only while the PSK Reporter switch is on. A station heard sending @APRSIS GRID is put on the APRS map at that locator, and the text after @APRSIS CMD goes to APRS-IS as a raw packet. Both go up under your callsign: Nexus logs in to APRS-IS with the passcode worked out from it, as the iGate does, and stores nothing.
chinese: 默认关闭（JS8Call 出厂为开启），且仅在 PSK Reporter 开关开启时有效。听到某台发送 @APRSIS GRID 时，会把它按该定位符放到 APRS 地图上；@APRSIS CMD 之后的文本会作为原始数据包发往 APRS-IS。两者都以你的呼号上传：Nexus 用由该呼号推算出的口令登录 APRS-IS，与 iGate 一样，且不存储任何内容。
do_not_translate: JS8Call | PSK Reporter | @APRSIS GRID | @APRSIS CMD | APRS-IS | Nexus | iGate
notes: Help text under the @APRSIS switch. @APRSIS GRID and @APRSIS CMD are JS8 messages a station sends; the passcode is the APRS-IS login code, computed from the callsign.

english: Relay APRS-IS messages to heard stations
chinese: 把 APRS-IS 消息中继给听到的台站
notes: Label of an on/off switch in Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8. Heard stations = stations this station has received on JS8.

english: Off by default. This transmits with nobody at the radio: an APRS message for a station you have heard on JS8 is keyed to it as @APRSIS MSG TO:, signed DE and the sender's call, and acknowledged on APRS-IS in that station's name. Never to a station on the never-spot list below. Only while TX is on, one message at a time, through every transmit guard, the idle and TX watchdogs included. Needs the switch above.
chinese: 默认关闭。这会在无人值守时发射：发给某台（你曾在 JS8 上听到它）的 APRS 消息会以 @APRSIS MSG TO: 键控给它，署名为 DE 加发送者呼号，并以该台站的名义在 APRS-IS 上确认。绝不发给下方“永不播报”列表中的台站。仅在 TX 开启时、一次一条，并经过所有发射保护，包括空闲看门狗和 TX 看门狗。需要上方开关。
do_not_translate: @APRSIS MSG TO: | DE | APRS-IS | JS8 | TX
notes: Help text under the relay switch. It must say plainly that the switch makes the radio transmit by itself. @APRSIS MSG TO: and DE are JS8 words sent on the air; the watchdogs are the automatic transmit time limits; the never-spot list is the field below it.
Label of a text field in Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8: a comma-separated list of callsigns. JS8Call names this setting the same way.

english: While the PSK Reporter switch is on, the stations you hear on JS8 are spotted as JS8Call spots them: to PSK Reporter and to JS8NET, JS8Call's spotting network, along with the commands sent to a @group. A callsign on this comma-separated list, as heard or by its base call, is spotted to no network. Empty by default, as in JS8Call.
chinese: PSK Reporter 开关开启时，你在 JS8 上听到的台站会按 JS8Call 的方式播报：发往 PSK Reporter 和 JS8Call 的播报网络 JS8NET，以及发往 @group 的命令。此逗号分隔列表中的呼号，按听到的呼号或其基础呼号，不会播报到任何网络。默认留空，与 JS8Call 一致。
notes: Help text under the never-spot list. JS8NET is JS8Call's spotting network; a @group is a JS8 group address such as @HB; the base callsign is the call without a /P or a prefix.
Heading of a group of settings in Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8.

english: Hide these callsigns in the RX pane
chinese: 在接收窗格中隐藏这些呼号

english: Comma separated, as JS8Call 3.0 has it. Nothing a listed station sends prints in the RX pane, by its call or its base call; the call list marks it ✕. It is still heard, answered and filed as before. The call list’s “Block this station” adds to it.
chinese: 逗号分隔，与 JS8Call 3.0 相同。列表中的台站发来的内容不会打印在接收窗格中，按其呼号或基础呼号匹配；呼号列表会用 ✕ 标出它。它仍会被听到、被应答并按原样归档。呼号列表中的“屏蔽此台站”会加入到此。

english: Highlight these words or callsigns (primary colour)
chinese: 高亮这些词或呼号（主色）

english: Comma separated. A Band activity row with one of these words, and the call list row of one of these calls, is tinted. Empty by default, as in JS8Call.
chinese: 逗号分隔。包含其中某个词的波段活动行，以及其中某个呼号的呼号列表行，会被着色。默认留空，与 JS8Call 一致。

english: Highlight these words or callsigns (secondary colour)
chinese: 高亮这些词或呼号（辅色）

english: The same with the second colour. A row both lists name takes the primary.
chinese: 同上，使用第二种颜色。被两个列表同时命中的行使用主色。

english: Printed after the last frame of a message in the RX pane and Band activity. ♢ by default, as in JS8Call; up to 2 characters.
chinese: 在接收窗格和波段活动中，打印在一条消息的最后一帧之后。默认 ♢，与 JS8Call 一致；最多 2 个字符。

english: Printed where the next frame of a message did not come within one and a half periods. …… by default, as in JS8Call.
chinese: 在一条消息的下一帧未在一个半周期内到达之处打印。默认 ……，与 JS8Call 一致。

notes: Heading of a group of settings in Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8.

english: A sound when one of these is heard, whichever screen is showing: its own tone, or a WAV file you choose. All off by default, as JS8Call’s notifications are. Test plays it once.
chinese: 听到下列事件时发声，无论当前显示哪个界面：使用其自带音调，或你选择的 WAV 文件。默认全部关闭，与 JS8Call 的通知一致。“测试”会播放一次。

notes: One of the events that can play a sound, in Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Sounds.
One of the events that can play a sound, in Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8 ▸ Sounds.

english: A message directed to you or your group
A message filed in your Inbox
chinese: 有消息归档到你的收件箱

notes: Button that plays the sound once. The same English text "Test" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.connections.qrz.test.action, settings.thisComputer.audio.test.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Accessible name of the Test button. {{event}} is the event, e.g. “A CQ”.

english: Choose a WAV file to play for this sound
chinese: 选择用于此提示音的 WAV 文件

english: Never a device your radio transmits from: a sound there could key a rig on VOX, so Nexus will not play one there, even if the radio’s TX audio device is changed to it later.
chinese: 绝不能用你电台发射所用的设备：那里的声音可能让 VOX 电台误发，所以 Nexus 不会在那里播放，即使之后把电台的 TX 音频设备改成它也一样。

english: {{device}} (radio TX audio, not used for sounds)
chinese: {{device}}（电台 TX 音频，不用于提示音）

notes: Section title on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8. JS8Call is a program's name; API stays as it is.

english: For programs written for JS8Call, such as loggers, maps and message tools, on this computer. They can read what Nexus hears, the inbox and the station details. They cannot transmit, tune or change anything. Programs on other computers cannot connect.
chinese: 供为本机上的 JS8Call 编写的程序使用，例如日志、地图和消息工具。它们可以读取 Nexus 听到的内容、收件箱和台站详情。它们不能发射、调谐或更改任何东西。其他电脑上的程序无法连接。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8, beside an on/off switch.

english: Programs connect to 127.0.0.1 on the port below. One at a time, as in JS8Call.
chinese: 程序连接到 127.0.0.1 上的下列端口。一次一个，与 JS8Call 一致。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8. A network port number.
Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8, beside an on/off switch.

english: Nexus sends to a program listening on 127.0.0.1 at the port below, and answers it there.
chinese: Nexus 会向 127.0.0.1 上监听下列端口的程序发送，并在该处回复它。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8. A network port number.
Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8, beside an on/off switch.
Short label on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8, beside an on/off switch.

english: Off by default, as in JS8Call: the program then gets what Nexus hears and sends, and no answer to its requests. On, Nexus answers its requests to read. A request to send, tune or change a setting is never answered.
chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致：此时程序能收到 Nexus 听到和发出的内容，但对其请求不予应答。开启后，Nexus 会应答其读取请求。发送、调谐或更改设置的请求永远不会被应答。
notes: Shown under both Accept switches on: Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8.
Abbreviation shown on: Settings ▸ SSTV. Check the screen before expanding or translating it.

Short label on: Settings ▸ SSTV. The same English text "Receiving" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. status.rx.label, shell.tx.announce.off) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 打开 SSTV 时开始接收

english: The SSTV screen starts the decoder as soon as you open it, so a picture on the band decodes without arming anything. Turn this off to arm the receiver by hand (the Arm button in the SSTV header). Stopping the receiver yourself is already remembered for the rest of the session.
chinese: SSTV 界面一打开就启动解码器，因此波段上的图片无需任何启用即可解码。关闭此项则需手动启用接收（SSTV 标题栏中的“启用”按钮）。你自己停止接收机的状态会在本次会话内记住。

english: Auto-arm SSTV for ISS passes — tunes {{freq}} FM and arms the decoder when the ISS is overhead while the SSTV or Satellites screen is open, restores your dial at LOS. On any other screen it only tells you the ISS is up and leaves your radio alone. If your radio can't receive {{freq}} MHz, it tells you once a session and does nothing else. Off by default. A pass arm is an explicit act, so it works whether or not the switch above is on.
chinese: 为 ISS 过境自动启用 SSTV — 当 SSTV 或卫星界面打开且 ISS 在头顶时，调谐到 {{freq}} FM 并启用解码器，LOS 时恢复你的频率。在其他界面上，它只会告诉你 ISS 已升起，不动你的电台。若你的电台无法接收 {{freq}} MHz，每次会话只提示一次，别的不做。默认关闭。过境启用属于显式动作，因此无论上方开关是否开启都有效。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ SSTV. The same English text "Transmitting" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. status.tx.label, shell.tx.announce.on, settings.transmit.tciServer.program.keyed) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Automatic — Scottie 1 on HF, PD-120 on 2 m (ARISS)
chinese: 自动 — HF 用 Scottie 1，2 米用 PD-120（ARISS）

english: This is the mode the SSTV screen starts on; you can still change it there for one picture. Automatic follows the band: HF gets Scottie 1 (the NA calling-frequency convention — Martin 1 is the EU one), 2 m gets PD-120, which is what ARISS transmits.
chinese: 这是 SSTV 界面启动时使用的模式；你仍可在那里为某一张图片更改。自动跟随波段：HF 用 Scottie 1（北美的呼叫频率惯例 — Martin 1 是欧洲的），2 米用 PD-120，也就是 ARISS 发射用的。

english: Send my callsign after each picture
chinese: 每张图片后发送我的呼号

english: Adds the FSK callsign burst other SSTV software reads and shows under the received picture — the same one Nexus shows you under yours. Off by default: it adds about {{seconds}} seconds of key-down to every transmission. Your callsign is still drawn into the picture either way.
chinese: 在接收图片下方加入其他 SSTV 软件能读取并显示的 FSK 呼号脉冲串 — 与 Nexus 在你自己图片下方显示的那个相同。默认关闭：它会给每次发射额外增加约 {{seconds}} 秒的持续按键时间。无论开否，你的呼号仍会绘制在图片上。

english: The drive the SSTV screen starts on, and the level an image is sent at. Leave it blank and Nexus never touches your power. SSTV is up to 290 seconds of continuous key-down at full duty, so most operators run it well below their SSB drive. Your Phone power cap still applies on top of this.
chinese: SSTV 界面启动时的驱动力，以及图片发送所用的电平。留空则 Nexus 从不触碰你的功率。SSTV 最长可达 290 秒的满占空比连续发射，因此大多数操作者会让它远低于自己的 SSB 驱动力。你话音的功率上限仍会叠加在此之上。

english: Your callsign is burned into the top-left of every picture you transmit, and there is no switch for it: an SSTV over is one long carrier of picture-only audio, so the picture is the identification ({{rule}}). Send is refused until you have set a callsign in Settings ▸ Station. If a picture already shows your call — a pre-made QSO card — tick “My picture already shows my callsign” in the SSTV screen: that is per-picture on purpose and resets with every new image.
chinese: 你的呼号会被烧录到你发射的每张图片的左上角，且没有开关可关：一次 SSTV 发射就是一段只有图片音频的长载波，因此图片本身就是识别（{{rule}}）。在“设置 ▸ 台站”中设好呼号前，“发送”会被拒绝。若图片上已经显示你的呼号 — 例如预先做好的 QSO 卡片 — 请在 SSTV 界面勾选“我的图片已显示我的呼号”：这是特意按图片设置的，每换一张新图片就会重置。
notes: Quotes another control by name: "My picture already shows my callsign" is the on-screen text of sstv.tx.idopt.label. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint points at a menu entry that no longer exists.
Abbreviation shown on: Settings ▸ APRS. Check the screen before expanding or translating it.

chinese: 自动 — 依据你的网格为 {{freq}}

english: Automatic — {{freq}} (set your grid on the Station tab)
chinese: 自动 — {{freq}}（请在“台站”标签页设置你的网格）

english: The 2 m FM channel APRS runs on, which is regional. Automatic follows your grid square, so moving to another region lands you on the right channel with nothing to configure — the number it picked is shown above. The boundaries are approximate; pick a channel here to pin it for good.
chinese: APRS 使用的 2 米 FM 频道，因地区而异。自动会跟随你的网格方格，因此换到别的地区也会自动落在正确频道上，无需配置 — 它选出的数值显示在上方。边界是近似的；在此选定频道可永久固定。

english: The icon other stations see on the map for your beacon. Digipeater and iGate come from the alternate symbol table and are what a fixed station running as infrastructure should show.
chinese: 其他台站在地图上看到的你的信标图标。数字中继（Digipeater）和 iGate 来自备用符号表，是作为基础设施运行的固定台站应显示的。

english: Free text carried with your position — a name, a net, a URL. This goes on the air, and APRS caps it at 43 characters.
chinese: 随位置一起发送的自由文本 — 姓名、网络、URL。这会送上空中，APRS 限制为 43 个字符。

english: Which digipeaters may repeat your beacon. {{path}} is the near-universal default — one hop through a local fill-in digi, then one wide hop. Leave it empty to transmit direct, with no digipeaters at all.
chinese: 哪些数字中继可以转发你的信标。{{path}} 是近乎通用的默认值 — 经本地补点中继跳一次，再宽域跳一次。留空则直接发射，完全不经过数字中继。

english: The suffix on your callsign in every APRS frame you send, which is how other operators tell your mobile from your home station. From my callsign uses whatever your callsign already spells out — so if you have set it to {{example}} on the Station tab, that is what goes out.
chinese: 你发出的每个 APRS 帧中呼号的后缀，其他操作者据此区分你的移动台与家庭台站。来自我的呼号 会使用你呼号里已经写明的后缀 — 所以如果你在“台站”标签页把它设成了 {{example}}，发出的就是这个。
notes: Quotes another control by name: "From my callsign" is the on-screen text of settings.aprs.ssid.fromCallsign. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint points at a menu entry that no longer exists.
One-word control on: Settings ▸ APRS. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.
One-word control on: Settings ▸ APRS. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.
One-word control on: Settings ▸ APRS. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Plot stations the internet reports alongside the ones your own antenna hears — each one tagged so you can always tell which is which. Runs whether or not the APRS decoder is armed: it uses no radio and never transmits. If internet stations appear while your receiver stays silent, the fault is in the RF chain.
chinese: 把互联网上报的台站与你自己天线听到的一起标绘 — 各自带标记，让你随时分得清。无论 APRS 解码器是否启用它都会运行：不使用电台，也从不发射。若互联网台站出现而你的接收机一直安静，故障就在射频链路上。

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ APRS. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: Your regional Tier 2 rotate is best — noam / soam / euro / asia / aunz .aprs2.net. {{host}} works anywhere.
chinese: 最好用你所在地区的二级轮转站 — noam / soam / euro / asia / aunz 的 .aprs2.net。{{host}} 在任何地方都可用。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ APRS. The same English text "Port" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.connectWeb.port.label, settings.amplifier.netPort.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: 14580 is the filtered port clients and iGates should use. The full-feed ports would send you the entire planet.
chinese: 14580 是客户端与 iGate 应使用的过滤端口。全量端口会把整个地球的数据都发给你。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ APRS. The same English text "Radius (km)" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. aprs.inet.radius.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: How far around your grid square to subscribe. APRS is a local mode; 150 km is a generous 2 m-plus-digipeater horizon. 0 = no distance limit (busy).
chinese: 订阅你网格方格周围多远。APRS 是本地模式；150 km 已是 2 米加数字中继的宽裕视距。0 = 不限距离（会很忙）。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ APRS. The same English text "Watched calls" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. aprs.inet.watch.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Comma separated. These come through from anywhere on earth, however far outside your radius they are — the club tracker on a road trip, a friend chasing a summit.
chinese: 逗号分隔。这些呼号无论在地球何处、离你的半径多远，都会送达 — 例如公路旅行中的俱乐部追踪器、正在冲顶的朋友。

english: Include weather reports in the feed.
chinese: 在数据源中包含天气报告。

english: Repeaters, NWS alerts and event markers other stations have placed on the map.
chinese: 其他台站放到地图上的中继、NWS 警报和事件标记。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ APRS. The same English text "Messages" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. aprs.messages.title, jtty.style.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Show APRS text messages from the feed. Display only — replying to an internet message is not wired up.
chinese: 显示数据源中的 APRS 文本消息。仅显示 — 回复互联网消息的功能尚未接通。

english: How long a station stays on the map after its last packet. Stations start to fade at a third of this. An hour by default: fixed stations often beacon only every ten to thirty minutes, and a shorter window makes the slow ones blink off between their own beacons. 0 keeps every station forever (no fade, no removal — the 2000-station ceiling still applies).
chinese: 某台站在其最后一个数据包之后在地图上保留多久。台站会在此值的三分之一处开始淡出。默认一小时：固定台站常常只每十到三十分钟发一次信标，窗口太短会让慢的台站在两次信标之间闪掉。0 表示永久保留所有台站（不淡出、不删除 — 2000 台上限仍适用）。

english: Contribute packets your own antenna hears to APRS-IS, so stations in your area reach the global map through you. Publishes under {{call}}, so it is a separate choice from watching the feed, and it needs the APRS decoder running to have anything to send. Nexus never sends the other way: gating the internet back onto the air means transmitting unattended.
chinese: 把你自己天线听到的数据包贡献给 APRS-IS，让你所在地区的台站经你到达全球地图。以 {{call}} 名义发布，因此这与“观看数据源”是两个独立选择，且需要 APRS 解码器运行才有内容可发。Nexus 从不反向发送：把互联网内容回灌到空中意味着无人值守发射。

english: Contribute packets your own antenna hears to APRS-IS, so stations in your area reach the global map through you. Publishes under your callsign, so it is a separate choice from watching the feed, and it needs the APRS decoder running to have anything to send. Nexus never sends the other way: gating the internet back onto the air means transmitting unattended.
chinese: 把你自己天线听到的数据包贡献给 APRS-IS，让你所在地区的台站经你到达全球地图。以你的呼号发布，因此这与“观看数据源”是两个独立选择，且需要 APRS 解码器运行才有内容可发。Nexus 从不反向发送：把互联网内容回灌到空中意味着无人值守发射。

english: The dial frequency used when a band/mode is selected. These are overrides of the stock WSJT-X working-frequency table — leave the list empty to use stock everywhere. An override replaces the stock row for its band + mode (e.g. to move FT8 to an alternate sub-band).
chinese: 选定波段/模式时使用的频率。这些是对 WSJT-X 原始工作频率表的覆盖 — 列表留空则各处都使用原始值。一条覆盖会替换其波段 + 模式对应的原始行（例如把 FT8 挪到备用子波段）。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Working frequencies. The same English text "Band" is used by 16 different keys (e.g. logEntry.override.band.label, nowbar.band.label, link.band.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Working frequencies. The same English text "Mode" is used by 17 different keys (e.g. logEntry.override.mode.label, logbook.field.mode.label, logbook.column.mode) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Short label on: Settings ▸ Working frequencies. The same English text "Dial (MHz)" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. freq.dial.label) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

chinese: 你的覆盖 — 原始值为 {{mhz}} MHz

notes: One-word control on: Settings ▸ Working frequencies. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Russian word.

english: {{us}} (US) · {{world}} (outside the US, chosen from your callsign)
chinese: {{us}}（美国）· {{world}}（美国以外，按你的呼号选定）

english: WSJT-X stock dial frequencies. A row with an active override shows your value (highlighted) instead of the stock one.
chinese: WSJT-X 原始频率。有生效覆盖的行会显示你的数值（高亮），而不是原始值。

english: None — the stock table is in effect.
chinese: 无 — 正在使用标准表。

english: duplicate band + mode — the last row wins
chinese: 重复的波段 + 模式 — 最后一行生效

english: MHz is the dial (suppressed-carrier) frequency. Save to apply — band switches then use your value for that band + mode.
chinese: MHz 是频率（抑制载波）频率。保存后生效 — 之后切换波段就会使用你为该波段 + 模式设定的值。

english: Remote access is set up at the station, on its own screen.
chinese: 远程访问在台站端设置，有它自己的界面。

english: Used by the P.533 link budget only. 0 = a simple wire/vertical (isotropic); a 3-element yagi ≈ 6–8. Honest v1: a plain dB shift — no pattern or takeoff-angle modelling, and the fast heuristic ignores it.
chinese: 仅供 P.533 链路预算使用。0 = 简单的线天线/垂直天线（各向同性）；三单元八木 ≈ 6–8。诚实的 v1：只是简单的 dB 平移 — 无方向图或起飞角建模，快速启发式会忽略它。

english: Pushes each logged QSO into DXKeeper over its TCP Network Service. Enable it in DXKeeper under Configuration ▸ Defaults ▸ Network Service first.
chinese: 把每次记录的 QSO 经其 TCP 网络服务推送到 DXKeeper。请先在 DXKeeper 的 Configuration ▸ Defaults ▸ Network Service 中启用。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ DXKeeper. The same English text "empty = off" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.n3fjp.host.placeholder, settings.n1mm.addr.placeholder) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Usually 127.0.0.1 — same PC. Leave blank to disable.
chinese: 通常是 127.0.0.1 — 同一台电脑。留空则禁用。

english: The Base Port from DXKeeper's Network Service panel (default 52000). DXKeeper itself listens on {{port}} — Nexus adds the 1 for you.
chinese: DXKeeper 网络服务面板中的 Base Port（默认 52000）。DXKeeper 本身监听 {{port}} — Nexus 已替你加上 1。

english: Off by default: Nexus already uploads to LoTW / eQSL / ClubLog / QRZ, so turning this on would upload every QSO twice. Note DXKeeper ignores this for Club Log and QRZ if Auto upload is ticked on its own QSL Configuration tab — untick it there.
chinese: 默认关闭：Nexus 已自行上传到 LoTW / eQSL / ClubLog / QRZ，开启此项会让每个 QSO 上传两次。注意：若 DXKeeper 自身 QSL Configuration 标签页中勾选了 Auto upload，它会忽略此设置对 Club Log 和 QRZ 的处理 — 请在那里取消勾选。
do_not_translate: <em> | Club Log | DXKeeper | ClubLog | Nexus | LoTW | eQSL | QRZ | QSL | QSO

chinese: N3FJP 集成（俱乐部主日志）

english: Each contact you log in Contest mode reaches the club's master N3FJP log the moment you log it. Nexus fills in the form of the N3FJP Field Day Contest Log (call, band, mode, class and section), so at Field Day the whole club's score updates in real time. CQ WPX, CQ WW RTTY and the ARRL VHF contests carry their exchange too; a QSO party, Sweepstakes or CQ WW CW/SSB contact reaches N3FJP without its exchange. Run N3FJP on the master computer; point Nexus at its IP + port (default 1100).
chinese: 你在竞赛模式下记录的每次联络，都会在记录的瞬间送达俱乐部的主 N3FJP 日志。Nexus 会填好 N3FJP Field Day Contest Log 的表单（呼号、波段、模式、等级和分区），因此 Field Day 期间整个俱乐部的比分实时更新。CQ WPX、CQ WW RTTY 和 ARRL VHF 竞赛也会带上其交换信息；QSO 派对、Sweepstakes 或 CQ WW CW/SSB 的联络会送达 N3FJP 但不带交换信息。请在主控电脑上运行 N3FJP；让 Nexus 指向其 IP + 端口（默认 1100）。
do_not_translate: N3FJP | Nexus | <b> | Field Day | CQ | WPX | CQ WW RTTY | RTTY | ARRL | VHF | QSO | Sweepstakes | CW | SSB

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ N3FJP. The same English text "empty = off" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.dxkeeper.host.placeholder, settings.n1mm.addr.placeholder) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: IP or hostname of the master log computer. Leave blank to disable.
chinese: 主日志电脑的 IP 或主机名。留空则禁用。
N3FJP 的 API TCP 端口（默认 1100）。

english: Log each contest contact with N3FJP's ENTER sequence, which scores the contest — the correct path. Turn off to fall back to a plain ADDDIRECT insert (may not score). On by default.
chinese: 用 N3FJP 的 ENTER 序列记录每次竞赛联络，它会为竞赛计分 — 这是正确的路径。关闭则回退到普通的 ADDDIRECT 插入（可能不计分）。默认开启。
向 N3FJP 报告我的波段

english: Tell N3FJP which band you're on (no CAT needed), so the club's Network Status Display band board shows this position. Off by default.
chinese: 告诉 N3FJP 你在哪个波段（无需 CAT），这样俱乐部的网络状态显示波段板会显示此位置。默认关闭。

english: Also push every logged QSO (not just contest contacts) to N3FJP ACLog on the host above — everyday general logging. N3FJP dedupes, so it's safe to run alongside the contest push.
chinese: 同时把每个已记录的 QSO（不只是竞赛联络）推送到上方主机的 N3FJP ACLog — 用于日常通用日志。N3FJP 会去重，因此与竞赛推送并行是安全的。

english: Save settings, then test the N3FJP TCP connection
chinese: 保存设置，然后测试 N3FJP 的 TCP 连接

english: Run this at the club site before the event starts to confirm the API link works.
chinese: 请在活动开始前到俱乐部现场运行一次，确认 API 链路可用。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ N1MM. The same English text "empty = off" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.dxkeeper.host.placeholder, settings.n3fjp.host.placeholder) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Where the N1MM contact packets go (host:port, UDP). Name the port — consumers stack on one host, and 12060 is often already taken by another logger. Leave blank to disable.
chinese: N1MM 联络数据包发往何处（host:port，UDP）。请写明端口 — 消费者会堆在同一主机上，而 12060 常已被别的日志程序占用。留空则禁用。
正在为每个已记录的 QSO 发送。

english: An address alone sends only the contacts you log in Contest mode — turn on Broadcast every QSO below for everyday logging.
chinese: 仅填地址只发送你在竞赛模式下记录的联络 — 日常日志请开启下方的“广播每个 QSO”。

english: Send the contact packet for every logged QSO, not just contest contacts — point a map app such as GridTracker at the address above and each contact plots on its map as you log it. One packet per QSO: this never doubles up with the contest broadcast, so it is safe to leave on through a contest. Off by default; with it off, packets go out only for the contacts you log in Contest mode.
chinese: 为每个已记录的 QSO 发送联络数据包，而不只是竞赛联络 — 把 GridTracker 之类的地图程序指向上方地址，你记录时每次联络都会标绘在其地图上。每个 QSO 只发一个包：这与竞赛广播不会重复，因此整场竞赛开着也安全。默认关闭；关闭时数据包只为你以竞赛模式记录的联络发出。

notes: Short label on: Settings ▸ Confirmations. The same English text "Confirmations" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. stats.confirmations.head) — each can take a different Russian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
